(function () {
    "use strict";

    if (window.top !== window.self) return;
    if (/[?&]nov3(=|&|$)/.test(location.search)) return;

    let off = false;
    try { off = localStorage.getItem("bv3:off") === "true"; } catch { }
    if (off) {
        const addButton = () => {
            if (["", "login", "register"].includes(location.pathname.split("/")[1])) return;
            const button = document.createElement("div");
            button.textContent = "Turn on V3 UI";
            button.style.cssText = "position:fixed;left:12px;bottom:12px;z-index:99999;padding:8px 14px;border-radius:8px;background:rgb(31,31,31);color:#fff;font:700 15px Nunito,sans-serif;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:inset 0 -4px rgba(0,0,0,.25),0 0 6px rgba(0,0,0,.4)";
            button.onclick = () => {
                try { localStorage.removeItem("bv3:off"); } catch { }
                location.reload();
            };
            document.body.append(button);
        };
        if (document.body) addButton();
        else document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", addButton);
        return;
    }

    function h(tag, props, ...kids) {
        const e = document.createElement(tag);
        if (props) for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(props)) {
            if (v == null || v === false) continue;
            if (k === "class") e.className = Array.isArray(v) ? v.filter(Boolean).join(" ") : v;
            else if (k === "style" && typeof v === "object") for (const [p, val] of Object.entries(v)) {
                if (val == null) continue;
                if (p.startsWith("--")) e.style.setProperty(p, val);
                else e.style[p] = val;
            }
            else if (k === "dataset") Object.assign(e.dataset, v);
            else if (k.startsWith("on") && typeof v === "function") e.addEventListener(k.slice(2), v);
            else if (k === "html") e.innerHTML = v;
            else e.setAttribute(k, v === true ? "" : v);
        }
        for (const c of kids.flat(Infinity)) {
            if (c == null || c === false) continue;
            e.append(c.nodeType ? c : document.createTextNode(String(c)));
        }
        return e;
    }

    const ordinal = (n) => {

        return "th";
    };

    async function requestJson(url, options, tries) {
        for (let i = 0; i < tries; i++) {
            if (i) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 700 * i));
            try {
                const res = await fetch(url, { credentials: "include", ...options });
                const text = await res.text();
                try { return JSON.parse(text); } catch { }
                if (res.status === 404) return { error: true, reason: "That isn't available right now." };
            } catch { }
        }
        return { error: true, reason: "Blacket is busy right now, try again in a moment." };
    }

    const plugin = (name) => !!(pluginState[name] ?? PLUGIN_DEFAULTS[name]);

        ocean: { name: "Ocean", vars: { "--background-color": "#0f2a3a", "--primary-color": "#12384d", "--secondary-color": "#1d5673", "--tertiary-color": "#0a1e2a" } },
        grape: { name: "Grape", vars: { "--background-color": "#2a1f3d", "--primary-color": "#21182f", "--secondary-color": "#43335e", "--tertiary-color": "#150f1f" } },
        rose: { name: "Rose", vars: { "--background-color": "#3a1f2a", "--primary-color": "#2b1720", "--secondary-color": "#5a2f42", "--tertiary-color": "#1c0e14" } },
        forest: { name: "Forest", vars: { "--background-color": "#1f3326", "--primary-color": "#17261c", "--secondary-color": "#2f4d38", "--tertiary-color": "#0f1912" } },
        amoled: { name: "AMOLED", vars: { "--background-color": "#000000", "--primary-color": "#0b0b0b", "--secondary-color": "#1f1f1f", "--tertiary-color": "#000000" } }
    };
    function customThemeVars(hex) {
        const n = parseInt(String(hex).replace("#", ""), 16) || 0x3b5bdb;
        const [r, g, b] = [(n >> 16) & 255, (n >> 8) & 255, n & 255].map((c) => c / 255);
        const max = Math.max(r, g, b), min = Math.min(r, g, b), d = max - min, l = (max + min) / 2;
        const s = d ? d / (1 - Math.abs(2 * l - 1)) : 0;
        const hue = !d ? 0 : max === r ? 60 * (((g - b) / d) % 6) : max === g ? 60 * ((b - r) / d + 2) : 60 * ((r - g) / d + 4);
        const sat = Math.round(Math.min(s * 100, 45));
        const hsl = (light) => `hsl(${Math.round((hue + 360) % 360)}, ${sat}%, ${light}%)`;
        return { "--background-color": hsl(18), "--primary-color": hsl(12), "--secondary-color": hsl(26), "--tertiary-color": hsl(7) };
    }
    function applyTheme() {
        const root = document.documentElement;
        if (!root) return;
        for (const v of ["--background-color", "--primary-color", "--secondary-color", "--tertiary-color"]) root.style.removeProperty(v);
        const theme = pluginValue("theme", "default");
        const vars = theme === "custom" ? customThemeVars(pluginValue("themeColor", "#3b5bdb")) : (THEMES[theme] || THEMES.default).vars;
        for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(vars)) root.style.setProperty(k, v);
        root.classList.toggle("bv3-lite", plugin("performance"));
        const image = customBackground();
        root.classList.toggle("bv3-custom-bg", !!image);
        for (const el of document.querySelectorAll(".bv3-bgimg")) el.style.backgroundImage = image ? `url("${image}")` : "";
    }

    async function uploadFile(file) {
        if (!file) throw "No file chosen.";
        if (file.size > 8 * 1024 * 1024) throw "File size is too large. (Max 8 MB)";
        const res = await postJson("/worker/upload", { filename: file.name, contentType: file.type });
        if (res.error) throw res.reason || "Upload failed.";
        const put = await fetch(res.data.url, { method: "PUT", headers: { "Content-Type": file.type }, body: file }).catch(() => null);
        if (!put?.ok) throw "Upload failed.";
        return String(res.data.publicUrl).replaceAll(" ", "%20");
    }

    const socketHandlers = new Set();
    let watchedSocket = null;
    function watchSocket() {
        const sock = v2().socket;
        if (!sock || sock === watchedSocket || !sock.addEventListener) return;
        watchedSocket = sock;
        sock.addEventListener("message", (e) => {
            let msg;
            try { msg = JSON.parse(e.data); } catch { return; }
            for (const fn of socketHandlers) {
                try { fn(msg); } catch (err) { console.error("[V3 skin]", err); }
            }
        });
    }
    setInterval(watchSocket, 1000);
    const onSocket = (fn) => (socketHandlers.add(fn), () => socketHandlers.delete(fn));
    const emitSocket = (event, data) => {
        const sock = v2().socket;
        if (sock?.readyState !== 1 || typeof sock.emit !== "function") return false;
        sock.emit(event, data);
        return true;
    };

        navigateTo();

    const expCost = (level) => 5 * Math.pow(level, v2().config?.exp?.difficulty ?? 0.75) * level;
    function levelFromExp(exp) {
        let level = 0, left = exp || 0;
        for (let i = 0; i <= 27915 && left >= expCost(level); i++) left -= expCost(level++);
        return { level, into: left, needed: expCost(level) };
    }

    function userLevel(user) {
        if (typeof user?.level === "number" && typeof user?.needed === "number") {
            let total = user.exp || 0;
            for (let l = 0; l < user.level; l++) total += expCost(l);
            return { level: user.level, into: user.exp || 0, needed: user.needed, total };
        }
        const exp = user?.exp ?? user?.misc?.exp ?? 0;
        return { ...levelFromExp(exp), total: exp };
    }

    function fitText(box, max, min = 1) {
        let lo = min, hi = max;
        while (lo < hi) {
            const mid = Math.ceil((lo + hi) / 2);
            box.style.fontSize = mid + "px";
            if (box.scrollWidth <= box.clientWidth + 1 && box.scrollHeight <= box.clientHeight + 1) lo = mid;
            else hi = mid - 1;
        }
        box.style.fontSize = lo + "px";
    }

    function textfit(className, max, ...kids) {
        const box = h("div", { class: className, style: { whiteSpace: "nowrap" } }, ...kids);
        requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(() => fitText(box, max)));
        return box;
    }

    let tooltipEl;
    function tooltip(target, text) {
        target.addEventListener("mouseenter", () => {

            document.body.append(tooltipEl);
            const r = target.getBoundingClientRect();
            const t = tooltipEl.getBoundingClientRect();
            tooltipEl.style.left = `${r.left + r.width / 2 - t.width / 2}px`;
            tooltipEl.style.top = `${r.top - t.height - 8}px`;
        });
        target.addEventListener("mouseleave", () => tooltipEl?.remove());
        target.addEventListener("click", () => tooltipEl?.remove());
        return target;
    }

    const toastQueue = [];

    function showToast() {
        const t = toastQueue[0];
        if (!t) return;
        const s = S("stores/ToastStore/toast");
        const el = h("div", { class: ["bv3-root", s.toastContainer], dataset: { closing: "false" } },
            h("div", { class: s.toast },
                t.icon && h("div", { class: s.leftSide }, h("div", { class: s.toastIcon },
                    t.icon.startsWith("fa") ? h("i", { class: t.icon }) : h("img", { class: s.toastIconImage, src: t.icon }))),
                h("div", { class: s.rightSide }, h("div", { class: s.toastHeader }, t.header), h("div", { class: s.toastBody }, t.body))));
        let done = false;
        const close = () => {
            if (done) return;
            done = true;
            el.dataset.closing = "true";
            setTimeout(() => { el.remove(); toastQueue.shift(); showToast(); }, 500);

                GenericButton({ to: "/store", icon: "fas fa-cart-shopping", className: s.visitStoreButton, backgroundColor: "#2b22c2" }, "Store")
            ),

        );

    function mirrorChatMentions(indicator) {
        let last = "";
        const sync = () => {
            const src = document.getElementById("chatNotificationIndicator");
            if (!src) return;
            const count = parseInt(src.textContent || "0", 10);
            const visible = src.style.display !== "none" && count > 0;
            const next = `${visible}:${count}`;
            if (next === last) return;
            last = next;
            indicator.style.display = visible ? "" : "none";
            indicator.firstChild.textContent = String(count);
        };
        const watch = () => {
            const src = document.getElementById("chatNotificationIndicator");
            if (!src) return setTimeout(watch, 500);
            new MutationObserver(sync).observe(src, { childList: true, characterData: true, subtree: true, attributes: true, attributeFilter: ["style"] });
            sync();
        };
        watch();
    }

            location.reload();
        });
    }

    const PAGES = {};

    const ownedItems = (user) => {
        const counts = {};
        for (const name of Object.values(user?.inventory || {})) if (v2().items?.[name]) counts[name] = (counts[name] || 0) + 1;
        return counts;

    const rarityColor = (name) => v2().rarities?.[v2().blooks?.[name]?.rarity]?.color || "#ffffff";

    function formatDuration(diff) {
        const seconds = Math.floor((diff / 1000) % 60);
        const minutes = Math.floor((diff / 60000) % 60);
        const hours = Math.floor((diff / 3600000) % 24);
        const days = Math.floor(diff / 86400000);
        if (days > 1) return `${days}d ${hours}h ${minutes}m`;
        if (hours >= 1) return `${hours}h ${minutes}m ${seconds}s`;
        if (minutes >= 1) return `${minutes}m ${seconds}s`;
        return `${seconds}s`;
    }
    const formatTimeRemaining = (expires) => {
        const diff = expires.getTime() - Date.now();
        return diff <= 0 ? "Expired" : formatDuration(diff);
    };

    function RarityLabel(text, backgroundColor) {
        const NS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";
        const svg = (tag, attrs, ...kids) => {
            const e = document.createElementNS(NS, tag);
            for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(attrs || {})) e.setAttribute(k, v);
            e.append(...kids);
            return e;
        };

        const unit = 50, fontSize = unit * 0.8, padY = unit * 0.1;
        const height = unit + padY * 2;
        const id = `mask-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)}`;
        const rainbow = backgroundColor === "rainbow";

        let overlay = "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8)";
        const hex = /^#[0-9a-f]{6}$/i.test(backgroundColor) ? backgroundColor : /^#[0-9a-f]{3}$/i.test(backgroundColor) ? "#" + [...backgroundColor.slice(1)].map((c) => c + c).join("") : null;
        if (hex) {
            const lum = 0.299 * parseInt(hex.slice(1, 3), 16) + 0.587 * parseInt(hex.slice(3, 5), 16) + 0.114 * parseInt(hex.slice(5, 7), 16);
            overlay = lum < 128 ? "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5)" : "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)";
        }

        const textAttrs = { "font-size": fontSize, "font-family": "Puffet, sans-serif", style: "text-transform: uppercase" };
        const label = svg("svg", { width: "100%", height: "100%", preserveAspectRatio: "xMidYMid meet" });
        const draw = (width) => {
            label.setAttribute("viewBox", `0 0 ${width} ${height}`);
            const r = { width, height, rx: height / 2, ry: height / 2 };
            label.replaceChildren(
                svg("defs", null,
                    svg("mask", { id }, svg("rect", { ...r, fill: "white" }),
                        svg("text", { ...textAttrs, x: width / 2, y: height / 2 + 2, "text-anchor": "middle", "dominant-baseline": "middle", fill: "black" }, text)),
                    rainbow ? svg("linearGradient", { id: `${id}-rb`, x1: "0%", y1: "0%", x2: "100%", y2: "0%" },
                        ...["red", "orange", "yellow", "#0f0", "#0ff", "blue", "#f0f", "red"].map((c, i) => svg("stop", { offset: `${i * 14.28}%`, "stop-color": c }))) : ""),
                svg("rect", { ...r, fill: overlay }),
                svg("rect", { ...r, fill: rainbow ? `url(#${id}-rb)` : backgroundColor, stroke: "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4)", "stroke-width": 4, mask: `url(#${id})` }));
        };

        const measure = svg("svg", { width: 0, height: 0, style: "position:absolute;visibility:hidden;pointer-events:none" }, svg("text", textAttrs, text));
        draw(200);
        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
            document.body.append(measure);
            const w = measure.firstChild.getBBox().width;
            measure.remove();
            if (w) draw(w * 1.4);
        });
        return label;
    }

    const RAINBOW = ["#FF0000", "#FF7F00", "#FFFF00", "#00FF00", "#0000FF", "#4B0082", "#9400D3"];
    const EMITTERS = {
        none: ["CENTER"], uncommon: ["CENTER"], rare: ["RIGHT_BOTTOM", "LEFT_BOTTOM"], epic: ["RIGHT_SHOWER", "LEFT_SHOWER"],
        legendary: ["TOP"], chroma: ["RIGHT_DIAMOND", "LEFT_DIAMOND"], mystical: ["RIGHT_SHOWER", "LEFT_SHOWER", "TOP"], mythical: ["RIGHT_SHOWER", "LEFT_SHOWER", "TOP"]
    };

    function ParticleCanvas({ className, color = "#ffffff", animation = "none", count = 200, size = 30, speed = 2 }) {
        const canvas = h("canvas", { class: className });
        const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
        const rand = (a, b) => Math.random() * (b - a) + a;
        const W = () => canvas.width, H = () => canvas.height;

        const spawn = (t) => {
            switch (t) {
                case "CENTER": { const a = rand(-115, -65); return { x: W() / 2, y: H() / 2, angle: a, v: rand(6, 7.5), g: 0.07, av: (a > -90 ? 1 : -1) * rand(1.25, 1.75) }; }
                case "RIGHT_BOTTOM": return { x: W(), y: H(), angle: rand(-160, -110), v: rand(6, 7.5), g: 0.05, av: rand(-1.75, -1.25) };
                case "LEFT_BOTTOM": return { x: 0, y: H(), angle: rand(-70, -20), v: rand(6, 7.5), g: 0.05, av: rand(1.25, 1.75) };
                case "TOP": return { x: rand(0, W()), y: -50, angle: 90, v: rand(0, 0.5), g: 0.07, av: rand(-1.5, 1.5) };
                case "RIGHT_SHOWER": return { x: W(), y: rand(0, H()), angle: rand(-180, -130), v: rand(6, 7.5), g: 0.03, av: rand(-1.75, -1.25) };
                case "LEFT_SHOWER": return { x: 0, y: rand(0, H()), angle: rand(-50, 0), v: rand(6, 7.5), g: 0.03, av: rand(1.25, 1.75) };
                case "RIGHT_DIAMOND": { const y = rand(0, H()); return { x: W(), y, angle: y > H() / 2 ? -150 : -210, v: rand(6, 7.5), g: 0, av: rand(-1.75, -1.25) }; }
                default: { const y = rand(0, H()); return { x: 0, y, angle: y > H() / 2 ? -30 : 30, v: rand(6, 7.5), g: 0, av: rand(1.25, 1.75) }; }
            }
        };

        const tinted = new Map();
        const tint = (img, c) => {
            const key = img.src + c;
            if (tinted.has(key)) return tinted.get(key);
            const off = document.createElement("canvas");
            off.width = size; off.height = size;
            const o = off.getContext("2d");
            o.drawImage(img, 0, 0, size, size);
            o.globalCompositeOperation = "source-atop";
            o.fillStyle = c;
            o.fillRect(0, 0, size, size);
            tinted.set(key, off);
            return off;
        };
        const images = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8].map((n) => {
            const img = new Image();
            img.crossOrigin = "anonymous";
            img.src = media(`/content/particles/${n}.png`);
            return img;
        });

        let particles = [], active = false, raf = null, last = 0;
        const reset = (p) => {
            const t = spawn(p.type);
            const rad = t.angle * Math.PI / 180;
            Object.assign(p, { x: t.x, y: t.y, vx: Math.cos(rad) * t.v, vy: Math.sin(rad) * t.v, g: t.g, av: t.av, rot: rad,
                img: images[Math.floor(Math.random() * images.length)], color: color !== "rainbow" ? color : RAINBOW[Math.floor(Math.random() * RAINBOW.length)] });
        };

        const frame = (time) => {
            const dt = Math.min(1000 / 60, time - last) / 1000 * 60 * speed;
            last = time;
            canvas.width = innerWidth; canvas.height = innerHeight;
            for (const p of particles) {
                p.vy += p.g * dt; p.x += p.vx * dt; p.y += p.vy * dt; p.rot += p.av * dt / 60;
                if (p.y > H() || p.y < -50 || p.x < -50 || p.x > W() + 50) {
                    if (!active) { p.dead = true; continue; }
                    reset(p);
                }
                if (!p.img.complete || !p.img.naturalWidth) continue;
                ctx.save();
                ctx.translate(p.x, p.y);
                ctx.rotate(p.rot);
                try { ctx.drawImage(tint(p.img, p.color), -size / 2, -size / 2); } catch { ctx.drawImage(p.img, -size / 2, -size / 2, size, size); }
                ctx.restore();
            }
            particles = particles.filter((p) => !p.dead);
            if (particles.length || active) raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
        };

        return {
            el: canvas,
            async start() {
                active = true;
                last = performance.now();
                raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
                for (const type of EMITTERS[String(animation).toLowerCase()] || EMITTERS.none) (async () => {
                    for (let i = 0; i < count && active; i++) {
                        particles.push({ type, x: 99999, y: 99999, vx: 0, vy: 0, g: 0, av: 0, rot: 0, img: images[0], color });
                        await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 10));
                    }
                })();
            },
            stop() { active = false; }
        };
    }

    function SearchBox({ placeholder, value, oninput, buttons = [], noPadding }) {

    function rarityEmoji(rarity) {
        const emojis = v2().emojis || {};
        const key = Object.keys(emojis).find((n) => n.toLowerCase() === String(rarity || "").toLowerCase());
        return key ? emojis[key].image : null;

    function QuantityCircle(s, color, amount, useVhStyles, rarity) {
        const size = useVhStyles ? "2.4vh" : "24px";
        const rainbow = color === "rainbow";
        const emoji = rarityEmoji(rarity);
        const badge = {
            borderRadius: "50%", overflow: "hidden",
            background: rainbow ? "linear-gradient(140deg, red, orange, yellow, #0f0, #0ff, blue, #f0f)" : color,

        };
        const circle = h("div", {

            style: {
                width: size, height: size, padding: "0", left: "-5px", bottom: "0",

            }
        },
        emoji && h("img", {
            class: s.blookQuantityImage, src: emoji, draggable: "false",

            onerror: function () { this.remove(); Object.assign(circle.style, badge, { filter: "" }); }
        }),
        h("div", { class: s.blookQuantityText, style: { fontSize: amount >= 99 ? (useVhStyles ? "0.9vh" : "9px") : null } }, amount >= 99 ? "99+" : amount.toLocaleString()));
        return circle;
    }

    function InventoryItem({ blook, item, amount = 0, locked = false, useVhStyles = false, hideCount = false, onClick }) {
        const s = S(`components/ItemContainer/components/InventoryItem/inventoryItem${useVhStyles ? "Vh" : ""}`);
        const data = blook ? v2().blooks?.[blook] : v2().items?.[item];
        if (!data) return null;

        const color = blook ? rarityColor(blook) : null;

        return h("div", { class: s.blook, dataset: { locked: String(locked), selectable: "true", square: String(!!item) }, onclick: onClick },
            blook
                ? Blook({ className: s.blookImage, src: data.image, objectFit: "contain" })
                : h("img", { src: data.image, class: s.itemImage, draggable: "false" }),
            blook
                ? (!locked && amount > 0 && !hideCount && QuantityCircle(s, color, amount, useVhStyles, data.rarity))
                : h("div", { class: s.itemQuantity }, `x${amount.toLocaleString()}`),
            item && h("div", { class: s.itemBackground }, h("div", { class: s.itemBackgroundOverlay, style: { background: data.color || "#2f2f2f", maskImage: `url(${media("/content/rarity-background.png")})`, webkitMaskImage: `url(${media("/content/rarity-background.png")})` } })),
            locked && h("i", { class: [s.blookLock, "fas fa-lock"] }),
            blook && isWished(blook) && WishStar()
        );
    }

    const TILE = { blook: { w: 60, h: 70 }, item: { w: 60, h: 60 } };

    function flowLayout(cells, width, center) {
        let x = 0, y = 0, rowH = 0;
        const rows = [[]];
        const placed = cells.map((c) => {
            if (x > 0 && x + c.w > width) { x = 0; y += rowH + 10; rowH = 0; rows.push([]); }
            const p = { ...c, x, y };
            rows[rows.length - 1].push(p);
            x += c.w + 10;
            rowH = Math.max(rowH, c.h);
            return p;
        });
        if (center && rows[0].length) {
            const last = rows[0][rows[0].length - 1];
            const shift = Math.max(0, (width - (last.x + last.w)) / 2);
            for (const p of placed) p.x += shift;
        }
        return { pos: placed, totalH: cells.length ? y + rowH : 0 };
    }

    function ItemContainer({ user, options = {}, className, style, onClick }) {
        const s = S("components/ItemContainer/itemContainer");
        const o = { showBlooks: true, showItems: true, showLocked: true, showPacks: true, ...options };
        const root = h("div", { class: [className, s.itemsContainer], style });

        const blooks = v2().blooks || {};
        const owned = user?.blooks || {};
        const items = ownedItems(user);
        const unlocked = o.allUnlocked || (plugin("unlockAll") && String(user?.id) === String(me()?.id));
        const search = (o.search || "").toLowerCase();
        const matches = (name) => !search || name.toLowerCase().includes(search);
        const rarityOk = (name) => !o.rarities?.length || o.rarities.includes(blooks[name]?.rarity);

        const blookCell = (name) => {
            const real = owned[name] || 0;
            const amount = real || (unlocked ? 1 : 0);
            if (!amount && !o.showLocked) return null;
            if (!matches(name) || !rarityOk(name)) return null;
            return { ...TILE.blook, blook: name, amount, real, locked: amount <= 0 };
        };
        const itemCells = () => o.showItems ? Object.entries(items).filter(([n]) => matches(n)).map(([item, amount]) => ({ ...TILE.item, item, amount, real: amount })) : [];

        const tile = (c) => h("div", { style: { position: "absolute", left: `${c.x}px`, top: `${c.y}px`, width: `${c.w}px`, height: `${c.h}px` } },
            InventoryItem({ blook: c.blook, item: c.item, amount: c.amount, locked: c.locked, useVhStyles: o.useVhStyles, hideCount: o.allUnlocked,
                onClick: () => (c.amount > 0 || o.allowLocked) && onClick?.({ type: c.blook ? "blook" : "item", name: c.blook || c.item, real: c.real }) }));

        let grids = [];
        const grid = (cells, width) => {
            const { pos, totalH } = flowLayout(cells, width, o.center);
            const el = h("div", { style: { position: "relative", height: `${totalH}px` } });
            grids.push({ el, pos, shown: new Map() });
            return el;
        };

        const paint = () => {
            const view = root.getBoundingClientRect();
            const tops = grids.map((g) => g.el.getBoundingClientRect().top - view.top);
            grids.forEach((g, n) => {
                const from = -tops[n] - 400, to = -tops[n] + view.height + 400;
                for (const [i, node] of g.shown) {
                    const c = g.pos[i];
                    if (c.y + c.h < from || c.y > to) { node.remove(); g.shown.delete(i); }
                }
                const add = [];
                g.pos.forEach((c, i) => {
                    if (c.y + c.h < from || c.y > to || g.shown.has(i)) return;
                    const node = tile(c);
                    g.shown.set(i, node);
                    add.push(node);
                });
                if (add.length) g.el.append(...add);
            });
        };
        let painting = false;
        const queuePaint = () => {
            if (painting) return;
            painting = true;
            requestAnimationFrame(() => { painting = false; paint(); });
        };
        root.addEventListener("scroll", queuePaint, { passive: true });

        let lastWidth = -1;
        const draw = () => {
            const width = root.clientWidth - 20;
            if (width <= 0) return;
            lastWidth = width;
            grids = [];

            if (!o.showPacks) {
                const cells = [
                    ...itemCells(),
                    ...(o.showBlooks ? Object.keys(blooks).map(blookCell).filter(Boolean) : [])
                ];
                root.replaceChildren(grid(cells, width));
                return queuePaint();
            }

            const sets = [];
            const mine = itemCells();
            if (mine.length) sets.push({ name: "My Items", cells: mine });
            if (o.showBlooks) {
                const packs = Object.entries(v2().packs || {}).sort((a, b) => (a[1].priority ?? 0) - (b[1].priority ?? 0));
                const seen = new Set();
                for (const [packName, pack] of packs) {
                    const cells = (pack.blooks || []).map((n) => { seen.add(n); return blookCell(n); }).filter(Boolean);
                    if (cells.length) sets.push({ name: `${packName} Pack`, icon: pack.image, cells, progress: [(pack.blooks || []).filter((n) => owned[n] > 0).length, (pack.blooks || []).length] });
                }
                const rest = Object.keys(blooks).filter((n) => !seen.has(n)).map(blookCell).filter(Boolean);
                if (rest.length) sets.push({ name: "Miscellaneous", cells: rest });
            }

            root.replaceChildren(...sets.map((set) => h("div", { class: s.setContainer },
                h("div", { class: s.setTopContainer },
                    h("div", { class: s.setTopTile, style: { backgroundImage: `url("${BACKGROUND_SVG_WHITE}")` } }),
                    h("div", { class: s.setTopText }, set.name,
                        set.progress && plugin("collectionProgress") && !o.allUnlocked && h("span", { style: { fontFamily: "var(--paragraph-font)", fontWeight: 700, fontSize: "0.5em", marginLeft: "14px", opacity: set.progress[0] === set.progress[1] ? 1 : 0.6, color: set.progress[0] === set.progress[1] ? "#7dff7d" : null } },
                            set.progress[0] === set.progress[1] ? "Complete!" : `${set.progress[0]} / ${set.progress[1]}`),
                        h("div", { class: s.setGradient }))),
                h("div", { class: s.setDivider }),
                h("div", { class: s.setContent }, grid(set.cells, width)))));
            queuePaint();
        };

        new ResizeObserver(() => (root.clientWidth - 20 !== lastWidth ? draw() : queuePaint())).observe(root);
        return root;
    }

    function Auction({ listing, useVhStyles = false, onClick }) {
        const s = S(`components/Auction/auction${useVhStyles ? "Vh" : ""}`);
        const blook = v2().blooks?.[listing.item];
        const item = v2().items?.[listing.item];

        return h("div", { class: s.auction, onclick: onClick },
            h("div", { class: s.auctionImageContainer }, blook ? Blook({ src: image }) : h("img", { src: image, draggable: "false" })),
            h("div", { class: s.auctionInfo },
                h("div", { class: s.auctionName }, listing.item),
                h("div", { class: s.auctionPrice }, "Price: ", h("img", { src: media("/content/token.png"), draggable: "false" }), " ", h("span", null, (listing.price ?? 0).toLocaleString())),
                h("div", { class: s.auctionSellerName }, "Seller: ", Username({ user: { username: listing.seller, color: listing.color || "#ffffff" } }))),
            h("div", { class: s.auctionBadge }, isWished(listing.item) && h("i", { class: "fas fa-star", style: { color: "gold", marginRight: "6px" } }), "BIN"),
            plugin("bazaarDeals") && VALUE_OF.get(listing.item) > 0 && (() => {

                    pct === 0 ? "at value" : pct < 0 ? `${-pct}% under value` : `${pct}% over value`);
            })(),

    }

    let recentChat = null, recentChatAt = 0;
    function chatLastSeen(id) {
        if (!recentChat || Date.now() - recentChatAt > 60 * 1000) {
            recentChatAt = Date.now();
            recentChat = getJson("/worker2/messages/0?limit=250");
        }
        return recentChat.then((d) => {
            const when = (d?.messages || []).filter((m) => String(m.author?.id) === String(id))
                .map((m) => { const t = m.message?.date; return +new Date(typeof t === "number" && t < 1e12 ? t * 1000 : t); })
                .filter(Boolean);
            return when.length ? Math.max(...when) : null;
        });
    }

    function Presence(user, { dot = false } = {}) {
        const el = dot
            ? h("span", { style: { display: "inline-block", width: "10px", height: "10px", borderRadius: "50%", background: "#777", flexShrink: 0 } })
            : h("span", null, "Checking...");
        let label = "Checking...";
        if (dot) tooltip(el, () => label);
        const show = (text, color) => {
            label = text;
            if (dot) el.style.background = color;
            else { el.textContent = text; el.style.color = color; }
        };
        if (typeof user.online === "boolean") show(user.online ? "Online" : "Offline", user.online ? "#5fe35f" : "#ff6b6b");
        else chatLastSeen(user.id).then((at) => {
            if (!at) return show("Not seen in chat lately", "#888");
            const ago = Date.now() - at;
            ago < 5 * 60 * 1000 ? show("Online (chatting)", "#5fe35f") : show(`Seen in chat ${formatDuration(ago)} ago`, "#ffc94d");
        });
        return el;
    }

    (() => {

            const call = (url, body) => postJson(url, body).then((d) => {

            });

                const mine = listing.seller === user.username;
                let error;
                const buttons = ModalButtons(
                    GenericButton({
                        onClick: () => {
                            if (!mine && user.tokens < listing.price) { error?.remove(); return buttons.before(error = ErrorContainer("You do not have enough tokens.")); }
                            call(mine ? "/worker/bazaar/remove" : "/worker/bazaar/buy", { id: listing.id })
                                .then(() => {

                                    } else {

                getJson(url).then((d) => {

            function filterModal() {

                    option("Cheapest", filters.sort === "cheapest", () => { filters.sort = "cheapest"; draw(); }),

                const body = ModalButtons();
                draw();
                const close = openModal(ModalHeader("Change Filters"), body,

                    { icon: "fas fa-sliders", tooltip: "Change Filters", onClick: filterModal },

            let mode = "blooks";

            const picker = h("div", { class: [s.auctionHouse, "bv3-m-picker"], style: { width: "300px", minWidth: "300px", height: "95%", display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", padding: "10px 10px 17px", boxSizing: "border-box", gap: "10px" } });
            const scroller = h("div", { style: { flex: 1, overflowY: "auto", overflowX: "hidden", paddingRight: "4px" } });

            const heading = (text) => h("div", { style: { fontFamily: "var(--heading-font)", fontSize: "22px", margin: "2px 0 8px" } }, text);

            function drawPicker() {
                const packs = Object.entries(v2().packs || {}).sort((a, b) => (a[1].priority ?? 0) - (b[1].priority ?? 0));
                const inPacks = new Set(packs.flatMap(([, p]) => p.blooks || []));
                const misc = Object.keys(v2().blooks || {}).filter((b) => !inPacks.has(b));
                const blookImg = (b) => v2().blooks?.[b]?.image || "/content/blooks/Error.webp";

                let content;
                if (mode === "items") content = [heading("Items"), grid(4, ...Object.entries(v2().items || {}).map(([name, it]) => Tile({ src: it.image, title: name, name, onClick: () => lookup(name) })))];
                else if (!openPack) content = [heading("Packs"), grid(3,
                    ...packs.map(([name, p]) => Tile({ src: p.image, title: `${name} Pack`, label: name, onClick: () => { openPack = name; drawPicker(); } })),
                    misc.length > 0 && Tile({ src: media("/content/packs/icons/DefaultTiled.png"), title: "Miscellaneous", label: "Misc", onClick: () => { openPack = "Miscellaneous"; drawPicker(); } }))];
                else {
                    const blooks = openPack === "Miscellaneous" ? misc : v2().packs?.[openPack]?.blooks || [];
                    content = [
                        h("div", { style: { display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: "10px", marginBottom: "8px" } },
                            h("div", { class: "bv3-picker-back", onclick: () => { openPack = null; drawPicker(); } }, h("i", { class: "fas fa-arrow-left" })),
                            h("div", { style: { fontFamily: "var(--heading-font)", fontSize: "22px", overflow: "hidden", textOverflow: "ellipsis", whiteSpace: "nowrap" } },
                                openPack === "Miscellaneous" ? "Miscellaneous" : `${openPack} Pack`)),
                        grid(4, ...blooks.map((b) => Tile({ src: blookImg(b), title: b, name: b, onClick: () => lookup(b) })))];
                }
                scroller.replaceChildren(...content);
                scroller.scrollTop = 0;
            }

            picker.append(
                MiniNavbar({ className: "bv3-bazaar-tabs", items: [
                    { text: "Blooks", icon: "fas fa-user", active: true, onClick: (e) => setMode("blooks", e) },
                    { text: "Items", icon: "fas fa-box", onClick: (e) => setMode("items", e) }
                ] }),
                scroller);
            picker.firstChild.style.width = "100%";
            picker.firstChild.style.boxSizing = "border-box";
            function setMode(next, e) {
                mode = next;
                for (const item of picker.firstChild.children) item.dataset.active = String(item === e.currentTarget);
                drawPicker();
            }
            drawPicker();

            root.append(searchBox, h("div", { class: [s.auctionHouseContainer, "bv3-m-stack"], style: { flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "center", gap: "15px", padding: "0 2.5%", boxSizing: "border-box" } },
                picker,
                h("div", { class: s.auctionHouse, style: { flex: 1, width: "auto" } }, items)));
            load();
        }

        PAGES["/bazaar"] = { topRight: ["tokens"], pageHeader: "Bazaar", render };
    })();

    (() => {
        const ROW_HEIGHT = 84;
        const BLOCK = 100;

        if (here() === "/panel/audit") {
            const open = XMLHttpRequest.prototype.open, send = XMLHttpRequest.prototype.send;
            XMLHttpRequest.prototype.open = function (method, url, ...rest) {
                this.bv3Audit = String(url).includes("/worker/staff/audit/");
                return open.call(this, method, url, ...rest);
            };
            XMLHttpRequest.prototype.send = function (...args) {
                if (!this.bv3Audit) return send.apply(this, args);
            };
        }

        function auditEngine(post, listen) {
            const MAX_ENTRIES = 400000, READ_BATCH = 5000, SYNC_PAGES = 40, FIRST_PAGES = 4, LIVE_EVERY = 60000;
            const interned = new Map();
            const intern = (s) => { if (interned.has(s)) return interned.get(s); interned.set(s, s); return s; };
            const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));

            let db = null, origin = "", uid = "", stopped = false, visible = true;
            let entries = [], seen = new Set(), unsorted = false;
            let lastQuery = { id: 0 }, matches = new Int32Array(0), changed = false;
            const log = { total: 0, pages: 0, pageSize: 0, walked: 1, walkedTotal: 0, complete: false };
            let backfilling = false, backfillError = "", phase = "Opening saved log...", syncedAt = 0, requestMs = 0, walking = false;
            let serverSearch = null;

            const status = () => post({ t: "status", saved: entries.length, total: log.total, pages: log.pages, pageSize: log.pageSize, walked: log.walked, complete: log.complete,
                backfilling, backfillError, phase, syncedAt, requestMs, full: entries.length >= MAX_ENTRIES, serverSearch });

            const hash = (s) => {
                let a = 0xdeadbeef, b = 0x41c6ce57;
                for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) {
                    const c = s.charCodeAt(i);
                    a = Math.imul(a ^ c, 2654435761);
                    b = Math.imul(b ^ c, 1597334677);
                }
                a = Math.imul(a ^ (a >>> 16), 2246822507) ^ Math.imul(b ^ (b >>> 13), 3266489909);
                b = Math.imul(b ^ (b >>> 16), 2246822507) ^ Math.imul(a ^ (a >>> 13), 3266489909);
                return 4294967296 * (2097151 & b) + (a >>> 0);
            };
            const done = (request) => new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
                request.onsuccess = () => resolve(request.result);
                request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
            });
            const finished = (tx) => new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
                tx.oncomplete = resolve;
                tx.onerror = tx.onabort = () => reject(tx.error);
            });
            async function openDb() {
                try {
                    const request = indexedDB.open(`bv3-audit-${uid}`, 1);
                    request.onupgradeneeded = () => {
                        request.result.createObjectStore("entries", { keyPath: ["d", "k"] });
                        request.result.createObjectStore("meta");
                    };
                    db = await done(request);
                    db.onversionchange = () => db?.close();
                    Object.assign(log, await done(db.transaction("meta").objectStore("meta").get("log")) || {});
                } catch { db = null; }
            }
            const saveMeta = () => db && db.transaction("meta", "readwrite").objectStore("meta").put({ ...log }, "log");

            function readBatch(before, count) {
                return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
                    const range = before ? IDBKeyRange.upperBound(before, true) : null;
                    const request = db.transaction("entries").objectStore("entries").openCursor(range, "prev");
                    const rows = [];
                    request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
                    request.onsuccess = () => {
                        const cursor = request.result;
                        if (!cursor) return resolve(rows);
                        rows.push(cursor.value);
                        rows.length < count ? cursor.continue() : resolve(rows);
                    };
                });
            }
            async function loadSaved() {
                if (!db) return;
                let before = null, count = 200;
                while (!stopped && db && entries.length < MAX_ENTRIES) {
                    const rows = await readBatch(before, count).catch(() => []);
                    if (!rows.length) break;
                    for (const row of rows) if (!seen.has(row.k)) {
                        seen.add(row.k);
                        entries.push({ d: row.d, k: row.k, a: intern(row.a), b: intern(row.b), u: intern(row.u), n: intern(row.n), v: intern(row.v), r: row.r });
                    }
                    before = [rows[rows.length - 1].d, rows[rows.length - 1].k];
                    count = READ_BATCH;
                    phase = `Reading saved log... ${entries.length.toLocaleString()}`;
                    unsorted = true;
                    refresh();
                    status();
                    await sleep(0);
                }
            }

            function merge(rows) {
                const fresh = [];
                for (const raw of rows) {
                    const a = String(raw.action?.[0] ?? ""), b = String(raw.action?.[1] ?? ""), u = String(raw.user?.id ?? ""), r = String(raw.reason ?? ""), d = Number(raw.date) || 0;
                    const k = hash(`${d}|${u}|${a}|${b}|${r}`);
                    if (seen.has(k)) continue;
                    seen.add(k);
                    const entry = { d, k, a: intern(a), b: intern(b), u: intern(u), n: intern(String(raw.user?.username ?? "")), v: intern(String(raw.user?.avatar ?? "")), r };
                    fresh.push(entry);
                    if (entries.length < MAX_ENTRIES) entries.push(entry);
                }
                if (fresh.length) {
                    unsorted = true;
                    changed = true;
                    const toSave = fresh.filter((entry) => !(entry.a === "users" && entry.b === "new_ip"));
                    for (let i = 0; db && i < toSave.length; i += 2000) {
                        const store = db.transaction("entries", "readwrite").objectStore("entries");
                        for (const entry of toSave.slice(i, i + 2000)) store.put(entry);
                    }
                }
                return fresh.length;
            }

            async function fetchPage(page, filter = {}) {
                const params = `action=${filter.action ? encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(filter.action)) : "undefined"}&user=${encodeURIComponent(filter.user ?? "undefined")}&search=${encodeURIComponent(filter.search ?? "undefined")}`;
                const started = Date.now();
                const abort = new AbortController();
                const timer = setTimeout(() => abort.abort(), 120000);
                try {
                    const res = await fetch(`${origin}/worker/staff/audit/${page}?${params}`, { credentials: "include", signal: abort.signal });
                    if (res.status === 429) return { retry: true, wait: (Number(res.headers.get("retry-after")) || 60) * 1000, reason: "Blacket asked us to slow down." };
                    const text = await res.text();
                    let data;
                    try { data = JSON.parse(text); } catch { return { retry: true, wait: 5000, reason: "Blacket is busy right now." }; }
                    requestMs = Date.now() - started;
                    if (data.error) {
                        if (!/rate|slow|too many|busy|try again|wait|later/i.test(String(data.reason))) return { denied: true, reason: data.reason };
                        return { retry: true, wait: 5000, reason: data.reason };
                    }
                    return { data };
                } catch {
                    return { retry: true, wait: 5000, reason: "Couldn't reach Blacket." };
                } finally { clearTimeout(timer); }
            }
            async function deny(reason) {
                if (stopped) return;
                stopped = true;
                entries = [];
                matches = new Int32Array(0);
                await wipe();
                post({ t: "denied", reason: String(reason || "You don't have access to the audit log.") });
            }
            function note(data) {
                const moved = log.total && data.total > log.total && log.pageSize ? Math.floor((data.total - log.total) / log.pageSize) : 0;
                log.walked += moved;
                log.total = Number(data.total) || 0;
                log.pages = Number(data.pages) || 1;
                if (data.page === 1 && data.audit?.length) log.pageSize = data.audit.length;
            }

            async function sync(first) {
                const limit = entries.length ? SYNC_PAGES : FIRST_PAGES;
                for (let page = 1; page <= limit && !stopped; page++) {
                    phase = page === 1 ? "Checking for new entries..." : `Catching up... page ${page}`;
                    status();
                    const { data, denied, retry, reason } = await (page === 1 && first || fetchPage(page));
                    if (denied) return deny(reason);
                    if (retry) { phase = reason; status(); return; }
                    note(data);
                    const fresh = merge(data.audit || []);
                    if (page >= (log.walked || 1)) log.walked = page;
                    refresh();
                    if (fresh < (data.audit?.length || 0) || page >= log.pages) break;
                    if (page === limit) log.complete = false;
                    await sleep(300);
                }
                if (log.walked >= log.pages && log.pages) log.complete = true;
                syncedAt = Date.now();
                phase = "";
                saveMeta();
                status();
            }

            async function walk() {
                if (walking || log.complete || entries.length >= MAX_ENTRIES) return true;
                walking = true;
                try {
                    const page = log.walked + 1;
                    const { data, denied, retry, wait, reason } = await fetchPage(page);
                    if (denied) { await deny(reason); return false; }
                    if (retry) return { wait, reason };
                    note(data);
                    merge(data.audit || []);
                    log.walked = Math.max(log.walked, page);
                    if (log.walked >= log.pages) log.complete = true;
                    saveMeta();
                    refresh();
                    status();
                    return true;
                } finally { walking = false; }
            }

            async function backfill() {
                let delay = 5000, failures = 0;
                while (backfilling && !stopped && !log.complete && entries.length < MAX_ENTRIES) {
                    if (!visible) { await sleep(1000); continue; }
                    const result = await walk();
                    if (result === false) return;
                    if (result?.wait) {
                        if (++failures >= 6) { backfillError = result.reason; break; }
                        backfillError = `${result.reason} Trying again soon.`;
                        status();
                        await sleep(Math.max(result.wait, delay));
                        delay = Math.min(delay * 2, 120000);
                        continue;
                    }
                    failures = 0;
                    delay = 5000;
                    backfillError = "";
                    await sleep(Math.max(500, requestMs * 2));
                }
                backfilling = false;
                status();
            }

            function when(value, endOfDay) {
                const ago = /^(\d+)([hdw])$/.exec(value);
                if (ago) return Date.now() - Number(ago[1]) * { h: 3600000, d: 86400000, w: 604800000 }[ago[2]];
                const date = Date.parse(value);
                if (Number.isNaN(date)) return null;
                return endOfDay && /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(value) ? date + 86399999 : date;
            }
            function parse(text) {
                const tests = [], words = [], server = { words: [] };
                for (const [, neg, key, quoted, plain] of String(text || "").matchAll(/(-?)(?:([a-z]+):)?(?:"([^"]*)"|(\S+))/gi)) {
                    const value = (quoted ?? plain).toLowerCase(), name = key?.toLowerCase();
                    if (!value) continue;
                    const add = (test) => tests.push(neg ? (e, hay) => !test(e, hay) : test);
                    if (name === "user" || name === "from") { add((e) => e.n.toLowerCase().includes(value)); if (!neg) { words.push(value); server.user = quoted ?? plain; } }
                    else if (name === "id") { add((e) => e.u.toLowerCase().startsWith(value)); if (!neg) server.user = quoted ?? plain; }
                    else if (name === "action" || name === "cat") add((e) => `${e.a}/${e.b}`.toLowerCase().includes(value));
                    else if (name === "after" || name === "since") { const at = when(value); if (at != null) add((e) => e.d >= at); }
                    else if (name === "before" || name === "until") { const at = when(value, true); if (at != null) add((e) => e.d <= at); }
                    else if (name === "on") { const from = when(value), to = when(value, true); if (from != null) add((e) => e.d >= from && e.d <= to); }
                    else {
                        const word = key ? `${name}:${value}` : value;
                        add((e, hay) => hay.includes(word));
                        if (!neg) { words.push(word); server.words.push(quoted ?? plain); }
                    }
                }
                return { tests, words, server };
            }
            function runQuery(query) {
                lastQuery = query;
                if (unsorted) { entries.sort((a, b) => b.d - a.d); unsorted = false; }
                const { tests, words } = parse(query.text);
                const from = query.after ? when(query.after) : null, to = query.before ? when(query.before, true) : null;
                const found = new Int32Array(entries.length), facets = {};
                let count = 0;
                for (let i = 0; i < entries.length; i++) {
                    const e = entries[i];
                    if ((from != null && e.d < from) || (to != null && e.d > to)) continue;
                    if (tests.length) {
                        const hay = `${e.n} ${e.u} ${e.a}/${e.b} ${e.r}`.toLowerCase();
                        if (!tests.every((test) => test(e, hay))) continue;
                    }
                    if (query.action) { if (e.a !== query.cat || e.b !== query.action) continue; }
                    facets[e.a] = (facets[e.a] || 0) + 1;
                    if (query.cat && e.a !== query.cat) continue;
                    found[count++] = i;
                }
                matches = found.subarray(0, count);
                if (query.order === "oldest") matches.reverse();
                post({ t: "result", id: query.id, count, facets, words });
            }
            let refreshTimer = null;
            function refresh() {
                if (refreshTimer) return;
                refreshTimer = setTimeout(() => {
                    refreshTimer = null;
                    if (lastQuery.id) runQuery(lastQuery);
                }, 400);
            }
            const view = (e) => ({ d: e.d, a: e.a, b: e.b, u: e.u, n: e.n, v: e.v, r: e.r });

            async function searchServer(query) {
                const { server } = parse(query.text);
                const same = serverSearch?.key === JSON.stringify([query.text, query.cat, query.action]);
                const page = same ? serverSearch.page + 1 : 1;
                const filter = { search: server.words.join(" ") || undefined, user: server.user, action: query.cat ? (query.action ? [query.cat, query.action] : [query.cat]) : undefined };
                if (filter.user) {
                    const found = await fetch(`${origin}/worker2/user/${encodeURIComponent(filter.user)}`, { credentials: "include" }).then((r) => r.json()).catch(() => null);
                    if (found?.user?.id != null) filter.user = found.user.id;
                }
                serverSearch = { key: JSON.stringify([query.text, query.cat, query.action]), page: page - 1, pages: serverSearch?.pages, total: serverSearch?.total, busy: true };
                status();
                const { data, denied, retry, reason } = await fetchPage(page, filter);
                if (denied) return deny(reason);
                serverSearch.busy = false;
                if (retry) serverSearch.error = reason;
                else {
                    merge(data.audit || []);
                    Object.assign(serverSearch, { page, pages: Number(data.pages) || 1, total: Number(data.total) || 0, error: "" });
                    refresh();
                }
                status();
            }

            function exportCsv(id) {
                const cell = (value) => {
                    const text = String(value);
                    const safe = /^[=+\-@\t\r]/.test(text) ? `'${text}` : text;
                    return `"${safe.replace(/"/g, "\"\"")}"`;
                };
                const parts = ["date,category,action,username,user id,reason\n"];
                for (let i = 0; i < matches.length; i += 5000) {
                    let chunk = "";
                    for (const at of matches.subarray(i, i + 5000)) {
                        const e = entries[at];
                        chunk += [new Date(e.d).toISOString(), e.a, e.b, e.n, e.u, e.r].map(cell).join(",") + "\n";
                    }
                    parts.push(chunk);
                }
                post({ t: "csv", id, blob: new Blob(parts, { type: "text/csv" }), count: matches.length });
            }

            async function wipe() {
                db?.close();
                db = null;
                await done(indexedDB.deleteDatabase(`bv3-audit-${uid}`)).catch(() => { });
            }

            async function start() {
                await openDb();
                const first = fetchPage(1);
                first.then((result) => { if (result.denied) deny(result.reason); });
                await loadSaved();
                if (stopped) return;
                await sync(first);
                while (!stopped) {
                    await sleep(LIVE_EVERY);
                    if (visible && !backfilling && requestMs < 10000) await sync();
                }
            }

            listen(async (m) => {
                if (m.t === "init") { origin = m.origin; uid = m.uid; start(); }
                else if (m.t === "query") runQuery(m.query);
                else if (m.t === "rows") {
                    if (unsorted) { entries.sort((a, b) => b.d - a.d); unsorted = false; runQuery(lastQuery); }
                    const rows = [];
                    for (const at of matches.subarray(m.start, m.start + m.count)) rows.push(view(entries[at]));
                    post({ t: "rows", id: m.id, start: m.start, rows });
                }
                else if (m.t === "more") { const result = await walk(); if (result?.wait) { phase = result.reason; status(); } }
                else if (m.t === "backfill") { backfilling = m.on; backfillError = ""; status(); if (m.on) backfill(); }
                else if (m.t === "server") searchServer(m.query);
                else if (m.t === "export") exportCsv(m.id);
                else if (m.t === "visible") visible = m.on;
                else if (m.t === "stop") stopped = true;
                else if (m.t === "clear") {
                    backfilling = false;
                    await wipe();
                    entries = [];
                    seen = new Set();
                    matches = new Int32Array(0);
                    Object.assign(log, { total: 0, pages: 0, pageSize: 0, walked: 1, walkedTotal: 0, complete: false });
                    await openDb();
                    refresh();
                    await sync();
                }
            });
        }

        function startEngine(onMessage) {
            let worker = null, send;
            const onPage = () => {
                const listeners = [];
                auditEngine((m) => setTimeout(() => onMessage(m)), (fn) => listeners.push(fn));
                send = (m) => setTimeout(() => listeners.forEach((fn) => fn(m)));
            };
            const init = { t: "init", origin: location.origin, uid: String(me().id) };
            try {
                const url = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([`(${auditEngine.toString()})((m) => postMessage(m), (fn) => { onmessage = (e) => fn(e.data); });`], { type: "text/javascript" }));
                worker = new Worker(url);
                URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
                worker.onmessage = (e) => onMessage(e.data);
                worker.onerror = (e) => {
                    console.error("[V3 skin] audit worker", e.message);
                    worker?.terminate();
                    worker = null;
                    onPage();
                    send(init);
                };
                send = (m) => worker?.postMessage(m);
            } catch {
                onPage();
            }
            send(init);
            return { send: (m) => send(m), stop: () => { send({ t: "stop" }); worker?.terminate(); } };
        }

        const HELP = "Words must all match. \"quotes\" for exact phrases, -word to exclude. Also user:name id:123 action:trades action:bazaar/bought after:2026-01-01 before:2026-02-01 on:2026-01-15 after:7d";

        function highlighted(text, words) {
            const lower = text.toLowerCase();
            const spots = [];
            for (const word of words) for (let at = lower.indexOf(word); at >= 0; at = lower.indexOf(word, at + word.length)) spots.push([at, at + word.length]);
            if (!spots.length) return [text];
            spots.sort((a, b) => a[0] - b[0]);
            const parts = [];
            let last = 0;
            for (const [from, to] of spots) {
                if (from < last) continue;
                parts.push(text.slice(last, from), h("mark", { style: { background: "rgba(255, 216, 77, 0.35)", color: "inherit", borderRadius: "3px" } }, text.slice(from, to)));
                last = to;
            }
            parts.push(text.slice(last));
            return parts;
        }

        function render(root) {
            let queryId = 0, rowCount = 0, words = [], blocks = new Map(), pending = new Set(), asking = false, stats = {}, drawQueued = false;
            const query = { text: "", cat: "", action: "", after: "", before: "", order: "newest" };

            const field = { background: "var(--background-color)", color: "var(--accent-color)", border: "none", borderRadius: "var(--border-radius)", padding: "7px 10px", fontSize: "15px", fontFamily: "var(--paragraph-font)", colorScheme: "dark" };
            const statusLine = h("div", { style: { fontSize: "15px", opacity: 0.8, minHeight: "20px" } });
            const bar = h("div", { style: { height: "100%", width: "0%", background: "var(--accent-color)", borderRadius: "4px", transition: "width 0.3s" } });
            const barHolder = h("div", { style: { height: "6px", borderRadius: "4px", background: "rgba(var(--white), 0.1)", overflow: "hidden", display: "none" } }, bar);
            const actionsHolder = h("div", { style: { display: "flex", gap: "8px", flexWrap: "wrap", alignItems: "center" } });
            const facetHolder = h("div", { style: { display: "flex", gap: "6px", flexWrap: "wrap" } });
            const spacer = h("div", { style: { position: "relative" } });
            const list = h("div", { class: "bv3-audit-list", style: { flex: 1, minHeight: 0, overflowY: "auto", overflowX: "hidden", position: "relative", background: "var(--primary-color)", borderRadius: "var(--border-radius)" } }, spacer);

            const engine = startEngine((m) => {
                if (m.t === "status") { stats = m; drawStatus(); }
                else if (m.t === "result" && m.id === queryId) {
                    rowCount = m.count;
                    words = m.words;
                    blocks = new Map();
                    pending = new Set();
                    spacer.style.height = `${rowCount * ROW_HEIGHT}px`;
                    drawFacets(m.facets);
                    drawStatus();
                    drawRows();
                }
                else if (m.t === "rows" && m.id === queryId) {
                    pending.delete(m.start);
                    blocks.set(m.start, m.rows);
                    if (blocks.size > 30) blocks.delete(blocks.keys().next().value);
                    drawRows();
                }
                else if (m.t === "csv") {
                    const link = h("a", { href: URL.createObjectURL(m.blob), download: `blacket-audit-${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.csv` });
                    link.click();
                    setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(link.href), 60000);
                    success(`Exported ${m.count.toLocaleString()} entries.`);
                }
                else if (m.t === "denied") {
                    list.replaceChildren(ErrorContainer(m.reason));
                    actionsHolder.replaceChildren();
                    statusLine.textContent = "";
                }
            });

            const search = () => engine.send({ t: "query", query: { ...query, id: ++queryId } });
            const newSearch = () => { list.scrollTop = 0; search(); };

            const rowAt = (i) => blocks.get(i - i % BLOCK)?.[i % BLOCK];
            function Row(entry, i) {
                const box = { position: "absolute", top: `${i * ROW_HEIGHT}px`, left: "0", right: "0", height: `${ROW_HEIGHT - 6}px`, boxSizing: "border-box", display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: "12px", padding: "6px 12px", overflow: "hidden" };
                if (!entry) return h("div", { style: { ...box, opacity: 0.3 } }, "...");
                const date = new Date(entry.d);
                return h("div", { class: "bv3-audit-row", style: box, onclick: () => detail(entry) },
                    h("img", { src: `/content/icons/audit/${encodeURIComponent(entry.a)}/${encodeURIComponent(entry.b)}.webp`, draggable: "false", style: { width: "42px", height: "42px", objectFit: "contain", flexShrink: 0 }, onerror: function () { this.style.visibility = "hidden"; } }),
                    h("div", { style: { flex: 1, minWidth: 0 } },
                        h("div", { style: { display: "flex", gap: "8px", alignItems: "center", fontSize: "17px", fontWeight: 700, whiteSpace: "nowrap" } },
                            h("span", { style: { overflow: "hidden", textOverflow: "ellipsis" } }, highlighted(entry.n, words)),
                            h("span", { style: { fontSize: "13px", fontWeight: 400, opacity: 0.55 } }, `${entry.a} / ${entry.b}`)),
                        h("div", { style: { fontSize: "15px", opacity: 0.85, overflow: "hidden", textOverflow: "ellipsis", whiteSpace: "nowrap" } }, highlighted(entry.r, words)),
                        h("div", { style: { fontSize: "13px", opacity: 0.5 } }, `${formatDuration(Math.max(0, Date.now() - entry.d))} ago, ${date.toLocaleString()}`)));
            }
            function drawRows() {
                if (drawQueued) return;
                drawQueued = true;
                requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                    drawQueued = false;
                    const first = Math.max(0, Math.floor(list.scrollTop / ROW_HEIGHT) - 5);
                    const last = Math.min(rowCount, Math.ceil((list.scrollTop + list.clientHeight) / ROW_HEIGHT) + 5);
                    const rows = [];
                    for (let i = first; i < last; i++) {
                        const start = i - i % BLOCK;
                        if (!blocks.has(start) && !pending.has(start)) {
                            pending.add(start);
                            engine.send({ t: "rows", id: queryId, start, count: BLOCK });
                        }
                        rows.push(Row(rowAt(i), i));
                    }
                    spacer.replaceChildren(...rows);
                    const unfiltered = !query.text && !query.cat && !query.after && !query.before && query.order === "newest";
                    if (unfiltered && last >= rowCount - 20 && stats.total && !stats.complete && !stats.backfilling && !asking) {
                        asking = true;
                        engine.send({ t: "more" });
                        setTimeout(() => (asking = false), 1500);
                    }
                });
            }
            list.addEventListener("scroll", drawRows, { passive: true });
            const resize = new ResizeObserver(drawRows);
            resize.observe(list);

            function detail(entry) {
                const line = (label, value) => h("div", { style: { display: "flex", gap: "10px", textAlign: "left" } }, h("b", { style: { minWidth: "80px", flexShrink: 0 } }, label), h("span", { style: { wordBreak: "break-word" } }, value));
                const close = openModal(ModalHeader(`${entry.a} / ${entry.b}`),
                    ModalBody(h("div", { style: { width: "min(600px, 85vw)", display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: "8px", fontSize: "17px" } },
                        h("div", { style: { display: "flex", gap: "10px", alignItems: "center" } }, h("div", { style: { width: "40px", height: "46px" } }, Blook({ src: entry.v || DEFAULT_AVATAR })), h("b", null, entry.n)),
                        line("User ID", entry.u), line("What", entry.r), line("When", new Date(entry.d).toLocaleString()), line("Action", `${entry.a} / ${entry.b}`))),
                    ModalButtons(
                        GenericButton({ icon: "fas fa-filter", onClick: () => { close(); input.value = `id:${entry.u}`; query.text = input.value; newSearch(); } }, "This User"),
                        GenericButton({ icon: "fas fa-user", onClick: () => { close(); go(`/stats?name=${encodeURIComponent(entry.n)}`); } }, "Profile"),
                        GenericButton({ icon: "fas fa-copy", onClick: () => { navigator.clipboard.writeText(`${new Date(entry.d).toISOString()} ${entry.n} (${entry.u}) ${entry.a}/${entry.b}: ${entry.r}`); success("Copied."); } }, "Copy"),
                        GenericButton({ onClick: () => close() }, "Close")));
            }

            function drawFacets(facets) {
                const sorted = Object.entries(facets).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]);
                facetHolder.replaceChildren(...sorted.map(([name, count]) => h("div", {
                    role: "button",
                    style: { padding: "3px 10px", borderRadius: "var(--border-radius)", cursor: "pointer", fontSize: "14px", fontWeight: 700, background: query.cat === name ? "var(--accent-color)" : "rgba(var(--white), 0.08)", color: query.cat === name ? "var(--background-color)" : null },
                    onclick: () => { query.cat = query.cat === name ? "" : name; query.action = ""; newSearch(); }
                }, `${name} ${count.toLocaleString()}`)));
            }

            function drawStatus() {
                const { saved = 0, total = 0, complete, backfilling, backfillError, phase, walked = 0, pages = 0, requestMs = 0, full, serverSearch } = stats;
                const parts = [`${rowCount.toLocaleString()} shown`, `${saved.toLocaleString()} saved`];
                if (total) parts.push(`${total.toLocaleString()} on Blacket`);
                if (phase) parts.push(phase);
                else if (stats.syncedAt) parts.push(`checked ${new Date(stats.syncedAt).toLocaleTimeString()}`);
                if (backfillError) parts.push(backfillError);
                if (full) parts.push("saved copy is full");
                statusLine.textContent = parts.join("  ·  ");

                barHolder.style.display = backfilling ? "" : "none";
                if (pages) bar.style.width = `${Math.min(100, walked / pages * 100)}%`;

                const left = Math.max(0, pages - walked);
                const minutes = Math.ceil(left * Math.max(0.5, requestMs * 3 / 1000) / 60);
                const searched = query.text || query.cat;
                actionsHolder.replaceChildren(...[
                    !complete && total > 0 && !full && GenericButton({ icon: backfilling ? "fas fa-pause" : "fas fa-download", onClick: () => (backfilling ? engine.send({ t: "backfill", on: false }) : confirmDownload(left, minutes)) },
                        backfilling ? `Pause (${Math.round(walked / pages * 100)}%, about ${minutes} min left)` : "Download Full Log"),
                    searched && !complete && GenericButton({ icon: "fas fa-magnifying-glass", onClick: () => engine.send({ t: "server", query: { ...query } }) },
                        serverSearch?.busy ? "Searching Blacket..." : serverSearch?.page && serverSearch.page < serverSearch.pages ? `Get More From Blacket (${serverSearch.total.toLocaleString()} matches)` : "Search All Of Blacket"),
                    GenericButton({ icon: "fas fa-file-csv", onClick: () => engine.send({ t: "export", id: queryId }) }, "Export"),
                    saved > 0 && GenericButton({ icon: "fas fa-trash", onClick: () => confirmModal("Clear Saved Log", "Delete the copy of the audit log saved in this browser? It downloads again from Blacket.", () => engine.send({ t: "clear" })) }, "Clear Saved")
                ].filter(Boolean));
            }
            const confirmDownload = (left, minutes) => confirmModal("Download Full Log",
                `This fetches ${left.toLocaleString()} more pages from Blacket, one at a time, which takes about ${minutes} minutes. It pauses while this tab is hidden, and you can stop any time and pick up later. After that, search covers everything.`,
                () => engine.send({ t: "backfill", on: true }));

            const input = h("input", { placeholder: "Search... user:name action:trades after:7d -word \"exact phrase\"", style: { ...field, flex: 1, minWidth: "0", fontSize: "17px" } });
            let typing = null;
            input.addEventListener("input", () => {
                clearTimeout(typing);
                typing = setTimeout(() => { query.text = input.value; newSearch(); }, 150);
            });
            input.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
                if (e.key !== "Enter" || !input.value.trim() || stats.complete) return;
                query.text = input.value;
                engine.send({ t: "server", query: { ...query } });
            });
            const dateField = (label, key) => h("label", { style: { display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: "6px", fontSize: "14px", opacity: 0.85 } }, label,
                h("input", { type: "date", style: field, onchange: (e) => { query[key] = e.target.value; newSearch(); } }));
            const orderButton = h("div", { class: "bv3-picker-back", style: { width: "auto", padding: "0 10px", gap: "6px", fontSize: "14px", fontWeight: 700 }, onclick: () => {
                query.order = query.order === "newest" ? "oldest" : "newest";
                orderButton.lastChild.textContent = query.order === "newest" ? "Newest" : "Oldest";
                newSearch();
            } }, h("i", { class: "fas fa-arrow-down-wide-short" }), h("span", null, "Newest"));

            const visibility = () => engine.send({ t: "visible", on: document.visibilityState === "visible" });
            document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", visibility);

            root.append(h("div", { class: "bv3-audit", style: { display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: "8px", height: "100vh", padding: "14px 2% 14px", boxSizing: "border-box" } },
                h("div", { style: { display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: "12px" } },
                    tooltip(h("a", { class: "bv3-picker-back", href: "/panel" }, h("i", { class: "fas fa-reply" })), "Back to Panel"),
                    h("div", { style: { fontFamily: "var(--heading-font)", fontSize: "34px" } }, "Audit Log")),
                h("div", { style: { display: "flex", gap: "8px", alignItems: "center" } }, input, tooltip(h("i", { class: "fas fa-circle-question", style: { opacity: 0.6, cursor: "help" } }), HELP)),
                h("div", { style: { display: "flex", gap: "10px", alignItems: "center", flexWrap: "wrap" } }, dateField("From", "after"), dateField("To", "before"), orderButton),
                facetHolder, statusLine, barHolder, list, actionsHolder));
            search();
            drawStatus();
            return () => {
                clearTimeout(typing);
                resize.disconnect();
                document.removeEventListener("visibilitychange", visibility);
                engine.stop();
            };
        }

        PAGES["/panel/audit"] = { topRight: [], render };
    })();

    (() => {
        const GLOBAL_ROOM = 0;

        const perms = (user) => user?.permissions || user?.perms || [];
        const can = (user, perm) => perms(user).includes(perm) || perms(user).includes("*");

        const views = new Set();
        onSocket((msg) => {
            for (const view of views) {
                try { view.onSocket(msg); } catch (err) { console.error("[V3 skin]", err); }
            }
            mentionToast(msg);
        });

        function mentionToast({ event, data }) {
            const self = me();
            if (event !== "messages-create" || !data?.message || !self || String(data.author?.id) === String(self.id)) return;
            const content = String(data.message.content || "");
            if (!(data.message.mentions || []).map(String).includes(String(self.id)) && !content.includes(`<@${self.id}>`)) return;
            const room = String(data.room?.id ?? "");
            if (plugin("mentionSound")) ding();
            if ([...views].some((v) => v.room === room && v.visible())) return;
            remember(data.author);
            const text = (parseReply(content)?.rest ?? content)
                .replace(/<@([0-9A-Za-z-]+)>/g, (m, id) => `@${userById(id)?.username || "user"}`)
                .replace(/<\/?[^>]+>/g, "");
            toast({
                header: `${data.author.username} mentioned you`, body: text.slice(0, 140), icon: blookPath(data.author.avatar), expires: 8000,
                onClick: () => room === String(GLOBAL_ROOM) ? showView("chat") : go("/clans/my-clan")
            });
        }

        let audio;
        function ding() {
            try {
                audio ??= new AudioContext();
                [880, 1320].forEach((freq, i) => {
                    const osc = audio.createOscillator(), gain = audio.createGain();
                    const at = audio.currentTime + i * 0.12;
                    osc.frequency.value = freq;
                    gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.15, at);
                    gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, at + 0.25);
                    osc.connect(gain).connect(audio.destination);
                    osc.start(at);
                    osc.stop(at + 0.25);
                });
            } catch { }
        }

        const filteredWords = () => String(pluginValue("filterWords", "")).split(",").map((w) => w.trim().toLowerCase()).filter(Boolean);
        const isFiltered = (content) => plugin("wordFilter") && filteredWords().some((w) => String(content).toLowerCase().includes(w));

        const SAVED_KEY = "bv3:savedMessages";
        const savedMessages = () => { try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(SAVED_KEY)) || []; } catch { return []; } };
        const storeSaved = (list) => { try { localStorage.setItem(SAVED_KEY, JSON.stringify(list.slice(0, 1000))); } catch { } };
        function saveMessage(data) {
            const list = savedMessages();
            if (list.some((m) => String(m.id) === String(data.message.id))) return toast({ header: "Saved Messages", body: "You already saved that message.", icon: "fas fa-bookmark" });
            const a = data.author || {};
            list.unshift({ id: data.message.id, content: data.message.content, date: data.message.date, author: { id: a.id, username: a.username, avatar: a.avatar, color: a.color } });
            storeSaved(list);
            success("Message saved. Find it under the bookmark button in chat.");
        }
        function savedModal(authorId) {
            const s = S("views/Chat/chat");
            const body = h("div", { style: { display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: "10px", width: "min(640px, 85vw)", maxHeight: "60vh", overflowY: "auto", textAlign: "left" } });
            const draw = () => {
                const list = savedMessages().filter((m) => !authorId || String(m.author.id) === String(authorId));
                body.replaceChildren(...(list.length ? list.map((m) => h("div", { style: { display: "flex", gap: "10px", padding: "8px 10px", borderRadius: "var(--border-radius)", background: "rgba(var(--black), 0.2)" } },
                    h("div", { style: { width: "40px", height: "46px", flexShrink: 0 } }, Blook({ src: blookPath(m.author.avatar) })),
                    h("div", { style: { flex: 1, minWidth: 0, fontSize: "17px" } },
                        h("div", { style: { display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: "8px" } }, Username({ user: m.author }),
                            h("span", { style: { opacity: 0.5, fontSize: "13px" } }, new Date(typeof m.date === "number" && m.date < 1e12 ? m.date * 1000 : m.date || Date.now()).toLocaleString())),
                        h("div", { class: s.messageContent }, contentEl(parseReply(m.content)?.rest ?? m.content, m.author, s))),
                    tooltip(h("i", { class: "fas fa-trash", style: { cursor: "pointer", color: "#ff6b6b", padding: "4px" }, onclick: () => { storeSaved(savedMessages().filter((x) => String(x.id) !== String(m.id))); draw(); } }), "Remove")))
                    : [h("div", { style: { opacity: 0.6, textAlign: "center" } }, authorId ? "You haven't saved any messages from this user." : "You haven't saved any messages yet. Right click a message to save it.")]));
            };
            draw();
            const close = openModal(ModalHeader("Saved Messages"), ModalBody(body), ModalButtons(GenericButton({ onClick: () => close() }, "Close")));
        }

        const known = new Map();
        const remember = (user) => {
            if (user?.id == null || user.id === 0) return;
            known.set(String(user.id), user);
