            known.set(`@${String(user.username).toLowerCase()}`, user);
            const cache = v2().chat?.cached?.users;
            if (cache) cache[user.id] = user;
        };
        const userById = (id) => known.get(String(id)) || v2().chat?.cached?.users?.[id];
        const lookupUser = (id) => userById(id) ? Promise.resolve(userById(id)) : getUser(id).then((u) => (remember(u), u));

        const esc = (s) => String(s).replace(/&/g, "&amp;").replace(/</g, "&lt;").replace(/>/g, "&gt;").replace(/"/g, "&quot;").replace(/'/g, "&#39;");
        const COLOR = "black|lime|pink|hotpink|white|brown|magenta|cyan|turquoise|red|orange|yellow|green|blue|purple|\\#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}";
        const COLOR_TAG = new RegExp(`&lt;(gradient=\\[(?:up|down|left|right|\\d{1,3}deg)(?: |):(?: |)(?:(?:(?:${COLOR})(?:, |,| ,| , |)){2,7})\\]|${COLOR})&gt;(.+?)&lt;\\/([^&]+?)&gt;`, "gs");
        const FILE_TYPES = ["pdf", "txt", "zip", "rar", "7z", "json", "js", "ts", "py", "html", "css", "csv", "md", "doc", "docx", "xls", "xlsx", "ppt", "pptx", "exe", "apk"];
        const URL_RE = /(?:http|https):\/\/([^ \n@<]+(\/|)|[^ \n@<]+\.(jpeg|jpg|png|webp|gif|mp4|webm|mov))/g;
        const TRUSTED_HOSTS = [location.host, "cdn.discordapp.com", "media.discordapp.net", "images-ext-1.discordapp.net", "media.discord.com", "s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com", "f005.backblazeb2.com"];

        let blooksByName = null;
        function formatContent(raw, author, s) {
            let m = esc(raw);
            m = m.replace(/\*\*\*([^*]+)\*\*\*/g, "<b><i>$1</i></b>")
                .replace(/\*\*([^*]+)\*\*/g, "<b>$1</b>")
                .replace(/\*([^*]+)\*/g, "<i>$1</i>")
                .replace(/~~([^~]+)~~/g, "<s>$1</s>")
                .replace(/__([^_]+)__/g, "<u>$1</u>");

            const emojis = v2().emojis || {};
            m = m.replace(/:([A-Za-z0-9_+-]+?):/g, (match, name) => {
                if (emojis[name]) return `<img loading="lazy" class="${s.emoji}" src="${esc(emojis[name].image)}">`;
                const unicode = (v2().emojiNames || []).find((x) => x.shortname === match);
                return unicode ? unicode.emoji : match;
            });

            const hasUrl = URL_RE.test(m);
            URL_RE.lastIndex = 0;
            m = m.replace(COLOR_TAG, (match, color, text) => {
                if (hasUrl || !can(author, "use_chat_colors")) return text;
                if (color.startsWith("gradient=")) {
                    const grad = color.split("=")[1].slice(1, -1).replace(/\s/g, "");
                    const [dir, colors] = grad.split(":");
                    const to = dir === "up" ? "to top" : dir === "down" ? "to bottom" : dir.endsWith("deg") ? dir : `to ${dir}`;
                    return `<span style="background: linear-gradient(${to}, ${colors.split(",").join(", ")}); display: inline-block; -webkit-background-clip: text; background-clip: text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;">${text}</span>`;
                }
                return `<span style="color: ${color};">${text}</span>`;
            });

            m = m.replace(URL_RE, (match, url) => {
                if (!can(author, "use_embeds") || plugin("hideEmbeds")) return `<a href="${match}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">${match}</a>`;
                const host = url.split("/")[0];
                const ext = url.split(".").pop().split("?")[0].toLowerCase();
                const src = TRUSTED_HOSTS.includes(host) ? `https://${url}` : `/worker/proxy/${btoa(`https://${url.split("?")[0]}`)}`;
                if (["jpg", "jpeg", "png", "webp", "gif"].includes(ext)) return `<img loading="lazy" data-embed="1" src="${src}" style="max-height: 300px; max-width: 100%; border-radius: var(--border-radius); display: block; cursor: pointer;">`;
                if (["webm", "mp4", "mov"].includes(ext)) return `<video src="${src}" controls style="max-height: 300px; max-width: 100%; border-radius: var(--border-radius); display: block;"></video>`;
                if (["mp3", "wav", "ogg", "m4a"].includes(ext)) return `<audio src="${src}" controls style="max-width: 100%; display: block;"></audio>`;
                if (TRUSTED_HOSTS.includes(host) && FILE_TYPES.includes(ext)) {
                    const file = decodeURIComponent(url.split("?")[0].split("/").pop() || "file").replace(/^[0-9a-f-]{20,}[_-]/i, "");
                    return `<a class="bv3-file" href="${src}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" download><i class="fas fa-file-lines"></i>${esc(file)}</a>`;
                }
                return `<a href="${match}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">${match}</a>`;
            });

            if (can(author, "use_blook_emojis")) {
                if (!blooksByName) {
                    blooksByName = {};
                    for (const [name, b] of Object.entries(v2().blooks || {})) blooksByName[name.toLowerCase()] = b;
                }
                m = m.replace(/\[([^\]]+)\]/g, (match, name) => {
                    const b = blooksByName[name.toLowerCase()];
                    return b ? `<img loading="lazy" class="${s.emoji}" src="${esc(b.image)}" title="${esc(name)}">` : match;
                });
            }

            m = m.replace(/&lt;@([0-9A-Za-z-]+)&gt;/g, (match, id) => `<span class="mention" data-mention="${id}" style="background: rgba(88, 101, 242, 0.3); border-radius: 3px; padding: 0 2px; cursor: pointer;">@${esc(userById(id)?.username || "user")}</span>`);
            return m;
        }

        function contentEl(raw, author, s) {
            const el = h("span", { html: formatContent(raw, author, s) });
            for (const mention of el.querySelectorAll("[data-mention]")) {
                const id = mention.dataset.mention;
                mention.addEventListener("click", () => lookupUser(id).then((u) => u && go(`/stats?name=${encodeURIComponent(u.username)}`)));
                if (!userById(id)) lookupUser(id).then((u) => u && (mention.textContent = `@${u.username}`));
            }
            for (const img of el.querySelectorAll("img[data-embed]")) img.addEventListener("click", () => window.open(img.src, "_blank"));
            try { window.twemoji?.parse(el, { className: s.emoji, base: "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/twitter/twemoji@14.0.2/assets/" }); } catch { }
            return el;
        }

        const parseReply = (raw) => {
            const match = /^From <@([0-9A-Za-z-]+)>: ([^\n]*)\n?/.exec(raw || "");
            return match ? { id: match[1], quote: match[2], rest: raw.slice(match[0].length) } : null;
        };

        const toDate = (d) => new Date(typeof d === "number" && d < 1e12 ? d * 1000 : d || Date.now());
        const timestamp = (date) => {
            const today = new Date();
            const time = date.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" });
            if (date.toDateString() === today.toDateString()) return `Today at ${time}`;
            if (date.toDateString() === new Date(today.getTime() - 86400000).toDateString()) return `Yesterday at ${time}`;
            return `${date.toLocaleDateString()} ${time}`;
        };

        function badgesOf(author) {
            let list = author.badges;
            if (typeof list === "string") try { list = JSON.parse(list); } catch { list = []; }
            if (!Array.isArray(list)) list = [];
            const all = v2().badges || {};
            return Object.entries(all).filter(([name]) => list.includes(name) || list.includes("*")).map(([name, b]) => ({ name, ...b }));
        }

        async function renderChat(root, { room = GLOBAL_ROOM, name = "global", embedded = false } = {}) {
            const s = S("views/Chat/chat");
            const self = await whenUser();
            await whenData();
            watchSocket();
            const extended = plugin("extendedChat") ? Math.min(5000, Math.max(50, Number(pluginValue("chatLimit", 500)) || 500)) : 0;
            const fetchLimit = extended || 250;
            const drawLimit = extended || 150;

            const list = h("ul", { class: s.messagesContainer, dataset: { aboveInput: "false" }, oncontextmenu: (e) => e.preventDefault() });
            let messages = [];
            let replyingTo = null;
            let editing = null;
            const shownFiltered = new Set();
            let drawQueued = false;

            const Header = (author, date) => h("div", { class: s.usernameContainer, style: { flexWrap: "wrap", rowGap: "0", whiteSpace: "nowrap" } },
                h("a", { href: `/stats?name=${encodeURIComponent(author.username || "")}`, style: { textDecoration: "none" }, oncontextmenu: (e) => userMenu(e, author) },
                    Username({ user: author })),
                NoteTag(author),
                author.clan && h("span", {
                    class: String(author.clan.color).toLowerCase() === "rainbow" ? "rainbow" : null,
                    style: { color: author.clan.color, fontFamily: "\"Quicksand Bold\"" }
                }, `[${author.clan.name}]`),
                badgesOf(author).length > 0 && h("div", { class: s.messageBadgeContainer }, badgesOf(author).map((b) => tooltip(h("img", { class: s.messageBadge, src: b.image }), b.name))),
                h("div", { class: s.messageBigTimestamp }, timestamp(date)));

            function ReplyLine(reply, author) {
                const nameEl = h("span", { class: s.replyingToUsername, style: { fontWeight: 700 } }, "@user");
                const avatarEl = h("img", { src: DEFAULT_AVATAR, style: { width: "20px", height: "23px", objectFit: "contain" } });
                lookupUser(reply.id).then((u) => {
                    if (!u) return;
                    nameEl.replaceWith(Username({ user: u, className: s.replyingToUsername }));
                    avatarEl.src = blookPath(avatarOf(u));
                });
                const quote = contentEl(reply.quote, author, s);
                Object.assign(quote.style, { opacity: 0.75, overflow: "hidden", textOverflow: "ellipsis", whiteSpace: "nowrap", minWidth: 0 });
                return h("div", { class: s.replyingTo, style: { marginLeft: "30px" } },
                    h("i", { class: "fas fa-reply", style: { transform: "scaleX(-1)", opacity: 0.5, fontSize: "14px" } }),
                    avatarEl, nameEl, quote);
            }

            const Message = (data, newUser) => {
                const author = data.author || {};
                const raw = String(data.message?.content ?? "");
                const reply = parseReply(raw);
                const mentionsMe = (data.message?.mentions || []).map(String).includes(String(self.id)) || reply?.id === String(self.id);
                const date = toDate(data.message?.date);
                newUser = newUser || !!reply;

                let body;
                if (editing === data.message?.id) {
                    const box = h("textarea", { class: [s.messageInput, s.editingMessageInput], style: { width: "100%" } });
                    box.value = raw;
                    const save = () => {
                        const content = box.value.trim();
                        if (content && content !== raw) postJson(`/worker/messages/${data.message.id}/edit`, { content }).then((d) => d.error && errorModal(d.reason));
                        editing = null;
                        draw();
                    };
                    const cancel = () => { editing = null; draw(); };
                    box.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
                        if (e.key === "Enter" && !e.shiftKey) { e.preventDefault(); save(); }
                        if (e.key === "Escape") cancel();
                    });
                    setTimeout(() => { box.focus(); box.setSelectionRange(box.value.length, box.value.length); });
                    body = [box, h("div", { class: s.editingMessageText }, "escape to ", h("span", { class: s.editingMessageCancelText, onclick: cancel }, "cancel"), " | enter to ", h("span", { class: s.editingMessageSaveText, onclick: save }, "save"))];
                } else if (isFiltered(raw) && !shownFiltered.has(String(data.message?.id))) {
                    body = h("span", { style: { opacity: 0.5, fontStyle: "italic", cursor: "pointer" }, onclick: () => { shownFiltered.add(String(data.message?.id)); draw(); } }, "Hidden by your word filter. Click to show.");
                } else body = contentEl(reply ? reply.rest : raw, author, s);

                return h("span", { class: s.messageHolder, style: { marginTop: newUser ? (plugin("compactChat") ? "6px" : "15px") : null } },
                    h("li", {
                        class: [s.message, mentionsMe && s.mention], dataset: { messageId: String(data.message?.id ?? "") }, style: embedded ? { paddingRight: "10px" } : null,
                        oncontextmenu: (e) => messageMenu(e, data)
                    },
                    reply && ReplyLine(reply, author),
                    h("div", { class: s.messageContainer },
                        newUser && h("a", { href: `/stats?name=${encodeURIComponent(author.username || "")}`, class: [s.messageAvatarContainer, s.messageAvatar], style: plugin("compactChat") ? { width: "38px", height: "40px", marginTop: "2px" } : null, oncontextmenu: (e) => { e.stopPropagation(); userMenu(e, author); } },
                            Blook({ src: blookPath(avatarOf(author)), objectFit: "contain" })),
                        h("div", { class: s.messageContentContainer },
                            newUser && Header(author, date),
                            h("div", { class: s.messageContent },
                                !newUser && h("div", { class: s.messageSmallTimestamp }, date.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" })),
                                body,
                                data.message?.edited?.edited && h("span", { class: s.edited }, "(edited)"),
                                data.message?.deleted && h("span", { class: s.edited, style: { color: "red" } }, "(deleted)"))))));
            };

            function messageMenu(e, data) {
                const mine = String(data.author?.id) === String(self.id);
                const target = e.target;
                contextMenu(e, [
                    mine && { label: "Edit", icon: "fas fa-edit", onClick: () => { editing = data.message.id; draw(); } },
                    { label: "Reply", icon: "fas fa-reply", onClick: () => setReply(data) },
                    !mine && { label: "Ping", icon: "fas fa-at", onClick: () => ping(data.author) },
                    !mine && { label: "Trade", icon: "fas fa-arrows-rotate", onClick: () => tradeWith(data.author.username) },
                    { label: "View Profile", icon: "fas fa-user", onClick: () => go(`/stats?name=${encodeURIComponent(data.author.username)}`) },
                    { label: "Copy Text", icon: "fas fa-copy", onClick: () => navigator.clipboard.writeText(data.message.content) },
                    plugin("savedMessages") && { label: "Save Message", icon: "fas fa-bookmark", onClick: () => saveMessage(data) },
                    !mine && plugin("userNotes") && { label: "Note", icon: "fas fa-note-sticky", onClick: () => editNote(data.author) },
                    !mine && plugin("muteUsers") && { label: "Mute", icon: "fas fa-volume-xmark", onClick: () => mute(data.author) },
                    !mine && { label: "Report", icon: "fas fa-flag", color: "#F54242", onClick: () => v2().showReportModal?.("message", data) },
                    (mine || can(self, "delete_messages")) && { label: "Delete", icon: "fas fa-trash", color: "#F54242", onClick: () => postJson(`/worker/messages/${data.message.id}/delete`, {}).then((d) => d.error && errorModal(d.reason)) },
                    { divider: true },
                    ["IMG", "VIDEO"].includes(target.tagName) && { label: "Copy Link", icon: "fas fa-link", onClick: () => navigator.clipboard.writeText(target.src) },
                    target.dataset?.mention && { label: "Copy User ID", icon: "fas fa-copy", onClick: () => navigator.clipboard.writeText(target.dataset.mention) },
                    { label: "Copy Raw Message", icon: "fas fa-copy", onClick: () => navigator.clipboard.writeText(JSON.stringify(data)) },
                    { label: "Copy Message ID", icon: "fas fa-copy", onClick: () => navigator.clipboard.writeText(String(data.message.id)) }
                ]);
            }

            const ping = (author) => {
                remember(author);
                const before = input.value.slice(0, input.selectionStart ?? input.value.length);
                insertText(`${before && !/\s$/.test(before) ? " " : ""}@${author.username} `);
            };

            const mute = (author) => {
                toggleMute(author);
                messages = messages.filter((m) => !isMuted(m.author?.id));
                draw();
            };

            function searchModal() {
                const field = Input({ icon: "fas fa-magnifying-glass", placeholder: "Search words, or from:username" });
                Object.assign(field.style, { margin: "0", width: "100%", maxWidth: "none" });
                const results = h("div", { style: { display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: "6px", maxHeight: "50vh", overflowY: "auto", textAlign: "left" } });
                const run = () => {
                    const q = field.querySelector("input").value.trim().toLowerCase();
                    const from = /^from:(\S+)\s*/.exec(q);
                    const words = from ? q.slice(from[0].length) : q;
                    const found = q ? messages.filter((m) => (!from || String(m.author?.username).toLowerCase() === from[1])
                        && (!words || String(m.message?.content).toLowerCase().includes(words))).slice(-100).reverse() : [];
                    results.replaceChildren(...(found.length ? found.map((m) => h("div", { style: { display: "flex", gap: "10px", padding: "6px 10px", borderRadius: "var(--border-radius)", background: "rgba(var(--black), 0.2)", fontSize: "16px" } },
                        h("div", { style: { width: "32px", height: "36px", flexShrink: 0 } }, Blook({ src: blookPath(avatarOf(m.author)) })),
                        h("div", { style: { minWidth: 0 } },
                            h("div", { style: { display: "flex", gap: "8px", alignItems: "center" } }, Username({ user: m.author }),
                                h("span", { style: { fontSize: "13px", opacity: 0.5 } }, timestamp(toDate(m.message?.date)))),
                            h("div", { class: s.messageContent }, contentEl(parseReply(m.message.content)?.rest ?? m.message.content, m.author, s)))))
                        : [h("div", { style: { opacity: 0.6 } }, q ? "Nothing found in the loaded messages." : `Searching the ${messages.length.toLocaleString()} loaded messages.`)]));
                };
                field.querySelector("input").addEventListener("input", run);
                const close = openModal(ModalHeader("Search Chat"), ModalBody(h("div", { style: { width: "min(640px, 85vw)", display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: "10px" } }, field, results)),
                    ModalButtons(GenericButton({ onClick: () => close() }, "Close")));
                run();
                field.querySelector("input").focus();
            }

            function userMenu(e, author) {
                const other = String(author.id) !== String(self.id);
                contextMenu(e, [
                    { label: "View Profile", icon: "fas fa-user", onClick: () => go(`/stats?name=${encodeURIComponent(author.username)}`) },
                    other && { label: "Ping", icon: "fas fa-at", onClick: () => ping(author) },
                    other && { label: "Trade", icon: "fas fa-arrows-rotate", onClick: () => tradeWith(author.username) },
                    { label: "View Blooks", icon: "fas fa-box-open", onClick: () => go(`/blooks?name=${encodeURIComponent(author.username)}`) },
                    plugin("savedMessages") && { label: "Saved Messages", icon: "fas fa-bookmark", onClick: () => savedModal(author.id) },
                    other && plugin("userNotes") && { label: noteOf(author.id) ? "Edit Note" : "Add Note", icon: "fas fa-note-sticky", onClick: () => editNote(author) },
                    other && plugin("muteUsers") && { label: "Mute", icon: "fas fa-volume-xmark", onClick: () => mute(author) },
                    String(author.id) !== String(self.id) && { label: "Report", icon: "fas fa-flag", color: "#F54242", onClick: () => v2().showReportModal?.("user", { author, user: author }) },
                    { divider: true },
                    { label: "Copy User ID", icon: "fas fa-copy", onClick: () => navigator.clipboard.writeText(String(author.id)) }
                ]);
            }

            const built = new Map();
            const draw = () => {
                const nodes = [];
                const keep = new Set();
                const from = Math.max(0, messages.length - drawLimit);
                for (let i = messages.length - 1; i >= from; i--) {
                    const prev = messages[i - 1];
                    const cur = messages[i];
                    const newUser = !prev || String(prev.author?.id) !== String(cur.author?.id)
                        || toDate(cur.message?.date) - toDate(prev.message?.date) > 5 * 60 * 1000;
                    const id = String(cur.message?.id ?? i);
                    const sig = `${newUser}|${cur.message?.content}|${!!cur.message?.edited?.edited}|${!!cur.message?.deleted}|${editing === cur.message?.id}`;
                    let hit = built.get(id);
                    if (!hit || hit.sig !== sig) built.set(id, hit = { sig, node: Message(cur, newUser) });
                    keep.add(id);
                    nodes.push(hit.node);
                }
                for (const id of built.keys()) if (!keep.has(id)) built.delete(id);
                const kids = list.children;
                if (kids.length && !kids[0].dataset?.messageNode) list.replaceChildren();
                nodes.forEach((node, i) => {
                    node.dataset.messageNode = "1";
                    if (kids[i] !== node) list.insertBefore(node, kids[i] || null);
                });
                while (kids.length > nodes.length) kids[kids.length - 1].remove();
            };
            const queueDraw = () => {
                if (drawQueued) return;
                drawQueued = true;
                requestAnimationFrame(() => { drawQueued = false; draw(); });
            };

            const view = {
                room: String(room),
                visible: () => list.isConnected && list.offsetParent !== null && document.visibilityState === "visible",
                onSocket({ event, data, error }) {
                    if (!list.isConnected) return views.delete(view);
                    if (error || !data) return;
                    if (event === "messages-create") {
                        if (String(data.room?.id) !== String(room)) return;
                        if ((self.blocks || []).includes(data.author?.id) || isMuted(data.author?.id)) return;
                        remember(data.author);
                        if (messages.some((m) => String(m.message?.id) === String(data.message?.id))) return;
                        messages.push(data);
                        queueDraw();
                    } else if (event === "messages-edit") {
                        const msg = messages.find((m) => String(m.message?.id) === String(data.message));
                        if (!msg) return;
                        msg.message.content = data.content;
                        msg.message.edited = { ...(msg.message.edited || {}), edited: true };
                        queueDraw();
                    } else if (event === "messages-delete") {
                        const i = messages.findIndex((m) => String(m.message?.id) === String(data.message));
                        if (i < 0) return;
                        if (can(self, "delete_messages")) messages[i].message.deleted = true;
                        else messages.splice(i, 1);
                        queueDraw();
                    }
                }
            };
            views.add(view);

            const replyBar = h("div", {
                class: s.aboveInputContainer,
                style: { transform: "rotateX(90deg)", transformOrigin: "bottom", transition: "transform 0.2s ease", overflow: "hidden" }
            });
            function setReply(data) {
                replyingTo = data;
                list.dataset.aboveInput = String(!!data);
                replyBar.style.transform = data ? "rotateX(0)" : "rotateX(90deg)";
                replyBar.replaceChildren(
                    h("div", null, "Replying to ", data?.author ? Username({ user: data.author }) : ""),
                    h("i", { class: "fas fa-times", onclick: () => setReply(null) }));
                if (data) input.focus();
                drawAttachments();
            }

            const input = h("textarea", {
                class: s.messageInput, placeholder: `Message #${name}`, maxlength: "2048", spellcheck: "true", rows: "1",
                style: { color: localStorage.getItem("chatColor") || null }
            });

            const insertText = (text) => {
                const at = input.selectionStart ?? input.value.length;
                input.value = input.value.slice(0, at) + text + input.value.slice(input.selectionEnd ?? at);
                input.focus();
                input.selectionStart = input.selectionEnd = at + text.length;
            };

            const suggest = h("div", { class: s.typingListContainer, style: { display: "none", left: "60px", maxHeight: "300px", overflowY: "auto" } });
            let options = [], picked = 0, tokenStart = 0;
            const closeSuggest = () => { suggest.style.display = "none"; options = []; };
            const updateSuggest = () => {
                const caret = input.selectionStart ?? input.value.length;
                const m = /(^|\s)([@:])([\w.+-]*)$/.exec(input.value.slice(0, caret));
                if (!m || (m[2] === ":" && (!plugin("emojiAutofill") || !m[3]))) return closeSuggest();
                const q = m[3].toLowerCase();
                tokenStart = caret - m[3].length - 1;
                if (m[2] === "@") {
                    const seen = new Set();
                    options = [];
                    for (const [key, u] of known) {
                        if (!key.startsWith("@") || seen.has(u.id) || !u.username.toLowerCase().startsWith(q)) continue;
                        seen.add(u.id);
                        options.push({ insert: `@${u.username} `, img: blookPath(avatarOf(u)), user: u });
                        if (options.length >= 8) break;
                    }
                } else {
                    options = Object.entries(v2().emojis || {}).filter(([n]) => n.toLowerCase().includes(q)).slice(0, 8)
                        .map(([n, e]) => ({ insert: `:${n}: `, img: e.image, label: `:${n}:` }));
                    for (const x of (v2().emojiNames || [])) {
                        if (options.length >= 8) break;
                        if (x.shortname?.toLowerCase().includes(q)) options.push({ insert: `${x.emoji} `, text: x.emoji, label: x.shortname });
                    }
                }
                if (!options.length) return closeSuggest();
                picked = Math.min(picked, options.length - 1);
                suggest.replaceChildren(...options.map((o, i) => h("div", { class: s.typingListItem, dataset: { selected: String(i === picked) }, onmousedown: (e) => { e.preventDefault(); choose(i); } },
                    h("div", { class: s.typingListItemImage }, o.img ? h("img", { src: o.img, style: { width: "20px", height: "20px", objectFit: "contain" } }) : o.text),
                    o.user ? Username({ user: o.user }) : h("span", null, o.label))));
                suggest.style.display = "flex";
            };
            const choose = (i) => {
                const o = options[i];
                if (!o) return;
                const caret = input.selectionStart ?? input.value.length;
                input.value = input.value.slice(0, tokenStart) + o.insert + input.value.slice(caret);
                input.selectionStart = input.selectionEnd = tokenStart + o.insert.length;
                closeSuggest();
                input.focus();
            };
            input.addEventListener("input", () => { picked = 0; updateSuggest(); });
            input.addEventListener("blur", () => setTimeout(closeSuggest, 150));
            input.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
                if (suggest.style.display === "none") return;
                if (e.key === "ArrowDown" || e.key === "ArrowUp") {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    e.stopImmediatePropagation();
                    picked = (picked + (e.key === "ArrowDown" ? 1 : options.length - 1)) % options.length;
                    updateSuggest();
                } else if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === "Tab") {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    e.stopImmediatePropagation();
                    choose(picked);
                } else if (e.key === "Escape") {
                    e.stopImmediatePropagation();
                    closeSuggest();
                }
            });

            let emojiPicker = null;
            const toggleEmojiPicker = () => {
                if (emojiPicker) { emojiPicker.remove(); emojiPicker = null; return; }
                const emojis = Object.entries(v2().emojis || {});
                const grid = h("div", { style: { display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "repeat(7, minmax(0, 1fr))", gap: "4px", overflowY: "auto", maxHeight: "240px" } });
                const fill = (q = "") => grid.replaceChildren(...emojis.filter(([n]) => n.toLowerCase().includes(q.toLowerCase())).slice(0, 400)
                    .map(([n, e]) => tooltip(h("img", { src: e.image, loading: "lazy", style: { width: "100%", aspectRatio: "1", objectFit: "contain", cursor: "pointer", padding: "4px", boxSizing: "border-box", borderRadius: "var(--border-radius)" }, onclick: () => insertText(`:${n}: `) }), `:${n}:`)));
                const search = h("input", { class: s.messageInput, placeholder: "Search emojis...", style: { width: "100%", boxSizing: "border-box", marginBottom: "8px" }, oninput: (e) => fill(e.target.value) });
                fill();
                emojiPicker = h("div", { style: { position: "absolute", bottom: "calc(100% + 8px)", right: "20px", width: "340px", padding: "10px", background: "var(--primary-color)", borderRadius: "var(--border-radius)", boxShadow: "inset 0 -5px rgba(var(--black), 0.2), 0 0 10px rgba(var(--black), 0.5)", zIndex: 10 } },
                    search, emojis.length ? grid : h("div", { style: { opacity: 0.6 } }, "No Blacket emojis found."));
                form.append(emojiPicker);
                search.focus();
            };

            const pending = [];
            const attachBar = h("div", { style: { position: "absolute", left: "0", right: "0", display: "none", gap: "8px", flexWrap: "wrap", padding: "8px 14px", background: "var(--primary-color)", zIndex: 2 } });
            const drawAttachments = () => {
                attachBar.style.display = pending.length ? "flex" : "none";
                attachBar.style.bottom = replyingTo ? "calc(100% + 40px)" : "100%";
                attachBar.replaceChildren(...pending.map((p, i) => h("div", { style: { position: "relative", display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: "8px", padding: "6px 10px", borderRadius: "var(--border-radius)", background: "rgba(var(--black), 0.3)", maxWidth: "220px" } },
                    p.image ? h("img", { src: p.url, style: { height: "60px", maxWidth: "120px", objectFit: "contain", borderRadius: "var(--border-radius)" } }) : h("i", { class: "fas fa-file-lines", style: { fontSize: "24px" } }),
                    !p.image && h("span", { style: { fontSize: "14px", overflow: "hidden", textOverflow: "ellipsis", whiteSpace: "nowrap" } }, p.name),
                    p.uploading && h("span", { style: { fontSize: "13px", opacity: 0.6 } }, "Uploading..."),
                    h("i", { class: "fas fa-times-circle", style: { position: "absolute", top: "-6px", right: "-6px", cursor: "pointer", color: "#ff6b6b", background: "var(--primary-color)", borderRadius: "50%" }, onclick: () => { pending.splice(i, 1); drawAttachments(); } }))));
            };

            const sendRaw = (content) => {
                const sock = v2().socket;
                if (sock?.readyState === 1 && typeof sock.emit === "function") sock.emit("messages-create", { room, content });
                else if (typeof v2().sendMessage === "function") v2().sendMessage(room, content);
                else errorModal("Chat isn't connected yet, try again in a moment.");
            };

            const send = () => {
                let content = input.value;
                if (pending.some((p) => p.uploading)) return toast({ header: "Chat", body: "Wait for your files to finish uploading.", icon: "fas fa-upload" });
                if (!content.replace(/\s/g, "") && !pending.length) return;

                if (replyingTo) {
                    remember(replyingTo.author);
                    const quoted = String(replyingTo.message.content);
                    const line = (parseReply(quoted)?.rest ?? quoted).replace(/\n/g, " ");
                    content = `From @${replyingTo.author.username}: ${line}\n@${replyingTo.author.username} ${content}`;
                }
                for (const mention of new Set((content.match(/\B@[\w.-]+/g) || []).map((x) => x.slice(1)))) {
                    const user = known.get(`@${mention.toLowerCase()}`);
                    if (user) content = content.replace(new RegExp(`@${mention.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\-]/g, "\\$&")}(?![\\w.-])`, "gi"), `<@${user.id}>`);
                }
                if (!can(self, "use_chat_colors")) localStorage.removeItem("chatColor");
                const color = localStorage.getItem("chatColor");
                if (color && content.trim()) content = `<${color}>${content}</${color}>`;
                if (pending.length) content = [content.trim(), ...pending.map((p) => p.url)].filter(Boolean).join("\n");

                sendRaw(content);
                input.value = "";
                pending.length = 0;
                drawAttachments();
                setReply(null);
            };

            input.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
                if (e.key === "Enter" && !e.shiftKey) { e.preventDefault(); send(); }
                if (e.key === "ArrowUp" && !input.value) {
                    const last = [...messages].reverse().find((m) => String(m.author?.id) === String(self.id) && !m.message?.deleted);
                    if (last) { e.preventDefault(); editing = last.message.id; draw(); }
                }
                if (e.key === "Escape") setReply(null);
            });

            const upload = (file) => {
                if (!file) return;
                if (file.size > 8 * 1024 * 1024) return errorModal("File size is too large. (Max 8 MB)");
                if (plugin("attachments")) {
                    const entry = { name: file.name, image: file.type.startsWith("image/"), uploading: true, url: file.type.startsWith("image/") ? URL.createObjectURL(file) : "" };
                    pending.push(entry);
                    drawAttachments();
                    return uploadFile(file).then((url) => { entry.url = url; entry.uploading = false; drawAttachments(); })
                        .catch((reason) => { pending.splice(pending.indexOf(entry), 1); drawAttachments(); errorModal(String(reason)); });
                }
                confirmModal("Upload", `Are you sure you want to upload ${file.name}?`, () => {
                    uploadFile(file).then(sendRaw).catch((reason) => errorModal(String(reason)));
                });
            };
            const pickFile = () => {
                const picker = h("input", { type: "file" });
                picker.onchange = () => upload(picker.files[0]);
                picker.click();
            };
            input.addEventListener("paste", (e) => {
                if (!can(self, "upload_files") || !e.clipboardData?.files?.length) return;
                e.preventDefault();
                upload(e.clipboardData.files[0]);
            });

            function colorModal() {
                const picker = h("input", { type: "color", value: localStorage.getItem("chatColor") || "#ffffff", style: { width: "120px", height: "50px", border: "none", background: "none", cursor: "pointer" } });
                const close = openModal(ModalHeader("Chat Color"), ModalBody("Pick the color your messages are sent in."), ModalBody(picker),
                    ModalButtons(
                        GenericButton({ onClick: () => { localStorage.setItem("chatColor", picker.value); input.style.color = picker.value; close(); } }, "Save"),
                        GenericButton({ onClick: () => { localStorage.removeItem("chatColor"); input.style.color = ""; close(); } }, "Reset")));
            }

            const form = h("div", { class: s.messageForm },
                h("div", { class: s.usersTypingContainer, dataset: { visible: "false" } }),
                replyBar,
                attachBar,
                suggest,
                h("div", { class: s.leftInputButtonsContainer },
                    can(self, "upload_files") && h("div", { class: s.inputButton, onclick: pickFile }, h("i", { class: "fas fa-paperclip" })),
                    plugin("savedMessages") && !embedded && tooltip(h("div", { class: s.inputButton, onclick: () => savedModal() }, h("i", { class: "fas fa-bookmark" })), "Saved Messages"),
                    plugin("mentionsInbox") && !embedded && tooltip(h("div", { class: s.inputButton, onclick: mentionsModal }, h("i", { class: "fas fa-at" })), "Mentions"),
                    plugin("chatSearch") && !embedded && tooltip(h("div", { class: s.inputButton, onclick: searchModal }, h("i", { class: "fas fa-magnifying-glass" })), "Search Chat")),
                input,
                h("div", { class: s.rightInputButtonsContainer },
                    tooltip(h("div", { class: s.inputButton, onclick: toggleEmojiPicker }, h("i", { class: "fas fa-face-smile" })), "Emojis"),
                    can(self, "use_chat_colors") && !embedded && h("div", { class: s.inputButton, onclick: colorModal }, h("i", { class: "fas fa-paint-brush" })),
                    h("div", { class: s.inputButton, onclick: send }, h("i", { class: "fas fa-paper-plane" }))));

            if (embedded) {
                Object.assign(list.style, { top: "0", height: "calc(100% - 70px)" });
                Object.assign(form.style, { position: "absolute", width: "auto", left: "0", right: "0", boxSizing: "border-box", borderRadius: "0 0 var(--border-radius) var(--border-radius)" });
                Object.assign(input.style, { flex: "1", minWidth: "0", width: "auto" });
                form.querySelector(`.${s.rightInputButtonsContainer}`).style.marginRight = "0";
            }

            list.replaceChildren(h("div", { style: { margin: "auto", opacity: 0.6, fontSize: "18px", padding: "20px" } }, "Loading messages..."));
            root.append(h("div", { class: s.container }, list, form));
            setReply(null);
            if (!embedded) input.focus();

            getJson(`/worker2/messages/${room}?limit=${fetchLimit}`).then((d) => {
                if (!d || d.error) return list.replaceChildren(ErrorContainer(d?.reason || "Could not load messages."));
                const live = messages;
                const history = (d.messages || []).filter((m) => !(self.blocks || []).includes(m.author?.id) && !isMuted(m.author?.id));
                history.sort((a, b) => toDate(a.message?.date) - toDate(b.message?.date));
                if (!history.some((m) => m.message?.date)) history.reverse();
                history.forEach((m) => remember(m.author));
                messages = [...history, ...live.filter((m) => !history.some((x) => String(x.message?.id) === String(m.message?.id)))];
                draw();
            });

            if (!embedded) {
                const indicator = document.getElementById("chatNotificationIndicator");
                if (indicator) { indicator.textContent = "0"; indicator.style.display = "none"; }
            }
        }

        VIEWS.chat = { topRight: [], render: (root) => renderChat(root), renderRoom: renderChat };
    })();

    (() => {
        const INVEST_PRICES = [25000, 100000, 250000, 500000];
        const INVEST_RATES = ["0.00%", "0.05%", "0.10%", "0.15%", "0.20%", "0.25%"];

        const call = (url, body) => postJson(url, body).then((d) => {
            if (d.error) throw d.reason || "Something went wrong.";
            return d;
        });
        const fail = (reason) => toast({ header: "Error", body: String(reason), icon: "fas fa-times-circle" });

        const ClanName = (clan, style) => h("span", {
            class: String(clan.color).toLowerCase() === "rainbow" ? "rainbow" : null,
            style: { color: String(clan.color).toLowerCase() === "rainbow" ? null : clan.color || "#ffffff", ...style }
        }, clan.safe && h("i", { class: "fas fa-shield", style: { marginRight: "8px", fontSize: "0.8em" } }), clan.name);

        const normalize = (clan) => {
            if (!clan) return clan;
            clan.exp ??= clan.xp ?? 0;
            clan.members ??= [];
            if (!clan.members.length && clan.ownerId && String(clan.ownerId) === String(me()?.id)) clan.members = [me()];
            clan.memberCount ??= clan.members.length;
            clan.owner ??= clan.members.find((m) => String(m.id) === String(clan.ownerId)) || { id: clan.ownerId, username: "" };
            clan.created ??= clan.createdAt ? Date.parse(clan.createdAt) / 1000 : 0;
            if (typeof clan.investments !== "object" || clan.investments === null) clan.investments = { level: 1, users: {} };
            return clan;
        };

        const clanImage = (clan) => String(clan.image || "").split("?")[0] || media("/content/icons/error.png");
        const formatDate = (seconds) => new Date(seconds * 1000).toLocaleDateString();

        function formModal(title, body, fields, submitText, onSubmit) {
            let error;
            const inputs = fields.map((f) => f.upload ? ImageField(f) : Input({ icon: f.icon, placeholder: f.placeholder, type: f.type || "text", autocomplete: "off", maxlength: f.max || "64", value: f.value }));
            const submit = () => {
                error?.remove();
                onSubmit(inputs.map((i) => i.querySelector("input").value)).then(() => close()).catch((reason) => buttons.before(error = ErrorContainer(String(reason))));
            };
            const buttons = ModalButtons(GenericButton({ onClick: submit }, submitText), GenericButton({ onClick: () => close() }, "Cancel"));
            const close = openModal(ModalHeader(title), body && ModalBody(body), h("form", { onsubmit: (e) => { e.preventDefault(); submit(); } }, inputs, h("input", { type: "submit", style: { display: "none" } })), buttons);
            inputs[0]?.querySelector("input").focus();
        }

        function ImageField(f) {
            const input = Input({ icon: f.icon, placeholder: f.placeholder, autocomplete: "off", maxlength: f.max || "256", value: f.value, readonly: true });
            Object.assign(input.style, { margin: "0", flex: "1", maxWidth: "none", width: "auto" });
            const field = input.querySelector("input");
            const preview = h("img", { src: f.value || "", style: { width: "120px", height: "120px", objectFit: "cover", borderRadius: "var(--border-radius)", display: f.value ? "block" : "none", margin: "0 auto 10px" } });
            const button = GenericButton({ icon: "fas fa-upload", onClick: () => {
                const picker = h("input", { type: "file", accept: "image/png,image/jpeg,image/gif,image/webp" });
                picker.onchange = () => {
                    const file = picker.files[0];
                    if (!file) return;
                    if (!/\.(png|jpe?g|gif|webp)$/i.test(file.name)) return fail("File type is not supported.");
                    button.style.opacity = "0.5";
                    uploadFile(file).then((url) => {
                        field.value = url;
                        preview.src = url;
                        preview.style.display = "block";
                    }).catch(fail).finally(() => (button.style.opacity = ""));
                };
                picker.click();
            } }, "Upload");
            return h("div", { style: { maxWidth: "420px", margin: "0 auto 15px" } }, preview,
                h("div", { style: { display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: "10px" } }, input, button));
        }

        const secureFields = () => [
            { icon: "fas fa-lock", placeholder: "Password", type: "password" },
            me().otp?.enabled || me().otp === true ? { icon: "fas fa-shield-alt", placeholder: "2FA Code" } : null
        ].filter(Boolean);

        function ClanCard(clan, onClick, footer) {
            const s = S("views/News/news");
            const { level } = levelFromExp(clan.exp);
            return h("div", { class: s.postContainer, style: { width: "300px", height: "360px" }, onclick: onClick },
                h("div", { class: s.postTopContainer, style: { height: "160px" } },
                    h("img", { class: s.postImage, src: clanImage(clan), draggable: "false", onerror: function () { this.onerror = null; this.src = media("/content/icons/error.png"); } }),
                    h("div", { class: s.postDate }, h("i", { class: "fas fa-star" }), `Level ${level.toLocaleString()}`),
                    h("div", { class: s.postAuthor }, `${(clan.memberCount ?? 0).toLocaleString()} Members`, h("i", { class: "fas fa-users" }))),
                h("div", { class: s.postTitle, style: { fontSize: "26px" } }, ClanName(clan)),
                h("div", { class: s.postDivider }),
                h("div", { class: s.postBottomContainer },
                    h("div", { class: s.postContent }, clan.description || ""),
                    footer || h("div", { class: s.postReadMoreText, style: { display: "flex", gap: "12px", alignItems: "center", opacity: 0.8 } },
                        h("span", null, h("i", { class: "fas fa-crown", style: { marginRight: "5px", color: "gold" } }), clan.owner?.username ?? ""),
                        clan.online != null && h("span", null, h("i", { class: "fas fa-circle", style: { color: "lime", fontSize: "9px", marginRight: "4px" } }), `${clan.online} Online`),
                        clan.offline != null && h("span", null, h("i", { class: "fas fa-circle", style: { color: "#888", fontSize: "9px", marginRight: "4px" } }), `${clan.offline} Offline`))));
        }

        const cardGrid = (...kids) => h("div", { style: { display: "flex", flexWrap: "wrap", gap: "30px", justifyContent: "center", margin: "10px 5% 40px" } }, ...kids);

        async function renderDiscover(root) {
            const user = await whenUser();
            await whenData();
            let page = 1, pages = 1, query = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get("name") || "";

            const results = h("div");
            const nav = h("div", { style: { display: "flex", justifyContent: "center", alignItems: "center", gap: "15px", marginBottom: "40px", fontSize: "20px", fontWeight: 700 } });

            const load = () => {
                results.replaceChildren(h("div", { style: { textAlign: "center", fontSize: "20px", margin: "40px" } }, "Loading..."));
                const url = query.trim() ? `/worker/clans/discover/name/${encodeURIComponent(query.trim())}` : `/worker/clans/discover/page/${page}`;
                getJson(url).then((d) => {
                    if (d.error) throw d.reason;
                    pages = d.pages || 1;
                    const clans = (d.clans || (d.clan ? [d.clan] : [])).map(normalize);
                    results.replaceChildren(clans.length
                        ? cardGrid(clans.map((clan) => ClanCard(clan, () => clanModal(clan))))
                        : h("div", { class: S("views/AuctionHouse/auctionHouse").noAuctions, style: { margin: "40px 0" } }, "No clans found."));
                    nav.replaceChildren(...(query.trim() ? [] : [
                        page > 1 && GenericButton({ icon: "fas fa-arrow-left", onClick: () => { page--; load(); } }, "Back"),
                        h("span", null, `Page ${page} of ${pages}`),
                        page < pages && GenericButton({ icon: "fas fa-arrow-right", onClick: () => { page++; load(); } }, "Next")
                    ].filter(Boolean)));
                }).catch((reason) => results.replaceChildren(ErrorContainer(String(reason || "Could not load clans."))));
            };

            function clanModal(clan) {
                const { level } = levelFromExp(clan.exp);
                const mine = user.clan && String(user.clan.id ?? user.clan) === String(clan.id);
                const action = h("div", { style: { display: "contents" } });

                const drawAction = (pending) => {
                    if (mine) return action.replaceChildren();
                    if (user.clan) return action.replaceChildren(GenericButton({
                        icon: "fas fa-bomb", backgroundColor: clan.safe ? "#555" : "#c22",
                        onClick: () => clan.safe ? fail("This clan is in safe mode and can't be attacked.") : attack(clan)
                    }, "Attack"));
                    if (pending?.accepted) return action.replaceChildren(GenericButton({ icon: "fas fa-door-open", onClick: () => join(clan) }, "Join Clan"));
                    if (pending) return action.replaceChildren(GenericButton({ icon: "fas fa-clock", style: { opacity: 0.6, pointerEvents: "none" } }, "Request Pending"));
                    action.replaceChildren(GenericButton({
                        icon: "fas fa-swords",
                        onClick: () => call("/worker/clans/requests/send", { clan: clan.id })
                            .then(() => { success(`You have sent a request to join ${clan.name}.`); drawAction({ accepted: false }); })
                            .catch(fail)
                    }, "Request to Join"));
                };
                drawAction(null);
                if (!user.clan) getJson("/worker/clans/requests/pending/me").then((d) => drawAction((d.clans || []).find((c) => c.id === clan.id))).catch(() => { });

                const membersBox = h("div", { style: { display: "flex", flexWrap: "wrap", gap: "8px", maxHeight: "200px", overflowY: "auto" } });
                const drawMembers = (members, done) => membersBox.replaceChildren(...(members.length
                    ? members.map((m) => h("a", { href: `/stats?name=${encodeURIComponent(m.username)}`, style: { display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: "8px", padding: "4px 12px 4px 4px", borderRadius: "var(--border-radius)", background: "rgba(var(--black), 0.2)", textDecoration: "none", fontSize: "17px" } },
                        h("div", { style: { width: "30px", height: "34px" } }, Blook({ src: blookPath(m.avatar) })),
                        String(m.id) === String(clan.owner?.id) && h("i", { class: "fas fa-crown", style: { color: "gold" } }),
                        Username({ user: m })))
                    : [h("div", { style: { opacity: 0.6 } }, done ? "This clan's member list isn't available." : "Loading members...")]));
                drawMembers(clan.members || [], !!clan.members?.length);

                const Info = (ic, text) => h("div", { style: { display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: "8px" } }, h("i", { class: ic, style: { width: "20px", opacity: 0.6 } }), text);

                const close = openModal(
                    ModalHeader(ClanName(clan)),
                    ModalBody(h("div", { style: { display: "flex", gap: "20px", alignItems: "flex-start", maxWidth: "780px", textAlign: "left" } },
                        h("img", { src: clanImage(clan), style: { width: "280px", maxHeight: "320px", objectFit: "contain", borderRadius: "var(--border-radius)", background: "rgba(var(--black), 0.2)", flexShrink: 0 } }),
                        h("div", { style: { display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: "6px", fontSize: "18px" } },
                            h("div", { style: { whiteSpace: "pre-wrap", marginBottom: "6px" } }, clan.description || "No description."),
                            Info("fas fa-star", `Level ${level.toLocaleString()} (${(clan.exp ?? 0).toLocaleString()} EXP)`),
                            Info("fas fa-crown", clan.owner?.username ?? "Unknown"),
                            Info("fas fa-users", `${(clan.memberCount ?? 0).toLocaleString()} Members, ${clan.online ?? 0} Online`),
                            Info("fas fa-calendar-alt", `Created ${formatDate(clan.created)}`),
                            Info("fas fa-shield", clan.safe ? "This clan is in safe mode." : "This clan is not in safe mode.")))),
                    ModalBody(h("div", { style: { display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: "8px", width: "100%", maxWidth: "780px" } },
                        h("div", { style: { fontWeight: 700, textAlign: "left" } }, `Members (${(clan.memberCount ?? 0).toLocaleString()})`),
                        membersBox)),
                    ModalButtons(action, GenericButton({ onClick: () => close() }, "Close")));

                if (!clan.members?.length) getJson(`/worker/clans/discover/name/${encodeURIComponent(clan.name)}`).then((d) => {
                    const full = normalize(d?.clan || d?.clans?.[0]);
                    drawMembers(full?.members || [], true);
                });
            }

            function attack(clan) {
                if (!(user.inventory || []).includes("Fragment Grenade (Item)")) return fail("You do not have any Fragment Grenades.");
                confirmModal("Attack", `Are you sure you want to attack ${clan.name}? This will cost you a Fragment Grenade. If the clan is shielded you will only destroy its shield.`, () =>
                    call("/worker/use", { item: "Fragment Grenade (Item)", clan: clan.id }).then((d) => {
                        user.inventory.splice(user.inventory.indexOf("Fragment Grenade (Item)"), 1);
                        success(d.message || `You attacked ${clan.name}!`);
                    }).catch(fail));
            }

            function join(clan) {
                confirmModal("Join Clan", `Are you sure you want to join ${clan.name}? You can't join any other clan unless you leave this one.`, () =>
                    call("/worker/clans/join", { clan: clan.id }).then(() => {
                        user.clan = clan;
                        success(`Welcome to ${clan.name}!`);
                        go("/clans/my-clan");
                    }).catch(fail));
            }

            function pendingModal() {
                const list = h("div", { style: { display: "flex", flexWrap: "wrap", gap: "20px", justifyContent: "center", maxWidth: "80vw", maxHeight: "60vh", overflowY: "auto", padding: "5px" } }, "Loading...");
                const close = openModal(ModalHeader("Your Requests"), ModalBody(list), ModalButtons(GenericButton({ onClick: () => close() }, "Close")));
                getJson("/worker/clans/requests/pending/me").then((d) => {
                    if (d.error) throw d.reason;
                    const clans = (d.clans || (d.clan ? [d.clan] : [])).map(normalize);
                    list.replaceChildren(...(clans.length ? clans.map((clan) => ClanCard(clan, () => { if (clan.accepted) { close(); join(clan); } },
                        h("div", { class: S("views/News/news").postReadMoreText, style: { opacity: 1, color: clan.accepted ? "lime" : "yellow", fontWeight: 700 } },
                            h("i", { class: clan.accepted ? "fas fa-check" : "fas fa-clock", style: { marginRight: "6px" } }), clan.accepted ? "Accepted, click to join" : "Pending")))
                        : ["You haven't sent any requests."]));
                }).catch((reason) => list.replaceChildren(ErrorContainer(String(reason))));
            }

            const createModal = () => formModal("Create Clan", "Name your clan and give it an image and a description.", [
                { icon: "fas fa-signature", placeholder: "Clan Name", max: "16" },
                { icon: "fas fa-image", placeholder: "Upload an image", max: "256", upload: true },
                { icon: "fas fa-align-left", placeholder: "Description", max: "128" }
            ], "Create", ([name, image, description]) => call("/worker/clans/create", { name, image, description }).then(() => {
                success(`Welcome to ${name}!`);
                go("/clans/my-clan");
            }));

            const searchBox = SearchBox({
                placeholder: "Search for a clan...",
                value: query,
                oninput: (e) => (query = e.target.value),
                buttons: [
                    { icon: "fas fa-times", tooltip: "Reset Search", onClick: () => { query = ""; searchBox.querySelector("input").value = ""; page = 1; load(); } },
                    !user.clan && { icon: "fas fa-envelope", tooltip: "Your Requests", onClick: pendingModal },
                    !user.clan && { icon: "fas fa-plus", tooltip: "Create Clan", onClick: createModal },
                    user.clan && { icon: "fas fa-users", tooltip: "My Clan", onClick: () => go("/clans/my-clan") },
                    { icon: "fas fa-magnifying-glass", tooltip: "Search", onClick: () => { page = 1; load(); } }
                ].filter(Boolean)
            });
            searchBox.querySelector("input").addEventListener("keydown", (e) => { if (e.key === "Enter") { page = 1; load(); } });

            root.append(searchBox, results, nav);
            load();
        }

        async function renderMyClan(root) {
            const user = await whenUser();
            await whenData();
            const d = S("views/Dashboard/dashboard");
            let clan;
            let tab = localStorage.getItem("bv3:clanTab") || "members";

            const body = h("div");
            root.append(body);

            const load = () => getJson("/worker/clans").then((res) => {
                clan = normalize(res.clan || res.clans?.[0]);
                if (res.error || !clan) throw res.reason || "You are not in a clan.";
                if (typeof clan.inventory === "string") try { clan.inventory = JSON.parse(clan.inventory); } catch { clan.inventory = []; }
                clan.inventory = Object.values(clan.inventory || {});
                clan.investments.users ??= {};
                draw();
            }).catch((reason) => {
                body.replaceChildren(ErrorContainer(String(reason)));
                setTimeout(() => go("/clans/discover"), 1500);
            });

            const isOwner = () => String(clan.owner?.id) === String(user.id);
            const reload = (message) => { if (message) success(message); load(); };
            const totalInvested = () => Object.values(clan.investments.users).reduce((a, b) => a + (b || 0), 0);

            const Stat = (ic, title, value) => h("div", { style: { display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: "2px", padding: "8px 14px 10px", borderRadius: "var(--border-radius)", background: "rgba(var(--black), 0.2)", boxShadow: "inset 0 -4px rgba(var(--black), 0.2)", minWidth: 0 } },
                h("div", { style: { fontSize: "14px", opacity: 0.6, display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: "6px", whiteSpace: "nowrap" } },
                    ic.startsWith("fa") ? h("i", { class: ic }) : h("img", { src: ic, style: { width: "15px", height: "15px" } }), title),
                h("div", { style: { fontSize: "19px", fontWeight: 700, whiteSpace: "nowrap", overflow: "hidden", textOverflow: "ellipsis" } }, value));

            function SidePanel() {
                const { level, into, needed } = levelFromExp(clan.exp);
                const Row = (ic, title, value) => h("div", { style: { display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center", gap: "10px", fontSize: "16px" } },
                    h("span", { style: { opacity: 0.6, display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: "7px", whiteSpace: "nowrap" } },
                        ic.startsWith("fa") ? h("i", { class: ic, style: { width: "16px", textAlign: "center" } }) : h("img", { src: ic, style: { width: "16px", height: "16px" } }), title),
                    h("b", { style: { textAlign: "right", overflow: "hidden", textOverflow: "ellipsis", whiteSpace: "nowrap" } }, value));
                return h("div", { class: S("components/Container/container").container, style: { margin: "0", minWidth: "unset", height: "100%", boxSizing: "border-box", overflowY: "auto", gap: "12px" } },
                    h("img", { src: clanImage(clan), style: { width: "100%", aspectRatio: "1", maxHeight: "220px", objectFit: "cover", borderRadius: "var(--border-radius)", boxShadow: "0 0 0 4px rgba(var(--white), 0.1)" } }),
                    h("div", { style: { fontFamily: "var(--heading-font)", fontSize: "32px", lineHeight: 1.1, textAlign: "center", wordBreak: "break-word" } }, ClanName(clan)),
                    clan.description && h("div", { style: { fontSize: "15px", opacity: 0.75, whiteSpace: "pre-wrap", textAlign: "center", lineHeight: 1.4 } }, clan.description),
                    h("div", { style: { display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: "10px" } },
                        h("div", { class: d.levelBarContainer, style: { flex: 1, height: "14px", margin: "0 0 0 16px" } },
                            h("div", { class: d.levelBar }, h("div", { style: { transform: `scaleX(${needed ? into / needed : 0})` } })),
                            h("div", { class: d.levelStarContainer, style: { width: "34px", height: "34px", left: "-17px", top: "calc(50% - 17px)" } },
                                h("img", { src: media("/content/level.png"), draggable: "false" }),
                                h("div", { style: { fontSize: "14px", WebkitTextStroke: "1px #000" } }, String(level)))),
                        h("div", { style: { fontSize: "13px", opacity: 0.6, whiteSpace: "nowrap" } }, `${Math.floor(into).toLocaleString()} / ${Math.ceil(needed).toLocaleString()}`)),
                    h("div", { style: { display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: "7px", padding: "10px 12px", borderRadius: "var(--border-radius)", background: "rgba(var(--black), 0.2)" } },
                        Row("fas fa-crown", "Owner", clan.owner?.username || "Unknown"),
                        Row("fas fa-users", "Members", `${clan.memberCount} (${clan.online ?? 0} online)`),
                        Row(media("/content/experience.png"), "Experience", Math.floor(clan.exp ?? 0).toLocaleString()),
                        Row(media("/content/token.png"), "Invested", totalInvested().toLocaleString()),
                        Row("fas fa-shield", "Shield", clan.shielded ? "Up" : "Down"),
                        Row("fas fa-mask", "Disguise", clan.disguised ? "On" : "Off"),
                        Row("fas fa-lock", "Safe Mode", clan.safe ? "On" : "Off"),
                        Row("fas fa-calendar-alt", "Created", formatDate(clan.created))),
                    h("div", { style: { display: "flex", gap: "8px", justifyContent: "center", flexWrap: "wrap", marginTop: "auto" } },
                        GenericButton({ icon: "fas fa-compass", onClick: () => go("/clans/discover") }, "Discover"),
                        !isOwner() && GenericButton({ icon: "fas fa-door-open", backgroundColor: "#a82a2a", onClick: leave }, "Leave")));
            }

            function Members() {
                const owner = clan.members.find((m) => String(m.id) === String(clan.owner?.id)) || clan.owner;
                const others = clan.members.filter((m) => String(m.id) !== String(clan.owner?.id));
                const card = (member) => {
                    const isClanOwner = member === owner;
                    const el = h("a", {
                        href: `/stats?name=${encodeURIComponent(member.username)}`,
                        class: S("views/Credits/credits").creditContainer,
                        style: { width: "auto", height: "80px", position: "relative", alignItems: "center", gap: "12px" }
                    },
                    h("div", { style: { width: "64px", height: "74px", flexShrink: 0 } }, Blook({ src: blookPath(member.avatar) })),
                    h("div", { style: { display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: "4px", minWidth: 0 } },
                        h("div", { style: { fontSize: "24px", display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: "8px" } },
                            isClanOwner && h("i", { class: "fas fa-crown", style: { color: "gold", fontSize: "18px" } }), Username({ user: member }),
                            plugin("onlineStatus") && Presence(member, { dot: true })),
                        h("div", { style: { fontSize: "15px", opacity: 0.7, display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: "5px" } },
                            h("img", { src: media("/content/token.png"), style: { width: "16px" } }), `${(clan.investments.users[member.id] || 0).toLocaleString()} invested`)),
                    isOwner() && !isClanOwner && tooltip(h("i", {
                        class: "fas fa-user-xmark",
                        style: { position: "absolute", top: "10px", right: "12px", color: "#ff4e4e", fontSize: "18px", cursor: "pointer" },
                        onclick: (e) => {
                            e.preventDefault();
                            e.stopPropagation();
                            confirmModal("Kick Member", `Are you sure you want to kick ${member.username}?`, () =>
                                call("/worker/clans/kick", { user: member.id }).then(() => reload(`Kicked ${member.username}.`)).catch(fail));
                        }
                    }), "Kick"));
                    return el;
                };
                return h("div", { style: { display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "repeat(auto-fill, minmax(300px, 1fr))", gap: "12px" } }, [owner, ...others].filter(Boolean).map(card));
            }

            function Inventory() {
                const ii = S("components/ItemContainer/components/InventoryItem/inventoryItem");
                const tile = (entry) => {
                    const item = v2().items?.[entry.item];
                    if (!item) return null;
                    const owner = clan.members.find((m) => String(m.id) === String(entry.user));
                    const mine = String(entry.user) === String(user.id);
                    return tooltip(h("div", { style: { width: "70px", height: "70px", position: "relative", cursor: mine ? "pointer" : "default" }, onclick: () => mine && takeBack(entry) },
                        h("div", { class: ii.blook, dataset: { square: "true", selectable: String(mine) } },
                            h("img", { src: item.image, class: ii.itemImage, draggable: "false" }),
                            h("div", { class: ii.itemBackground }, h("div", { class: ii.itemBackgroundOverlay, style: { background: item.color || "#2f2f2f", maskImage: `url(${media("/content/rarity-background.png")})`, webkitMaskImage: `url(${media("/content/rarity-background.png")})` } }))),
                        owner && h("img", { src: blookPath(owner.avatar), style: { position: "absolute", left: "-6px", bottom: "-6px", width: "26px" } })),
                    `${entry.item} (${owner?.username ?? "unknown"})${mine ? ", click to take back" : ""}`);
                };

                const takeBack = (entry) => call("/worker/clans/inventory/remove", { item: entry.id }).then(() => {
                    user.inventory.push(entry.item);
                    reload(`Took back your ${entry.item}.`);
                }).catch(fail);

                const add = () => {
                    const counts = ownedItems(user);
                    if (!Object.keys(counts).length) return fail("You don't have any items to add.");
                    const close = openModal(ModalHeader("Add Item"), ModalBody("Which item would you like to put in the clan inventory?"),
                        ModalBody(h("div", { style: { display: "flex", flexWrap: "wrap", gap: "10px", justifyContent: "center", maxWidth: "500px" } },
                            Object.entries(counts).map(([name, amount]) => h("div", { style: { width: "60px", height: "60px" } },
                                InventoryItem({ item: name, amount, onClick: () => call("/worker/clans/inventory/add", { item: name }).then(() => {
                                    user.inventory.splice(user.inventory.indexOf(name), 1);
                                    close();
                                    reload(`Added ${name} to the clan inventory.`);
                                }).catch(fail) }))))),
                        ModalButtons(GenericButton({ onClick: () => close() }, "Cancel")));
                };

                return Container({ style: { margin: "0", minWidth: "unset" } },
                    h("div", { style: { display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center", marginBottom: "15px" } },
                        h("div", { style: { fontSize: "18px", opacity: 0.7 } }, "Items here protect and power up the clan. Click one of yours to take it back."),
                        GenericButton({ icon: "fas fa-plus", onClick: add }, "Add Item")),
                    clan.inventory.length
                        ? h("div", { style: { display: "flex", flexWrap: "wrap", gap: "15px" } }, clan.inventory.map(tile))
                        : h("div", null, "The clan inventory is empty."));
            }

            function Investments() {
                const level = clan.investments.level ?? 1;
                const mine = clan.investments.users[user.id] || 0;
                const tokens = (fn) => (values) => {
                    const amount = parseInt(values[0], 10);
                    if (!amount || amount < 1) return Promise.reject("Please enter a number of tokens.");
                    return fn(amount);
                };
                const invest = () => formModal("Invest Tokens", `How many tokens would you like to invest? You have ${user.tokens.toLocaleString()}.`,
                    [{ icon: "fas fa-coins", placeholder: "Tokens", type: "number" }], "Invest",
                    tokens((amount) => call("/worker/clans/investments/add", { tokens: amount }).then(() => {
                        user.tokens -= amount;
                        mountTopRight(currentPage());
                        reload(`Invested ${amount.toLocaleString()} tokens.`);
                    })));
                const withdraw = () => formModal("Withdraw Tokens", `How many tokens would you like to withdraw? You have ${mine.toLocaleString()} invested.`,
                    [{ icon: "fas fa-coins", placeholder: "Tokens", type: "number" }], "Withdraw",
                    tokens((amount) => call("/worker/clans/investments/remove", { tokens: amount }).then(() => {
                        user.tokens += amount;
                        mountTopRight(currentPage());
                        reload(`Withdrew ${amount.toLocaleString()} tokens.`);
                    })));
                const upgrade = () => {
                    if (level >= 5) return fail("Your clan's investment level is already maxed.");
                    const price = INVEST_PRICES[level - 1];
                    confirmModal("Upgrade", `Upgrade the clan's investment level to ${level + 1} for ${price.toLocaleString()} tokens?`, () =>
                        call("/worker/clans/investments/upgrade", {}).then(() => {
                            user.tokens -= price;
                            mountTopRight(currentPage());
                            reload(`Upgraded investments to level ${level + 1}.`);
                        }).catch(fail));
                };

                return Container({ style: { margin: "0", minWidth: "unset" } },
                    h("div", null, h("b", null, "Investment Level: "), `${level} / 5`),
                    h("div", null, h("b", null, "Hourly Return: "), INVEST_RATES[level] || "0.00%"),
                    h("div", null, h("b", null, "You Have Invested: "), `${mine.toLocaleString()} tokens`),
                    h("div", null, h("b", null, "Clan Total: "), `${totalInvested().toLocaleString()} tokens`),
                    h("div", { style: { display: "flex", gap: "10px", marginTop: "15px", flexWrap: "wrap" } },
                        GenericButton({ icon: "fas fa-arrow-up", onClick: invest }, "Invest"),
                        GenericButton({ icon: "fas fa-arrow-down", onClick: withdraw }, "Withdraw"),
                        isOwner() && level < 5 && GenericButton({ icon: "fas fa-angles-up", onClick: upgrade }, `Upgrade (${INVEST_PRICES[level - 1].toLocaleString()} tokens)`)));
            }

            function Chat() {
                const room = clan.room ?? user.clan?.room;
                if (room == null) return Container({ style: { margin: "0", minWidth: "unset" } }, "Clan chat isn't available right now.");
                const box = h("div", { style: { position: "relative", height: "100%", margin: "0", borderRadius: "var(--border-radius)", background: "var(--primary-color)", boxShadow: "inset 0 -7px rgba(var(--black), 0.2)", overflow: "hidden", transform: "translateZ(0)" } });
                VIEWS.chat.renderRoom(box, { room, name: clan.name, embedded: true });
                return box;
            }

            function Requests() {
                const list = h("div", { style: { display: "flex", flexWrap: "wrap", gap: "15px", justifyContent: "center" } }, "Loading...");
                getJson("/worker/clans/requests/pending").then((res) => {
                    if (res.error) throw res.reason;
                    const requests = res.requests || [];
                    if (!requests.length) return list.replaceChildren("There are no pending requests.");
                    list.replaceChildren(...requests.map((request) => h("div", { class: S("views/Credits/credits").creditContainer, style: { width: "380px", height: "90px", alignItems: "center", gap: "12px", cursor: "default" } },
                        h("div", { style: { width: "75px", height: "85px", flexShrink: 0 } }, Blook({ src: blookPath(request.avatar) })),
                        h("div", { style: { flex: 1, fontSize: "22px" } }, Username({ user: request })),
                        h("div", { style: { display: "flex", gap: "8px" } },
                            GenericButton({ backgroundColor: "#2a8a2a", onClick: () => call("/worker/clans/requests/accept", { user: request.id }).then(() => reload(`Accepted ${request.username}.`)).catch(fail), style: { minWidth: "unset" } }, h("i", { class: "fas fa-check" })),
                            GenericButton({ backgroundColor: "#a82a2a", onClick: () => call("/worker/clans/requests/reject", { user: request.id }).then(() => reload(`Rejected ${request.username}.`)).catch(fail), style: { minWidth: "unset" } }, h("i", { class: "fas fa-times" }))))));
                }).catch((reason) => list.replaceChildren(ErrorContainer(String(reason))));
                return Container({ style: { margin: "0", minWidth: "unset" } }, list);
            }

            function Settings() {
                const ClearButton = (onClick, ...kids) => h("div", { class: S("components/Buttons/ClearButton/clearButton").clearButton, role: "button", onclick: onClick }, ...kids);
                const setting = (path, label, field, current, max) => () => formModal(label, null, [{ ...field, value: current, max }], "Save",
                    ([value]) => call(`/worker/clans/settings/${path}`, { [path]: value }).then(() => reload(`${label} saved.`)));

                const transfer = () => {
                    const others = clan.members.filter((m) => String(m.id) !== String(user.id));
                    if (!others.length) return fail("There's nobody to transfer the clan to.");
                    const close = openModal(ModalHeader("Transfer Ownership"), ModalBody("Who should own the clan?"),
                        ModalBody(h("div", { style: { display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: "8px", maxHeight: "50vh", overflowY: "auto" } },
                            others.map((m) => GenericButton({ onClick: () => {
                                close();
                                formModal("Transfer Ownership", `Confirm with your password to give the clan to ${m.username}.`, secureFields(), "Transfer",
                                    ([password, code]) => call("/worker/clans/settings/transfer-ownership", { password, code, user: m.id }).then(() => reload(`${m.username} now owns the clan.`)));
                            } }, Username({ user: m }))))),
                        ModalButtons(GenericButton({ onClick: () => close() }, "Cancel")));
                };

                const disband = () => formModal("Disband Clan", "This deletes the clan for everyone and can't be undone. Confirm with your password.", secureFields(), "Disband",
                    ([password, code]) => call("/worker/clans/settings/disband", { password, code }).then(() => {
                        success("The clan has been disbanded.");
                        user.clan = null;
                        go("/clans/discover");
                    }));

                const toggle = (path, label) => () => call(`/worker/clans/settings/${path}`, {}).then(() => reload(`${label} updated.`)).catch(fail);

                return Container({ style: { margin: "0", minWidth: "unset" } },
                    h("div", { style: { display: "flex", flexWrap: "wrap", gap: "10px" } },
                        ClearButton(setting("name", "Clan Name", { icon: "fas fa-signature", placeholder: "Clan Name" }, clan.name, "16"), "Change Name"),
                        ClearButton(setting("description", "Clan Description", { icon: "fas fa-align-left", placeholder: "Description" }, clan.description, "128"), "Change Description"),
                        ClearButton(setting("image", "Clan Image", { icon: "fas fa-image", placeholder: "Upload an image", upload: true }, clan.image, "256"), "Change Image"),
                        ClearButton(toggle("reset-color", "Clan color"), "Reset Color"),
                        ClearButton(toggle("safe-mode", "Safe mode"), `Safe Mode: ${clan.safe ? "On" : "Off"}`),
                        ClearButton(toggle("requests", "Join requests"), `Join Requests: ${clan.settings?.requests ? "On" : "Off"}`),
                        ClearButton(transfer, "Transfer Ownership"),
                        ClearButton(disband, h("span", { style: { color: "#ff4e4e" } }, "Disband Clan"))));
            }

            const leave = () => formModal("Leave Clan", `Are you sure you want to leave ${clan.name}? Confirm with your password.`, secureFields(), "Leave",
                ([password, code]) => call("/worker/clans/leave", { password, code }).then(() => {
                    success(`You left ${clan.name}.`);
                    user.clan = null;
                    go("/clans/discover");
                }));

            function draw() {
                const TABS = [
