                    { key: "members", text: "Members", icon: "fas fa-users", render: Members },
                    { key: "chat", text: "Chat", icon: "fas fa-comments", render: Chat },
                    { key: "inventory", text: "Inventory", icon: "fas fa-box-open", render: Inventory },
                    { key: "investments", text: "Investments", icon: "fas fa-coins", render: Investments },
                    isOwner() && { key: "requests", text: "Requests", icon: "fas fa-envelope", render: Requests },
                    isOwner() && { key: "settings", text: "Settings", icon: "fas fa-cog", render: Settings }
                ].filter(Boolean);
                const current = TABS.find((t) => t.key === tab) || TABS[0];
                localStorage.setItem("bv3:clanTab", current.key);

                const content = current.render();
                body.replaceChildren(h("div", { class: "bv3-m-clan", style: { display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "minmax(260px, 320px) minmax(0, 1fr)", gap: "20px", height: "100vh", padding: "20px 2% 20px", boxSizing: "border-box" } },
                    SidePanel(),
                    h("div", { style: { display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: "12px", minHeight: 0, paddingTop: "45px" } },
                        MiniNavbar({ items: TABS.map((t) => ({ text: t.text, icon: t.icon, active: t === current, onClick: () => { tab = t.key; draw(); } })) }),
                        h("div", { class: "bv3-m-clan-content", style: { flex: 1, minHeight: 0, overflowY: current.key === "chat" ? "hidden" : "auto", paddingRight: "4px" } }, content))));
            }

            body.replaceChildren(h("div", { style: { textAlign: "center", fontSize: "20px", margin: "40px" } }, "Loading..."));
            load();
        }

        function renderRoot(root) {
            whenUser().then((user) => go(user.clan ? "/clans/my-clan" : "/clans/discover", true));
            root.append(h("div", { style: { textAlign: "center", fontSize: "20px", margin: "40px" } }, "Loading..."));
        }

        PAGES["/clans"] = { topRight: ["tokens"], pageHeader: "Clans", render: renderRoot };
        PAGES["/clans/discover"] = { topRight: ["tokens"], pageHeader: "Discover Clans", render: renderDiscover };
        PAGES["/clans/my-clan"] = { topRight: ["tokens"], render: renderMyClan };
    })();

    (() => {
        async function render(root) {
            const s = S("views/Credits/credits");
            await whenData();

            const credits = (v2().credits || []).map((c) => ({
                user: { ...(c.user || {}), username: c.user?.username || c.nickname, color: c.user?.color || "#ffffff" },
                avatar: c.image || c.user?.avatar || DEFAULT_AVATAR,
                description: c.note || ""
            }));

            const showCredit = (credit) => {
                const m = S("views/Credits/credits");
                const close = openModal(
                    ModalHeader([h("div", { class: m.creditModalAvatarContainer }, Blook({ className: m.creditModalAvatar, src: credit.avatar })), Username({ user: credit.user })]),
                    ModalBody(credit.description),
                    ModalButtons(
                        GenericButton({ onClick: () => go(`/stats?name=${encodeURIComponent(credit.user.username)}`) }, "View User"),
                        GenericButton({ onClick: () => close() }, "Close")));
            };

            root.append(h("div", { class: s.container }, credits.map((credit) =>
                h("div", { class: s.creditContainer, onclick: () => showCredit(credit) },
                    h("div", { class: s.creditAvatar }, Blook({ src: credit.avatar })),
                    h("div", { class: s.creditRightSide },
                        Username({ user: credit.user, className: s.creditUsername }),
                        h("div", { class: s.creditDescription }, credit.description))))));
        }

        PAGES["/credits"] = { topRight: [], pageHeader: "Credits", render };
    })();

    (() => {
        const StatButton = ({ icon: ic, backgroundColor = "var(--primary-color)", onClick }, ...children) =>
            GenericButton({ icon: ic, backgroundColor, useVhStyles: true, onClick, style: { fontSize: "2vh" } }, ...children);

        function LevelContainer(s, user) {
            const { level, into, needed } = userLevel(user);
            return h("div", { class: s.levelBarContainer },
                h("div", { class: s.levelBar }, h("div", { style: { transform: `scaleX(${needed ? into / needed : 0})` } })),
                h("div", { class: s.levelStarContainer },
                    h("img", { src: media("/content/level.png"), alt: "Level Icon", draggable: "false" }),
                    h("div", null, String(level))));
        }

        function StatContainer(s, title, img, value) {
            return h("div", { class: s.statContainer },
                h("div", { class: s.statHeader },
                    img.startsWith("fa") ? h("i", { class: img, style: { width: "1em", textAlign: "center", marginRight: "0.25em" } }) : h("img", { src: img, draggable: "false" }),
                    title),
                h("div", { class: s.statDivider }),
                h("div", { class: s.statValue }, value));
        }

        const SectionHeader = (s, text) => h("div", { class: s.containerHeader }, h("div", { class: s.containerHeaderInside }, text));

        const FRIEND_DONE = { request: "Friend request sent.", remove: "Friend removed.", cancel: "Friend request revoked.", accept: "Friend request accepted.", decline: "Friend request declined.", block: "User blocked.", unblock: "User unblocked." };
    const friendAction = (path, user) => postJson(`/worker/friends/${path}`, { user: user.username, username: user.username }).then((d) => {
            if (d.error) return errorModal(d.reason || "Something went wrong.");
            if (path === "block") (me().blocks ||= []).push(user.id);
            if (path === "unblock") me().blocks = (me().blocks || []).filter((id) => id !== user.id);
            success(FRIEND_DONE[path]);
            rerender();
        });

        function FriendsContainer(s, onFriendClick) {
            const MODES = { all: "All Friends", requests: "Incoming Requests", sending: "Outgoing Requests" };
            let mode = "all";
            let data = { friends: [], receiving: [], sending: [] };

            const root = h("div", { class: s.friendsContainer });

            const draw = () => {
                const list = mode === "all" ? data.friends : mode === "requests" ? data.receiving : data.sending;
                const rowHeight = Math.max(60, innerHeight / 100 * 8);

                const buttons = h("div", { class: s.friendsViewModeButtons },
                    mode !== "requests" && StatButton({ icon: "fas fa-arrow-up", onClick: () => { mode = "requests"; draw(); } }, "Incoming",
                        h("div", { class: s.requestCount, style: { display: data.receiving.length ? "flex" : "none" } }, h("div", null, String(data.receiving.length)))),
                    mode !== "sending" && StatButton({ icon: "fas fa-arrow-down", onClick: () => { mode = "sending"; draw(); } }, "Outgoing"),
                    mode !== "all" && StatButton({ icon: "fas fa-user", onClick: () => { mode = "all"; draw(); } }, "All"));

                root.replaceChildren(
                    h("div", { class: s.friendsTop },
                        h("p", { class: s.friendsHeader }, "Friends"),
                        h("p", { class: s.friendsMode }, MODES[mode]),
                        buttons),
                    h("div", { class: s.holdFriends },
                        mode === "all" && !list.length && "You don't have any friends. Why don't you make some?",
                        h("div", { class: s.holdFriendsList, style: { overflowY: "auto", overflowX: "hidden" } }, list.map((friend) =>
                            h("div", { class: s.friend, style: { height: `${rowHeight}px` }, onclick: () => onFriendClick(friend) },
                                h("div", { class: s.friendAvatarContainer }, Blook({ className: s.friendAvatar, src: blookPath(friend.avatar) })),
                                h("div", { class: s.friendBannerAndInfo },
                                    h("div", { class: s.friendBanner }, h("img", { src: friend.banner ? (friend.banner.startsWith("/") ? friend.banner : `/content/banners/${friend.banner}.webp`) : "/content/banners/Default.webp", draggable: "false" })),
                                    Username({ user: friend, className: s.friendUsername }),
                                    plugin("onlineStatus") && h("div", { style: { position: "absolute", top: "6px", right: "8px", display: "flex" } }, Presence(friend, { dot: true })),
                                    friend.role && h("span", { class: [s.friendTitle, S("components/Title/title").title] }, friend.role))))))
                );
            };

            draw();
            getJson("/worker2/friends").then((d) => {
                if (d && !d.error) data = { friends: d.friends || [], receiving: d.receiving || [], sending: d.sending || [] };
                draw();
            });
            return root;
        }

        function CosmeticsModal(category) {
            const c = S("views/Dashboard/components/CosmeticsModal/cosmeticsModal");
            const s = S("views/Dashboard/dashboard");
            const user = me();
            const can = (perm) => user.perms?.includes(perm) || user.perms?.includes("*");
            const body = h("div", { class: s.cosmeticsCategoryContainer });

            const apply = (url, payload, done) => postJson(url, payload).then((d) => {
                if (d.error) return errorModal(d.reason || "Something went wrong.");
                done();
                close();
                rerender();
            });

            const setAvatar = (blook) => apply("/worker/cosmetics/avatar", { blook }, () => {
                user.avatar = v2().blooks?.[blook]?.image || blookPath(blook);
                success(`Your avatar is now ${blook}.`);
            });
            const setBanner = (banner) => apply("/worker/cosmetics/banner", { banner }, () => {
                user.banner = v2().banners?.[banner]?.image || user.banner;
                success(`Your banner is now ${banner}.`);
            });

            const search = (placeholder, onInput) => {
                const box = SearchBox({ placeholder, oninput: (e) => onInput(e.target.value) });
                Object.assign(box.style, { padding: "unset", margin: "unset", width: "100%", marginBottom: "10px", boxShadow: "unset" });
                return box;
            };

            const CATEGORIES = {
                Avatar: () => {
                    const grid = h("div", { style: { display: "contents" } });
                    const draw = (q = "") => grid.replaceChildren(ItemContainer({
                        user, options: { showBlooks: true, showItems: false, showPacks: false, showLocked: false, search: q },
                        style: { height: "calc(100% + 150px)" },
                        onClick: ({ name }) => setAvatar(name)
                    }));
                    draw();
                    return [
                        search("Search for a blook...", draw),
                        h("div", { class: c.holder },
                            h("div", { style: { display: "flex", gap: "10px", padding: "10px" } },
                                h("div", { class: c.topBlook, onclick: () => setAvatar("Default") }, h("img", { src: blookPath("Default") }))),
                            grid)
                    ];
                },
                Banner: () => {
                    if (!can("change_banner")) return [h("div", null, "You need Blacket Plus to change your banner."), GenericButton({ to: "/store" }, "Visit the Store")];
                    const list = h("div", { class: c.holder, dataset: { column: "true" } });
                    const draw = (q = "") => list.replaceChildren(...Object.entries(v2().banners || {})
                        .filter(([name]) => name.toLowerCase().includes(q.toLowerCase()))
                        .map(([name, b]) => h("div", { class: c.bannerContainer, onclick: () => setBanner(name) },
                            h("img", { class: c.bannerImage, src: b.image }),
                            h("div", { class: c.bannerName }, `${name} Banner`))));
                    draw();
                    return [search("Search for a banner...", draw), list];
                },
                Color: () => {
                    if (!can("change_color")) return [h("div", null, "You need Blacket Plus to change your name color."), GenericButton({ to: "/store" }, "Visit the Store")];
                    const picker = h("input", { type: "color", value: /^#[0-9a-f]{6}$/i.test(user.color) ? user.color : "#ffffff", style: { width: "150px", height: "60px", border: "none", background: "none", cursor: "pointer" } });
                    const preview = h("div", { class: c.usernameWouldLookLike }, Username({ user }));
                    picker.addEventListener("input", () => preview.replaceChildren(Username({ user: { ...user, color: picker.value } })));
                    return [h("div", { class: c.colorCategoryHolder },
                        preview, picker,
                        h("div", { style: { marginTop: "15px" } }, GenericButton({
                            onClick: () => apply("/worker/settings/color", { color: picker.value }, () => { user.color = picker.value; success("Your name color was changed."); })
                        }, "Save")))];
                }
            };

            const show = (name) => body.replaceChildren(...CATEGORIES[name]());
            const close = openModal(
                h("div", { class: S("components/Modals/ModalHeader/modalHeader").header }, "Cosmetics",
                    GenericButton({ onClick: () => close(), className: s.cosmeticsCloseButton }, h("i", { class: "fas fa-times" }))),
                h("div", { class: S("components/Modals/ModalHeader/modalHeader").divider }),
                h("div", { class: s.cosmeticsButtonContainer }, Object.keys(CATEGORIES).map((name) => GenericButton({ onClick: () => show(name) }, name))),
                body);
            show(category);
        }

        function moreStats(s, user, isMe, friends, badges) {
            if (!plugin("moreStats")) return [];
            const all = v2().blooks || {};
            const owned = Object.entries(user.blooks || {}).filter(([n, c]) => c > 0 && all[n]);
            const rarest = [...owned].sort((a, b) => (all[a[0]].chance ?? 100) - (all[b[0]].chance ?? 100))[0]?.[0];
            const priciest = [...owned].sort((a, b) => (VALUE_OF.get(b[0]) || 0) - (VALUE_OF.get(a[0]) || 0))[0]?.[0];
            const pretty = (key) => key.replace(/([A-Z])/g, " $1").replace(/[_-]/g, " ").replace(/^./, (c) => c.toUpperCase());
            const rows = [
                ["Level", "fas fa-star", userLevel(user).level.toLocaleString()],
                ["Unique Blooks", "fas fa-layer-group", `${owned.length.toLocaleString()} / ${Object.keys(all).length.toLocaleString()}`],
                ["Blooks Owned", "fas fa-cubes", owned.reduce((sum, [, c]) => sum + c, 0).toLocaleString()],
                ["Items", "fas fa-box", (user.inventory || []).length.toLocaleString()],
                ["Rarest Blook", "fas fa-gem", rarest ? `${rarest} (${all[rarest].chance}%)` : "None"],
                ["Most Valuable", "fas fa-crown", priciest && VALUE_OF.get(priciest) ? `${priciest} (${VALUE_OF.get(priciest).toLocaleString()})` : "None"],
                ["Badges", "fas fa-certificate", badges.length.toLocaleString()],
                ["Joined", "fas fa-calendar-alt", user.created ? new Date(user.created * 1000).toLocaleDateString() : "Unknown"],
                user.role && ["Role", "fas fa-id-badge", user.role],
                isMe && ["Friends", "fas fa-user-group", (friends.friends || []).length.toLocaleString()],
                ...Object.entries(user.misc || {}).filter(([k, v]) => typeof v === "number" && !["exp", "opened", "messages"].includes(k))
                    .map(([k, v]) => [pretty(k), "fas fa-chart-simple", v.toLocaleString()])
            ];
            return rows.filter(Boolean).map(([title, ic, value]) => StatContainer(s, title, ic, value));
        }

        function lookupUser() {
            let error = null;
            const input = Input({ icon: "fas fa-user", placeholder: "Username", maxlength: "64", autocomplete: "off" });
            const field = input.querySelector("input");

            const submit = () => {
                const name = field.value.trim();
                error?.remove();
                if (!name) return form.after(error = ErrorContainer("Where's the username?"));
                if (name.includes("%")) return form.after(error = ErrorContainer("Percent signs are not allowed in usernames."));
                go(`/stats?name=${encodeURIComponent(name)}`);
            };

            const form = h("form", { onsubmit: (e) => { e.preventDefault(); submit(); } }, input);
            const close = openModal(
                ModalHeader("Lookup User"),
                ModalBody("Which user's statistics do you wish to lookup?"),
                form,
                ModalButtons(
                    GenericButton({ type: "submit", onClick: submit }, "Lookup"),
                    GenericButton({ onClick: () => close() }, "Cancel")));
            field.focus();
        }

        async function render(root) {
            const s = S("views/Dashboard/dashboard");
            const self = await whenUser();
            await whenData();

            const name = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get("name");
            let viewing = self;
            if (name && name.toLowerCase() !== self.username.toLowerCase()) {
                viewing = await getUser(name);
                if (!viewing) {
                    errorModal("That user could not be found.");
                    viewing = self;
                }
            }
            const isMe = viewing.id === self.id;
            const friends = (await getJson("/worker2/friends").catch(() => null)) || {};
            const has = (list) => (list || []).some((u) => u.id === viewing.id);

            const badges = (viewing.badges || []).map((b) => v2().badges?.[b]).filter(Boolean);
            const blookCount = Object.values(viewing.blooks || {}).filter((n) => n > 0).length;

            const claimable = isMe && (!self.claimed || new Date(self.claimed * 1000).toDateString() !== new Date().toDateString());

            const buttons = [
                StatButton({ icon: "fas fa-user-plus", onClick: lookupUser }, "Lookup User"),
                claimable && StatButton({ icon: "fas fa-star", onClick: () => getJson("/worker/claim").then((d) => d.error ? errorModal(d.reason) : location.reload()) }, "Daily Rewards"),
                StatButton({ icon: "fas fa-cart-shopping", onClick: () => go("/store") }, "Store"),
                isMe && StatButton({ icon: "fas fa-gift", onClick: () => go("/giveaways") }, "Giveaways"),
                isMe && plugin("netWorth") && StatButton({ icon: "fas fa-chart-line", onClick: netWorthModal }, "Net Worth"),
                isMe && plugin("tradeHistory") && StatButton({ icon: "fas fa-clock-rotate-left", onClick: tradeHistoryModal }, "Trade History"),
                !isMe && plugin("userNotes") && StatButton({ icon: "fas fa-note-sticky", onClick: () => editNote(viewing) }, noteOf(viewing.id) ? "Edit Note" : "Add Note"),
                ...(!isMe ? [
                    !has(friends.friends) && !has(friends.sending) && !has(friends.receiving) && !(self.blocks || []).includes(viewing.id)
                        && StatButton({ icon: "fas fa-user-plus", onClick: () => friendAction("request", viewing) }, "Add Friend"),
                    has(friends.friends) && StatButton({ icon: "fas fa-user-xmark", onClick: () => friendAction("remove", viewing) }, "Remove Friend"),
                    has(friends.sending) && StatButton({ icon: "fas fa-user-xmark", onClick: () => friendAction("cancel", viewing) }, "Revoke Request"),
                    ...(has(friends.receiving) ? [
                        StatButton({ icon: "fas fa-user-plus", onClick: () => friendAction("accept", viewing) }, "Accept Request"),
                        StatButton({ icon: "fas fa-user-xmark", onClick: () => friendAction("decline", viewing) }, "Decline Request")
                    ] : []),
                    !(self.blocks || []).includes(viewing.id)
                        ? StatButton({ icon: "fas fa-ban", onClick: () => friendAction("block", viewing) }, "Block User")
                        : StatButton({ icon: "fas fa-handshake", onClick: () => friendAction("unblock", viewing) }, "Unblock User"),
                    StatButton({ icon: "fas fa-arrows-rotate", onClick: () => tradeWith(viewing.username) }, "Trade"),
                    StatButton({ icon: "fas fa-reply", onClick: () => go("/stats") }, "Go Back")
                ] : [])
            ];

            const auctions = h("div", { class: s.userAuctions });
            const noAuctions = () => auctions.replaceChildren(h("div", { class: s.noAuctions }, h("img", { src: media("/content/404.png") }), "No listings found."));
            noAuctions();
            getJson(`/worker/bazaar?item=${encodeURIComponent(viewing.id)}`).then((d) => {
                const list = (d?.bazaar || []).filter((l) => !l.seller || l.seller === viewing.username);
                if (!list.length) return noAuctions();
                auctions.replaceChildren(...list.map((listing) => Auction({ listing, useVhStyles: true, onClick: () => go("/bazaar") })));
            }).catch(noAuctions);

            root.append(h("div", { class: s.parentHolder },
                h("div", { class: [s.section, s.userSection] },
                    h("div", { class: s.userTopProfile },
                        h("div", { class: s.userBannerBlook },
                            h("div", { class: s.userAvatarContainer, dataset: { hoverable: String(isMe) }, onclick: () => isMe && CosmeticsModal("Avatar") },
                                Blook({ className: s.userAvatar, src: avatarOf(viewing) })),
                            h("div", { class: s.bannerLevel },
                                h("div", { class: s.userBanner, dataset: { hoverable: String(isMe) }, onclick: () => isMe && CosmeticsModal("Banner") },
                                    h("img", { src: viewing.banner || "/content/banners/Default.webp", alt: "User Banner", draggable: "false" }),
                                    h("div", { class: s.userInfoContainer },
                                        h("div", { class: s.usernameAndTitleContainer },
                                            h("div", { style: { display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: "6px" } }, Username({ user: viewing, className: s.username, style: { width: "auto" } }), NoteTag(viewing)),
                                            viewing.role && h("span", { class: [s.title, S("components/Title/title").title] }, viewing.role)))),
                                LevelContainer(s, viewing))),
                        h("div", { class: s.statButtonContainer }, buttons),
                        h("div", { class: s.userBadges }, badges.map((b) => tooltip(h("div", { class: s.badgeContainer }, h("img", { src: b.image, draggable: "false" })), b.description || ""))))),

                h("div", { class: [s.section, s.statsSection] },
                    h("div", { class: s.statsContainer, style: { background: "unset", boxShadow: "unset" } },
                        h("div", { class: s.statsContainerHolder },
                            StatContainer(s, "User ID", media("/content/icons/dashboardStatsUserID.png"), String(viewing.id)),
                            viewing.clan && StatContainer(s, "Clan", media("/content/icons/dashboardStatsGuild.png"), viewing.clan.name),
                            StatContainer(s, "Total Blooks", media("/content/icons/dashboardStatsBlooksUnlocked.png"), blookCount.toLocaleString()),
                            StatContainer(s, "Tokens", media("/content/token.png"), (viewing.tokens ?? 0).toLocaleString()),
                            StatContainer(s, "Value", "fas fa-scale-balanced", worth(viewing.blooks).toLocaleString()),
                            StatContainer(s, "Experience", media("/content/experience.png"), Math.floor(userLevel(viewing).total).toLocaleString()),
                            StatContainer(s, "Packs Opened", media("/content/icons/dashboardStatsPacksOpened.png"), (viewing.opened ?? viewing.misc?.opened ?? 0).toLocaleString()),
                            StatContainer(s, "Messages Sent", media("/content/icons/dashboardStatsMessagesSent.png"), (viewing.messages ?? viewing.misc?.messages ?? 0).toLocaleString()),
                            plugin("onlineStatus") && !isMe && StatContainer(s, "Status", "fas fa-signal", Presence(viewing)),
                            ...moreStats(s, viewing, isMe, friends, badges)))),

                h("div", { class: [s.section, s.friendsSection] },
                    FriendsContainer(s, (friend) => go(`/stats?name=${encodeURIComponent(friend.username)}`))),

                h("div", { class: [s.section, s.auctionSection] },
                    SectionHeader(s, "Listings"),
                    h("div", { class: s.statsContainer }, auctions)),

                h("div", { class: [s.section, s.inventorySection] },
                    SectionHeader(s, "Inventory"),
                    h("div", { class: s.statsContainer },
                        h("div", { class: s.inventoryItemsContainer },
                            ItemContainer({
                                user: viewing,
                                options: { showBlooks: true, showLocked: false, showPacks: false, showItems: true },
                                className: s.inventoryItems,
                                onClick: () => go("/blooks")
                            }))))
            ));
        }

        PAGES["/stats"] = { topRight: null, render };
    })();

    function loadLocal(key, fallback) {
        try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(key)) ?? fallback; } catch { return fallback; }
    }
    function saveLocal(key, value) {
        try { localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(value)); } catch { toast({ header: "Storage full", body: "Your browser is out of space for plugin data.", icon: "fas fa-triangle-exclamation" }); }
    }
    const todayKey = () => new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    const TEXTAREA_STYLE = { width: "100%", boxSizing: "border-box", resize: "vertical", padding: "8px 10px", fontSize: "16px", fontFamily: "var(--paragraph-font)", color: "var(--accent-color)", background: "var(--background-color)", border: "none", borderRadius: "var(--border-radius)", outline: "none" };

    function infoModal(title, ...body) {
        const close = openModal(ModalHeader(title), ModalBody(h("div", { style: { width: "min(720px, 85vw)", maxHeight: "65vh", overflowY: "auto", textAlign: "left" } }, ...body)),
            ModalButtons(GenericButton({ onClick: () => close() }, "Close")));
        return close;
    }

    const offerText = (side) => [
        ...Object.entries(side?.blooks || {}).map(([name, n]) => `${n}x ${name}`),
        side?.tokens ? `${Number(side.tokens).toLocaleString()} tokens` : null
    ].filter(Boolean).join(", ") || "nothing";

    function LineChart(points, { width = 600, height = 170, color = "#5fa8ff" } = {}) {
        if (points.length < 2) return h("div", { style: { opacity: 0.6, padding: "10px 0" } }, "Not enough data yet. It fills in as you use the site.");
        const NS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";
        const el = (tag, attrs, text) => {
            const e = document.createElementNS(NS, tag);
            for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(attrs)) e.setAttribute(k, v);
            if (text != null) e.textContent = text;
            return e;
        };
        const values = points.map((p) => p.value);
        const min = Math.min(...values), max = Math.max(...values), span = max - min || 1, pad = 24;
        const x = (i) => pad + i * (width - pad * 2) / (points.length - 1);
        const y = (v) => height - pad - (v - min) / span * (height - pad * 2 - 10);
        const svg = el("svg", { viewBox: `0 0 ${width} ${height}`, width: "100%" });
        svg.append(
            el("polyline", { points: points.map((p, i) => `${x(i)},${y(p.value)}`).join(" "), fill: "none", stroke: color, "stroke-width": 3, "stroke-linejoin": "round" }),
            el("text", { x: pad, y: 14, fill: "currentColor", "font-size": 13, opacity: 0.6 }, `high ${max.toLocaleString()}  ·  low ${min.toLocaleString()}`),
            el("text", { x: pad, y: height - 4, fill: "currentColor", "font-size": 13, opacity: 0.6 }, points[0].label),
            el("text", { x: width - pad, y: height - 4, fill: "currentColor", "font-size": 13, opacity: 0.6, "text-anchor": "end" }, points[points.length - 1].label));
        points.forEach((p, i) => {
            const dot = el("circle", { cx: x(i), cy: y(p.value), r: 4, fill: color });
            dot.append(el("title", {}, `${p.label}: ${p.value.toLocaleString()}`));
            svg.append(dot);
        });
        return h("div", { style: { color: "var(--accent-color)", width: "100%" } }, svg);
    }

    const NOTES_KEY = "bv3:userNotes";
    const noteOf = (id) => plugin("userNotes") ? loadLocal(NOTES_KEY, {})[String(id)] || "" : "";
    function editNote(user) {
        const box = h("textarea", { rows: "3", maxlength: "300", placeholder: "Only you can see this", style: TEXTAREA_STYLE });
        box.value = loadLocal(NOTES_KEY, {})[String(user.id)] || "";
        const save = () => {
            const notes = loadLocal(NOTES_KEY, {});
            const text = box.value.trim();
            if (text) notes[String(user.id)] = text; else delete notes[String(user.id)];
            saveLocal(NOTES_KEY, notes);
            close();
            success(text ? `Saved your note on ${user.username}.` : `Removed your note on ${user.username}.`);
        };
        const close = openModal(ModalHeader(`Note on ${user.username}`), ModalBody(h("div", { style: { width: "min(460px, 80vw)" } }, box)),
            ModalButtons(GenericButton({ onClick: save }, "Save"), GenericButton({ onClick: () => close() }, "Cancel")));
        box.focus();
    }
    function NoteTag(user) {
        const note = noteOf(user?.id);
        return note ? tooltip(h("i", { class: "fas fa-note-sticky", style: { color: "#ffd84d", fontSize: "0.8em", cursor: "help" } }), note) : null;
    }

    const MUTED_KEY = "bv3:muted";
    const isMuted = (id) => plugin("muteUsers") && loadLocal(MUTED_KEY, []).some((u) => String(u.id) === String(id));
    function toggleMute(user) {
        const list = loadLocal(MUTED_KEY, []);
        const muted = list.some((u) => String(u.id) === String(user.id));
        saveLocal(MUTED_KEY, muted ? list.filter((u) => String(u.id) !== String(user.id)) : [...list, { id: user.id, username: user.username }]);
        success(muted ? `Unmuted ${user.username}.` : `Muted ${user.username}. Their messages are hidden for you.`);
        return !muted;
    }
    function mutedModal() {
        const body = h("div", { style: { display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: "8px" } });
        const draw = () => {
            const list = loadLocal(MUTED_KEY, []);
            body.replaceChildren(...(list.length ? list.map((u) => h("div", { style: { display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center", padding: "6px 12px", borderRadius: "var(--border-radius)", background: "rgba(var(--black), 0.2)" } },
                h("span", null, u.username), GenericButton({ onClick: () => { toggleMute(u); draw(); } }, "Unmute")))
                : [h("div", { style: { opacity: 0.6 } }, "Nobody's muted. Right click someone in chat to mute them.")]));
        };
        draw();
        infoModal("Muted Users", body);
    }

    const MENTIONS_KEY = "bv3:mentions";
    const plainMessage = (content) => String(content || "")
        .replace(/^From <@[^>]+>: [^\n]*\n?/, "")
        .replace(/<@([0-9A-Za-z-]+)>/g, (m, id) => String(id) === String(me()?.id) ? "@you" : "@someone")
        .replace(/<\/?[^>]+>/g, "");

    function mentionsModal() {
        const list = loadLocal(MENTIONS_KEY, []);
        const body = h("div", { style: { display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: "8px" } });
        const close = infoModal("Mentions", body);
        body.replaceChildren(...(list.length ? [
            GenericButton({ icon: "fas fa-trash", onClick: () => { saveLocal(MENTIONS_KEY, []); close(); success("Cleared your mentions."); } }, "Clear All"),
            ...list.map((m) => h("div", {
                style: { display: "flex", gap: "10px", padding: "8px 10px", borderRadius: "var(--border-radius)", background: "rgba(var(--black), 0.2)", cursor: "pointer" },
                onclick: () => { close(); String(m.room) === "0" ? showView("chat") : go("/clans/my-clan"); }
            },
            h("div", { style: { width: "36px", height: "42px", flexShrink: 0 } }, Blook({ src: blookPath(m.author.avatar) })),
            h("div", { style: { minWidth: 0 } },
                h("div", { style: { display: "flex", gap: "8px", alignItems: "center" } }, Username({ user: m.author }),
                    h("span", { style: { fontSize: "13px", opacity: 0.5 } }, `${new Date(m.date).toLocaleString()}${String(m.room) === "0" ? "" : " · clan chat"}`)),
                h("div", { style: { fontSize: "16px", wordBreak: "break-word" } }, m.text))))
        ] : [h("div", { style: { opacity: 0.6 } }, "Nobody has pinged you yet.")]));
    }

    let chimeContext;
    function chime() {
        try {
            chimeContext ??= new AudioContext();
            [660, 990].forEach((freq, i) => {
                const osc = chimeContext.createOscillator(), gain = chimeContext.createGain();
                const at = chimeContext.currentTime + i * 0.1;
                osc.frequency.value = freq;
                gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.12, at);
                gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, at + 0.2);
                osc.connect(gain).connect(chimeContext.destination);
                osc.start(at);
                osc.stop(at + 0.2);
            });
        } catch { }
    }

    const alertWords = () => String(pluginValue("alertWords", "")).split(",").map((w) => w.trim().toLowerCase()).filter(Boolean);

    onSocket(({ event, data, error }) => {
        const self = me();
        if (error || !self) return;
        if (event === "booster") return boosterAlert(data);
        if (event !== "messages-create" || !data?.message || String(data.author?.id) === String(self.id) || isMuted(data.author?.id)) return;
        const content = String(data.message.content || "");
        const text = plainMessage(content);
        const mentioned = (data.message.mentions || []).map(String).includes(String(self.id)) || content.includes(`<@${self.id}>`);
        if (mentioned && plugin("mentionsInbox")) {
            const a = data.author;
            saveLocal(MENTIONS_KEY, [{ id: data.message.id, room: data.room?.id ?? 0, date: Date.now(), text: text.slice(0, 300), author: { id: a.id, username: a.username, avatar: a.avatar, color: a.color } },
                ...loadLocal(MENTIONS_KEY, [])].slice(0, 200));
        }
        if (!mentioned && plugin("keywordAlerts")) {
            const word = alertWords().find((w) => text.toLowerCase().includes(w));
            if (!word) return;
            chime();
            if (activeView !== "chat") toast({ header: `${data.author.username} said "${word}"`, body: text.slice(0, 140), icon: blookPath(data.author.avatar), expires: 8000, onClick: () => showView("chat") });
        }
    });

    function boosterAlert(booster) {
        if (!plugin("boosterAlert") || !booster) return;
        const ends = booster.time ? booster.time * 1000 : booster.endsAt;
        if (!ends || ends < Date.now() || booster.active === false || localStorage.getItem("bv3:boosterSeen") === String(ends)) return;
        try { localStorage.setItem("bv3:boosterSeen", String(ends)); } catch { }
        const who = booster.activatedBy || booster.username;
        const show = (name) => toast({ header: "Booster active!", expires: 10000, icon: "fas fa-rocket",
            body: `${name ? `${name} is boosting` : "Everyone's chances are boosted"} ${booster.multiplier || 2}x for ${formatDuration(ends - Date.now())}. Go open some packs.`, onClick: () => go("/market") });
        if (who || !booster.user) return show(who);
        getUser(booster.user).then((u) => show(u?.username));
    }

    const TRADES_KEY = "bv3:tradeHistory";
    function recordTrade(other, gave, got) {
        if (!plugin("tradeHistory")) return;
        const copy = (side) => ({ blooks: { ...(side.blooks || {}) }, tokens: Number(side.tokens) || 0 });
        saveLocal(TRADES_KEY, [{ date: Date.now(), with: { id: other.id, username: other.username, avatar: other.avatar, color: other.color }, gave: copy(gave), got: copy(got) },
            ...loadLocal(TRADES_KEY, [])].slice(0, 300));
    }
    function tradeHistoryModal() {
        const list = loadLocal(TRADES_KEY, []);
        const value = (side) => worth(side.blooks) + side.tokens;
        const body = h("div", { style: { display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: "10px" } });
        const close = infoModal("Trade History", body);
        body.replaceChildren(...(list.length ? [
            GenericButton({ icon: "fas fa-trash", onClick: () => confirmModal("Clear History", "Delete your saved trade history?", () => { saveLocal(TRADES_KEY, []); close(); }) }, "Clear History"),
            ...list.map((t) => {
                const diff = value(t.got) - value(t.gave);
                return h("div", { style: { display: "flex", gap: "12px", padding: "10px 12px", borderRadius: "var(--border-radius)", background: "rgba(var(--black), 0.2)" } },
                    h("div", { style: { width: "40px", height: "46px", flexShrink: 0 } }, Blook({ src: blookPath(t.with.avatar) })),
                    h("div", { style: { flex: 1, minWidth: 0, fontSize: "16px" } },
                        h("div", { style: { display: "flex", gap: "8px", alignItems: "center", flexWrap: "wrap" } }, Username({ user: t.with }),
                            h("span", { style: { fontSize: "13px", opacity: 0.5 } }, new Date(t.date).toLocaleString()),
                            h("span", { style: { fontSize: "14px", fontWeight: 700, color: diff > 0 ? "#7dff7d" : diff < 0 ? "#ff8a8a" : null } },
                                diff === 0 ? "even" : `${diff > 0 ? "+" : ""}${diff.toLocaleString()} value`)),
                        h("div", null, h("b", null, "Gave: "), offerText(t.gave)),
                        h("div", null, h("b", null, "Got: "), offerText(t.got))));
            })
        ] : [h("div", { style: { opacity: 0.6 } }, "No trades yet. Finished trades show up here.")]));
    }

    const PRESETS_KEY = "bv3:tradePresets";
    function presetsModal(current, apply) {
        const body = h("div", { style: { display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: "8px" } });
        const name = Input({ icon: "fas fa-tag", placeholder: "Name this offer", maxlength: "40" });
        Object.assign(name.style, { margin: "0", width: "100%", maxWidth: "none" });
        const draw = () => {
            const list = loadLocal(PRESETS_KEY, []);
            body.replaceChildren(
                h("div", { style: { display: "flex", gap: "10px", alignItems: "center" } }, name, GenericButton({ icon: "fas fa-floppy-disk", onClick: () => {
                    const label = name.querySelector("input").value.trim() || `Offer ${list.length + 1}`;
                    if (!Object.keys(current().blooks).length && !current().tokens) return toast({ header: "Quick Offers", body: "Put something in your offer first.", icon: "fas fa-info-circle" });
                    saveLocal(PRESETS_KEY, [{ name: label, blooks: { ...current().blooks }, tokens: current().tokens }, ...list.filter((p) => p.name !== label)]);
                    name.querySelector("input").value = "";
                    draw();
                }, style: { flexShrink: 0, whiteSpace: "nowrap" } }, "Save")),
                ...(list.length ? list.map((p) => h("div", { style: { display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: "10px", padding: "6px 10px", borderRadius: "var(--border-radius)", background: "rgba(var(--black), 0.2)" } },
                    h("div", { style: { flex: 1, minWidth: 0 } }, h("b", null, p.name), h("div", { style: { fontSize: "14px", opacity: 0.7 } }, offerText(p))),
                    GenericButton({ onClick: () => { close(); apply(p); } }, "Load"),
                    tooltip(h("i", { class: "fas fa-trash", style: { cursor: "pointer", color: "#ff6b6b", padding: "6px" }, onclick: () => { saveLocal(PRESETS_KEY, list.filter((x) => x !== p)); draw(); } }), "Delete")))
                    : [h("div", { style: { opacity: 0.6 } }, "No saved offers yet.")]));
        };
        draw();
        const close = infoModal("Quick Offers", body);
    }

    let friendIds = null, friendIdsAt = 0;
    async function shouldDecline(user) {
        if (!plugin("autoDecline") || !user) return false;
        const always = String(pluginValue("declineList", "")).split(/[\n,]/).map((n) => n.trim().toLowerCase()).filter(Boolean);
        if (always.includes(String(user.username).toLowerCase())) return true;
        if (!friendIds || Date.now() - friendIdsAt > 60 * 1000) {
            const d = await getJson("/worker2/friends");
            if (d?.error) return false;
            friendIds = new Set((d?.friends || []).map((f) => String(f.id)));
            friendIdsAt = Date.now();
        }
        return !friendIds.has(String(user.id));
    }

    const PULLS_KEY = "bv3:pullStats";
    const expectedPull = (pack) => {
        const blooks = pack.blooks || [];
        const total = blooks.reduce((sum, b) => sum + (v2().blooks?.[b]?.chance || 0), 0);
        return total ? blooks.reduce((sum, b) => sum + (v2().blooks?.[b]?.chance || 0) * (VALUE_OF.get(b) || 0), 0) / total : 0;
    };
    function recordPull(packName, pack, blook) {
        if (!plugin("pullStats")) return;
        const stats = loadLocal(PULLS_KEY, { packs: {}, rare: [] });
        const p = stats.packs[packName] ??= { opened: 0, spent: 0, value: 0, expected: 0 };
        p.opened++;
        p.spent += pack.price || 0;
        p.value += VALUE_OF.get(blook) || 0;
        p.expected += expectedPull(pack);
        const chance = v2().blooks?.[blook]?.chance ?? 100;
        stats.rare = [...stats.rare, { blook, chance, pack: packName, date: Date.now() }].sort((a, b) => a.chance - b.chance).slice(0, 15);
        saveLocal(PULLS_KEY, stats);
    }
    function pullStatsModal() {
        const stats = loadLocal(PULLS_KEY, { packs: {}, rare: [] });
        const rows = Object.entries(stats.packs).sort((a, b) => b[1].opened - a[1].opened);
        const sum = (k) => rows.reduce((a, [, p]) => a + p[k], 0);
        const luck = (p) => p.expected ? `${Math.round(p.value / p.expected * 100)}%` : "?";
        const cell = (text, bold) => h(bold ? "th" : "td", { style: { padding: "6px 10px", textAlign: "left", whiteSpace: "nowrap" } }, text);
        const close = infoModal("Pull Stats", rows.length ? [
            h("div", { style: { marginBottom: "10px", opacity: 0.8 } }, "Luck is the value you pulled against the average for those packs. Over 100% means you've been lucky."),
            h("table", { style: { width: "100%", borderCollapse: "collapse", fontSize: "16px" } },
                h("tr", null, ...["Pack", "Opened", "Spent", "Value Pulled", "Luck"].map((t) => cell(t, true))),
                ...rows.map(([name, p]) => h("tr", null, cell(name), cell(p.opened.toLocaleString()), cell(p.spent.toLocaleString()), cell(Math.round(p.value).toLocaleString()), cell(luck(p)))),
                h("tr", { style: { fontWeight: 700 } }, cell("Total"), cell(sum("opened").toLocaleString()), cell(sum("spent").toLocaleString()), cell(Math.round(sum("value")).toLocaleString()),
                    cell(luck({ value: sum("value"), expected: sum("expected") })))),
            h("div", { style: { margin: "16px 0 8px", fontWeight: 700 } }, "Rarest Pulls"),
            h("div", { style: { display: "flex", flexWrap: "wrap", gap: "10px" } }, stats.rare.map((r) => tooltip(h("div", { style: { width: "60px", height: "70px" } }, InventoryItem({ blook: r.blook, amount: 1, hideCount: true })),
                `${r.blook} (${r.chance}%) from ${r.pack}, ${new Date(r.date).toLocaleDateString()}`))),
            h("div", { style: { marginTop: "14px" } }, GenericButton({ icon: "fas fa-trash", onClick: () => confirmModal("Reset Stats", "Delete your pull stats?", () => { saveLocal(PULLS_KEY, { packs: {}, rare: [] }); close(); }) }, "Reset"))
        ] : h("div", { style: { opacity: 0.6 } }, "Open some packs and your stats show up here."));
    }

    const PRICES_KEY = "bv3:priceHistory";
    function recordPrices(listings) {
        if (!plugin("priceHistory") || !listings?.length) return;
        const history = loadLocal(PRICES_KEY, {});
        const day = todayKey();
        for (const l of listings) {
            if (!l?.item || !(l.price > 0)) continue;
            const item = history[l.item] ??= {};
            item[day] = Math.min(item[day] ?? Infinity, l.price);
            const days = Object.keys(item).sort();
            for (const old of days.slice(0, Math.max(0, days.length - 90))) delete item[old];
        }
        saveLocal(PRICES_KEY, history);
    }
    const priceHistoryOf = (item) => Object.entries(loadLocal(PRICES_KEY, {})[item] || {}).sort(([a], [b]) => a.localeCompare(b))
        .map(([day, value]) => ({ label: new Date(day).toLocaleDateString(), value }));
    function priceHistoryModal(item) {
        infoModal(`${item} Price History`,
            h("div", { style: { marginBottom: "8px", opacity: 0.8 } }, "The lowest Bazaar price this browser saw each day."),
            LineChart(priceHistoryOf(item)));
    }

    const WISHLIST_KEY = "bv3:wishlist";
    const isWished = (name) => plugin("wishlist") && loadLocal(WISHLIST_KEY, []).includes(name);
    function toggleWish(name) {
        const list = loadLocal(WISHLIST_KEY, []);
        const wished = list.includes(name);
        saveLocal(WISHLIST_KEY, wished ? list.filter((n) => n !== name) : [...list, name]);
        success(wished ? `Removed ${name} from your wishlist.` : `Added ${name} to your wishlist.`);
        return !wished;
    }
    const WishStar = (style) => h("i", { class: "fas fa-star", style: { position: "absolute", top: "-2px", right: "-2px", color: "gold", fontSize: "14px", filter: "drop-shadow(0 0 2px #000)", zIndex: 2, pointerEvents: "none", ...style } });
    function wishlistModal() {
        const body = h("div", { style: { display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: "10px" } });
        const names = Object.keys(v2().blooks || {});
        const listId = "bv3-blook-names";
        const input = Input({ icon: "fas fa-star", placeholder: "Add a blook", list: listId });
        Object.assign(input.style, { margin: "0", width: "100%", maxWidth: "none" });
        const add = () => {
            const typed = input.querySelector("input").value.trim();
            const name = names.find((n) => n.toLowerCase() === typed.toLowerCase());
            if (!name) return toast({ header: "Wishlist", body: "That isn't a blook.", icon: "fas fa-info-circle" });
            if (!loadLocal(WISHLIST_KEY, []).includes(name)) toggleWish(name);
            input.querySelector("input").value = "";
            draw();
        };
        input.querySelector("input").addEventListener("keydown", (e) => { if (e.key === "Enter") add(); });
        const draw = () => {
            const list = loadLocal(WISHLIST_KEY, []);
            body.replaceChildren(
                h("datalist", { id: listId }, names.map((n) => h("option", { value: n }))),
                h("div", { style: { display: "flex", gap: "10px", alignItems: "center" } }, input, GenericButton({ onClick: add }, "Add")),
                list.length ? h("div", { style: { display: "flex", flexWrap: "wrap", gap: "12px" } }, list.map((name) => tooltip(h("div", { style: { width: "60px", height: "70px" } },
                    InventoryItem({ blook: name, amount: me()?.blooks?.[name] || 0, locked: !(me()?.blooks?.[name] > 0), onClick: () => go(`/bazaar?item=${encodeURIComponent(name)}`) })),
                `${name}, click to find it on the Bazaar`)))
                    : h("div", { style: { opacity: 0.6 } }, "Nothing on your wishlist yet."),
                ...(list.length ? [GenericButton({ icon: "fas fa-trash", onClick: () => { saveLocal(WISHLIST_KEY, []); draw(); } }, "Clear")] : []));
        };
        draw();
        infoModal("Wishlist", body);
    }

    const WORTH_KEY = "bv3:netWorth";
    function recordWorth(user) {
        if (!plugin("netWorth") || !user?.blooks) return;
        const history = loadLocal(WORTH_KEY, {});
        history[todayKey()] = { value: worth(user.blooks), tokens: user.tokens ?? 0 };
        const days = Object.keys(history).sort();
        for (const old of days.slice(0, Math.max(0, days.length - 365))) delete history[old];
        saveLocal(WORTH_KEY, history);
    }
    function netWorthModal() {
        recordWorth(me());
        const days = Object.entries(loadLocal(WORTH_KEY, {})).sort(([a], [b]) => a.localeCompare(b));
        const points = (k) => days.map(([day, d]) => ({ label: new Date(day).toLocaleDateString(), value: d[k] }));
        infoModal("Net Worth",
            h("div", { style: { fontWeight: 700, margin: "4px 0" } }, "Blook value"), LineChart(points("value")),
            h("div", { style: { fontWeight: 700, margin: "14px 0 4px" } }, "Tokens"), LineChart(points("tokens"), { color: "#ffc94d" }),
            h("div", { style: { fontWeight: 700, margin: "14px 0 4px" } }, "Total"), LineChart(days.map(([day, d]) => ({ label: new Date(day).toLocaleDateString(), value: d.value + d.tokens })), { color: "#5fe35f" }));
    }

    function sessionStart() {
        let start;
        try { start = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem("bv3:session")); } catch { }
        const user = me();
        if (!start && user) {
            start = { at: Date.now(), tokens: user.tokens ?? 0, exp: userLevel(user).total };
            try { sessionStorage.setItem("bv3:session", JSON.stringify(start)); } catch { }
        }
        return start;
    }
    function SessionPill(t) {
        const el = h("div", { class: [t.balance, "bv3-session"], style: { fontSize: "16px", gap: "10px" } });
        const update = () => {
            const start = sessionStart(), user = me();
            if (!start || !user) return;
            const tokens = (user.tokens ?? 0) - start.tokens;
            const exp = Math.floor(userLevel(user).total - start.exp);
            const sign = (n) => (n > 0 ? "+" : "") + n.toLocaleString();
            el.replaceChildren(h("i", { class: "fas fa-stopwatch", style: { opacity: 0.7 } }), formatDuration(Date.now() - start.at).replace(/ \d+s$/, ""),
                h("span", { style: { color: tokens > 0 ? "#7dff7d" : tokens < 0 ? "#ff8a8a" : null } }, `${sign(tokens)} tokens`),
                ...(exp > 0 ? [h("span", { style: { opacity: 0.8 } }, `${sign(exp)} exp`)] : []));
        };
        update();
        const timer = setInterval(() => (el.isConnected ? update() : clearInterval(timer)), 15000);
        return tooltip(el, "Since you opened Blacket in this tab");
    }

    function customBackground() {
        if (!plugin("customBackground")) return "";
        try { return localStorage.getItem("bv3:bgImage") || ""; } catch { return ""; }
    }
    function backgroundModal() {
        const url = Input({ icon: "fas fa-link", placeholder: "Image link (https://...)" });
        Object.assign(url.style, { margin: "0", width: "100%", maxWidth: "none" });
        const set = (value) => {
            try { value ? localStorage.setItem("bv3:bgImage", value) : localStorage.removeItem("bv3:bgImage"); }
            catch { return errorModal("That picture is too big to save. Try one under 3 MB or use a link."); }
            if (!plugin("customBackground")) setPlugin("customBackground", true);
            applyTheme();
            close();
        };
        const pick = () => {
            const picker = h("input", { type: "file", accept: "image/*" });
            picker.onchange = () => {
                const file = picker.files[0];
                if (!file) return;
                if (file.size > 3 * 1024 * 1024) return errorModal("That picture is too big. Use one under 3 MB or a link.");
                const reader = new FileReader();
                reader.onload = () => set(reader.result);
                reader.readAsDataURL(file);
            };
            picker.click();
        };
        const close = openModal(ModalHeader("Custom Background"),
            ModalBody(h("div", { style: { width: "min(460px, 80vw)", display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: "10px" } }, url,
                h("div", { style: { fontSize: "15px", opacity: 0.6 } }, "Or pick a picture from your computer. It's saved in this browser only."))),
            ModalButtons(
                GenericButton({ onClick: () => { const v = url.querySelector("input").value.trim(); if (/^https?:\/\//.test(v)) set(v); else toast({ header: "Background", body: "Paste a link starting with https://", icon: "fas fa-info-circle" }); } }, "Use Link"),
                GenericButton({ icon: "fas fa-upload", onClick: pick }, "Pick File"),
                GenericButton({ onClick: () => set("") }, "Remove")));
    }

    function sidebarPages() {
        if (!plugin("sidebarEditor")) return SIDEBAR_PAGES;
        const order = pluginValue("sidebarOrder", []), hidden = pluginValue("sidebarHidden", []);
        const rank = (p) => { const i = order.indexOf(p.text); return i < 0 ? 1000 + SIDEBAR_PAGES.indexOf(p) : i; };
        return [...SIDEBAR_PAGES].sort((a, b) => rank(a) - rank(b)).filter((p) => p.text === "Plugins" || !hidden.includes(p.text));
    }
    function sidebarEditorModal() {
        const body = h("div", { style: { display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: "6px", width: "min(420px, 80vw)" } });
        const draw = () => {
            const hidden = pluginValue("sidebarHidden", []);
            const order = [...SIDEBAR_PAGES].sort((a, b) => {
                const o = pluginValue("sidebarOrder", []);
                const r = (p) => { const i = o.indexOf(p.text); return i < 0 ? 1000 + SIDEBAR_PAGES.indexOf(p) : i; };
                return r(a) - r(b);
            }).map((p) => p.text);
            const move = (i, d) => {
                const next = [...order];
                [next[i], next[i + d]] = [next[i + d], next[i]];
                setPlugin("sidebarOrder", next);
                refreshSidebar();
                draw();
            };
            const icon = (cls, onClick, hide) => h("i", { class: cls, style: { cursor: "pointer", padding: "6px", opacity: hide ? 0.2 : 0.8, pointerEvents: hide ? "none" : null }, onclick: onClick });
            body.replaceChildren(...order.map((text, i) => {
                const page = SIDEBAR_PAGES.find((p) => p.text === text);
                const off = hidden.includes(text);
                return h("div", { style: { display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: "10px", padding: "4px 10px", borderRadius: "var(--border-radius)", background: "rgba(var(--black), 0.2)", opacity: off ? 0.5 : 1 } },
                    h("i", { class: page.icon, style: { width: "22px", textAlign: "center" } }),
                    h("span", { style: { flex: 1, textAlign: "left" } }, text),
                    icon("fas fa-arrow-up", () => move(i, -1), i === 0),
                    icon("fas fa-arrow-down", () => move(i, 1), i === order.length - 1),
                    icon(off ? "fas fa-eye-slash" : "fas fa-eye", () => {
                        setPlugin("sidebarHidden", off ? hidden.filter((t) => t !== text) : [...hidden, text]);
                        refreshSidebar();
                        draw();
                    }, text === "Plugins"));
            }), GenericButton({ onClick: () => { setPlugin("sidebarOrder", []); setPlugin("sidebarHidden", []); refreshSidebar(); draw(); } }, "Reset"));
        };
        if (!plugin("sidebarEditor")) setPlugin("sidebarEditor", true);
        draw();
        infoModal("Sidebar Editor", body);
    }

    function quickSearch() {
        if (document.querySelector(".bv3-quick-search")) return;
        const field = h("input", { placeholder: "Go to a page, find a blook, or look up a user...", style: { ...TEXTAREA_STYLE, fontSize: "20px", padding: "12px 14px" } });
        const results = h("div", { style: { display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: "2px", maxHeight: "50vh", overflowY: "auto", marginTop: "10px" } });
        let options = [], picked = 0;
        const run = (o) => { close(); o.run(); };
        const draw = () => {
            const q = field.value.trim(), lower = q.toLowerCase();
            options = [
                ...sidebarPages().filter((p) => p.text.toLowerCase().includes(lower)).map((p) => ({ icon: p.icon, text: p.text, hint: "page", run: () => (p.view ? showView(p.view) : go(p.link)) })),
                ...(q ? Object.keys(v2().blooks || {}).filter((n) => n.toLowerCase().includes(lower)).slice(0, 6)
                    .map((n) => ({ img: v2().blooks[n].image, text: n, hint: "find on the Bazaar", run: () => go(`/bazaar?item=${encodeURIComponent(n)}`) })) : []),
                ...(q && !/\s/.test(q) ? [
                    { icon: "fas fa-user", text: `Look up ${q}`, hint: "profile", run: () => go(`/stats?name=${encodeURIComponent(q)}`) },
                    { icon: "fas fa-box-open", text: `${q}'s blooks`, hint: "inventory", run: () => go(`/blooks?name=${encodeURIComponent(q)}`) }
                ] : [])
            ];
            picked = Math.min(picked, Math.max(0, options.length - 1));
            results.replaceChildren(...options.map((o, i) => h("div", { class: "bv3-search-row", dataset: { selected: String(i === picked) }, onclick: () => run(o) },
                o.img ? h("img", { src: o.img, style: { width: "26px", height: "26px", objectFit: "contain" } }) : h("i", { class: o.icon, style: { width: "26px", textAlign: "center" } }),
                h("span", { style: { flex: 1 } }, o.text),
                h("span", { style: { fontSize: "14px", opacity: 0.5 } }, o.hint))));
        };
        field.addEventListener("input", () => { picked = 0; draw(); });
        field.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
            if (e.key === "ArrowDown" || e.key === "ArrowUp") {
                e.preventDefault();
                picked = (picked + (e.key === "ArrowDown" ? 1 : options.length - 1)) % Math.max(1, options.length);
                draw();
            } else if (e.key === "Enter" && options[picked]) run(options[picked]);
            else if (e.key === "Escape") close();
        });
        const close = openModal(h("div", { class: "bv3-quick-search", style: { width: "min(600px, 85vw)", padding: "16px 16px 8px" } }, field, results));
        draw();
        field.focus();
    }
    document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
        if (!plugin("quickSearch") || !navigateTo || e.key.toLowerCase() !== "k" || !(e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey)) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        quickSearch();
    });

    function startExtras(user) {
        recordWorth(user);
        sessionStart();
        whenData().then(() => boosterAlert(v2().booster));
    }

    (() => {
        const call = (url, body) => postJson(url, body).then((d) => {
            if (d.error) throw d.reason || "Something went wrong.";
            return d;
        });
        const fail = (reason) => toast({ header: "Error", body: String(reason), icon: "fas fa-times-circle" });

        const blookList = (g) => Array.isArray(g.blooks) ? g.blooks.map((name) => [name, 1]) : Object.entries(g.blooks || {});
        const toMs = (t) => typeof t === "number" && t < 1e12 ? t * 1000 : +new Date(t);
        const ended = (g) => toMs(g.endsAt) <= Date.now();
        const giveawayImage = (g) => g.image || "/content/giveaway.png";

        function Rewards(g, size = 50) {
            const tile = (src, label, amount, color) => tooltip(h("div", { style: { position: "relative", width: `${size}px`, height: `${size + 6}px` } },
                Blook({ src }),
                amount > 1 && h("div", { style: { position: "absolute", bottom: "-2px", right: "-4px", fontFamily: "var(--heading-font)", fontSize: "13px", padding: "0 5px", borderRadius: "var(--border-radius)", background: "rgba(var(--black), 0.6)", color: color || null } }, `x${amount.toLocaleString()}`)),
            label);
            const blooks = blookList(g).sort((a, b) => (v2().blooks?.[a[0]]?.chance ?? 100) - (v2().blooks?.[b[0]]?.chance ?? 100));
            return h("div", { style: { display: "flex", flexWrap: "wrap", gap: "8px", alignItems: "center" } },
                g.tokens > 0 && tile(media("/content/token.png"), `${g.tokens.toLocaleString()} tokens`, g.tokens),
                blooks.map(([name, amount]) => tile(v2().blooks?.[name]?.image || blookPath(name), name, amount, rarityColor(name) === "rainbow" ? null : rarityColor(name))));
        }

        const Countdown = (g) => {
            const el = h("span");
            const tick = () => {
                if (!el.isConnected && el.dataset.started) return clearInterval(timer);
                el.dataset.started = "1";
                el.textContent = ended(g) ? "Ended" : `Ends in ${formatDuration(toMs(g.endsAt) - Date.now())}`;
            };
            const timer = setInterval(tick, 1000);
            tick();
            return el;
        };

        function GiveawayCard(g, onClick) {
            const s = S("views/News/news");
            return h("div", { class: s.postContainer, style: { width: "320px", height: "400px", opacity: ended(g) ? 0.6 : 1 }, onclick: onClick },
                h("div", { class: s.postTopContainer, style: { height: "160px" } },
                    h("img", { class: s.postImage, src: giveawayImage(g), draggable: "false", onerror: function () { this.onerror = null; this.src = media("/content/icons/error.png"); } }),
                    h("div", { class: s.postDate }, h("i", { class: "fas fa-clock" }), Countdown(g)),
                    h("div", { class: s.postAuthor }, `x${g.winners} winner${g.winners === 1 ? "" : "s"}`, h("i", { class: "fas fa-trophy" }))),
                h("div", { class: s.postTitle, style: { fontSize: "24px" } }, g.title),
                h("div", { class: s.postDivider }),
                h("div", { class: s.postBottomContainer, style: { gap: "8px" } },
                    h("div", { style: { display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: "8px", fontSize: "16px" } },
                        h("div", { style: { width: "26px", height: "30px" } }, Blook({ src: blookPath(g.user?.avatar) })), "Hosted by ", Username({ user: g.user || {} })),
                    Rewards(g, 40),
                    h("div", { class: s.postContent, style: { height: "auto", maxHeight: "60px" } }, g.description || "")));
        }

        async function viewGiveaway(id, onChange) {
            const d = await getJson(`/worker/giveaways/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`);
            if (!d || d.error || !d.giveaway) return fail(d?.reason || "That giveaway could not be found.");
            const g = d.giveaway;
            const self = me();
            const mine = String(g.user?.id) === String(self.id);
            const chance = !g.entries || g.entries <= g.winners ? 100 : Math.max(+(g.winners / g.entries * 100).toFixed(3), 0);

            const People = (title, users) => users?.length > 0 && h("div", { style: { display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: "6px", textAlign: "left" } },
                h("b", null, title),
                h("div", { style: { display: "flex", flexWrap: "wrap", gap: "6px", maxHeight: "110px", overflowY: "auto" } }, users.map((u) =>
                    h("a", { href: `/stats?name=${encodeURIComponent(u.username)}`, style: { display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: "6px", padding: "3px 10px 3px 3px", borderRadius: "var(--border-radius)", background: "rgba(var(--black), 0.2)", textDecoration: "none", fontSize: "15px" } },
                        h("div", { style: { width: "24px", height: "28px" } }, Blook({ src: blookPath(u.avatar) })), Username({ user: u })))));

            const action = h("div", { style: { display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", alignItems: "center", gap: "10px" } });
            if (ended(g)) action.append(h("div", { style: { opacity: 0.7 } }, "This giveaway has ended."));
            else if (mine) action.append(h("div", { style: { opacity: 0.7 } }, "You're hosting this giveaway."));
            else if (g.entered) action.append(GenericButton({ icon: "fas fa-check", backgroundColor: "#2a8a2a", style: { pointerEvents: "none" } }, "Entered"));
            else {
                const check = h("div");
                const enter = GenericButton({ icon: "fas fa-ticket", style: { opacity: 0.5, pointerEvents: "none" } }, "Enter");
                action.append(check, enter);
                const render = () => {
                    if (!window.turnstile || !v2().config?.turnstileSiteKey) return setTimeout(render, 300);
                    window.turnstile.render(check, {
                        sitekey: v2().config.turnstileSiteKey,
                        callback: (token) => {
                            Object.assign(enter.style, { opacity: "", pointerEvents: "" });
                            enter.onclick = () => call("/worker/giveaways/enter", { id: Number(g.id), token })
                                .then(() => { close(); success(`You entered ${g.title}.`); onChange?.(); })
                                .catch(fail);
                        }
                    });
                };
                render();
            }

            const close = openModal(
                ModalHeader(g.title),
                ModalBody(h("div", { style: { display: "flex", gap: "20px", alignItems: "flex-start", maxWidth: "760px", textAlign: "left", flexWrap: "wrap" } },
                    h("img", { src: giveawayImage(g), style: { width: "240px", maxHeight: "240px", objectFit: "contain", borderRadius: "var(--border-radius)", background: "rgba(var(--black), 0.2)" } }),
                    h("div", { style: { flex: 1, minWidth: "260px", display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: "10px", fontSize: "17px" } },
                        h("a", { href: `/stats?name=${encodeURIComponent(g.user?.username || "")}`, style: { display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: "8px", textDecoration: "none" } },
                            h("div", { style: { width: "30px", height: "34px" } }, Blook({ src: blookPath(g.user?.avatar) })), "Hosted by ", Username({ user: g.user || {} })),
                        g.description && h("div", { style: { whiteSpace: "pre-wrap", opacity: 0.85 } }, g.description),
                        h("div", null, h("b", null, "Rewards"), h("div", { style: { marginTop: "6px" } }, Rewards(g))),
                        h("div", { style: { display: "flex", flexWrap: "wrap", gap: "6px 18px", opacity: 0.8 } },
                            h("span", null, h("i", { class: "fas fa-clock", style: { marginRight: "6px" } }), Countdown(g)),
                            h("span", null, h("i", { class: "fas fa-trophy", style: { marginRight: "6px" } }), `${g.winners} winner${g.winners === 1 ? "" : "s"}`),
                            h("span", null, h("i", { class: "fas fa-users", style: { marginRight: "6px" } }), `${(g.entries ?? 0).toLocaleString()} entered (${chance}% to win)`)),
                        People("Winners", g.usersWon),
                        People("Entered", g.usersEntered)))),
                ModalBody(action),
                ModalButtons(GenericButton({ onClick: () => close() }, "Close")));
        }

        function createModal(onDone) {
            const self = me();
            const blooks = {};
            let image = null, error;

            const field = (ic, placeholder, props = {}) => {
                const box = Input({ icon: ic, placeholder, autocomplete: "off", ...props });
                Object.assign(box.style, { margin: "0", width: "100%", maxWidth: "none" });
                return box;
            };
            const title = field("fas fa-heading", "Title", { maxlength: "32" });
            const description = field("fas fa-align-left", "Description", { maxlength: "256" });
            const winners = field("fas fa-trophy", "Winners (1-100)", { type: "number", min: "1", max: "100", value: "1" });
            const minutes = field("fas fa-clock", "Length in minutes (up to 10080)", { type: "number", min: "1", max: "10080", value: "60" });
            const tokens = field("fas fa-coins", `Tokens (you have ${(self.tokens ?? 0).toLocaleString()})`, { type: "number", min: "0", value: "0" });
            const value = (box) => box.querySelector("input").value;

            const preview = h("img", { style: { width: "100%", maxHeight: "140px", objectFit: "contain", display: "none", borderRadius: "var(--border-radius)" } });
            const upload = GenericButton({ icon: "fas fa-image", onClick: () => {
                const picker = h("input", { type: "file", accept: "image/png,image/jpeg,image/gif,image/webp" });
                picker.onchange = () => uploadFile(picker.files[0]).then((url) => {
                    image = url;
                    preview.src = url;
                    preview.style.display = "block";
                }).catch(fail);
                picker.click();
            } }, "Upload Image");

            const chosen = h("div", { style: { display: "flex", flexWrap: "wrap", gap: "8px" } });
            const drawChosen = () => chosen.replaceChildren(...Object.entries(blooks).map(([name, amount]) => tooltip(h("div", { style: { width: "50px", height: "58px" } },
                InventoryItem({ blook: name, amount, onClick: () => {
                    const input = Input({ icon: "fas fa-hashtag", type: "number", min: "0", value: String(amount) });
                    const set = () => {
                        const n = Math.min(parseInt(input.querySelector("input").value, 10) || 0, self.blooks?.[name] || 0);
                        if (n > 0) blooks[name] = n; else delete blooks[name];
                        closeAmount();
                        drawChosen();
                    };
                    const closeAmount = openModal(ModalHeader(name), ModalBody(`How many? You have ${(self.blooks?.[name] || 0).toLocaleString()}. 0 removes it.`),
                        h("form", { onsubmit: (e) => { e.preventDefault(); set(); } }, input), ModalButtons(GenericButton({ onClick: set }, "Set")));
                } })), `${name}, click to change`)),
                GenericButton({ icon: "fas fa-plus", onClick: pickBlook }, "Add Blook"));
            const pickBlook = () => {
                let q = "";
                const holder = h("div", { style: { width: "min(560px, 80vw)", height: "45vh" } });
                const draw = () => holder.replaceChildren(ItemContainer({
                    user: self, options: { showItems: false, showPacks: false, showLocked: false, search: q },
                    style: { height: "100%", width: "100%", boxSizing: "border-box", borderRadius: "var(--border-radius)" },
                    onClick: ({ name, real }) => { if (!real) return; blooks[name] ||= 1; closePick(); drawChosen(); }
                }));
                const search = SearchBox({ placeholder: "Search your blooks...", oninput: (e) => { q = e.target.value; draw(); } });
                Object.assign(search.style, { margin: "0 0 10px", width: "100%", boxSizing: "border-box", boxShadow: "none" });
                const closePick = openModal(ModalHeader("Add a Blook"), ModalBody(h("div", { style: { display: "flex", flexDirection: "column" } }, search, holder)),
                    ModalButtons(GenericButton({ onClick: () => closePick() }, "Cancel")));
                draw();
            };
            drawChosen();

            const submit = () => {
                error?.remove();
                const body = {
                    title: value(title).trim(), description: value(description).trim(), image,
                    winners: Math.max(1, Math.min(100, parseInt(value(winners), 10) || 1)),
                    tokens: Math.max(0, parseInt(value(tokens), 10) || 0),
                    blooks, endsAt: Math.max(1, Math.min(10080, parseInt(value(minutes), 10) || 0))
                };
                if (!body.title || !body.description) return buttons.before(error = ErrorContainer("Give it a title and a description."));
                if (body.tokens > (self.tokens ?? 0)) return buttons.before(error = ErrorContainer("You don't have that many tokens."));
                if (!body.tokens && !Object.keys(blooks).length) return buttons.before(error = ErrorContainer("Add some tokens or blooks to give away."));
                call("/worker/giveaways/create", body).then(() => {
                    close();
                    self.tokens -= body.tokens;
                    for (const [name, n] of Object.entries(blooks)) self.blooks[name] -= n;
                    mountTopRight(currentPage());
                    success(`Started ${body.title}.`);
                    onDone();
                }).catch((reason) => buttons.before(error = ErrorContainer(String(reason))));
            };
            const buttons = ModalButtons(GenericButton({ onClick: submit }, "Start Giveaway"), GenericButton({ onClick: () => close() }, "Cancel"));
            const close = openModal(ModalHeader("Create Giveaway"),
                ModalBody(h("div", { class: "bv3-m-2col", style: { display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "1fr 1fr", gap: "10px", width: "min(640px, 85vw)" } },
                    h("div", { style: { gridColumn: "1 / -1" } }, title),
                    h("div", { style: { gridColumn: "1 / -1" } }, description),
                    winners, minutes, tokens, upload,
                    h("div", { style: { gridColumn: "1 / -1" } }, preview),
                    h("div", { style: { gridColumn: "1 / -1", textAlign: "left" } }, h("b", null, "Blooks"), h("div", { style: { marginTop: "6px" } }, chosen)))),
                buttons);
            title.querySelector("input").focus();
        }

        async function render(root) {
            await whenUser();
            let filter = "active";
            let list = [];

            const grid = h("div", { style: { display: "flex", flexWrap: "wrap", gap: "25px", justifyContent: "center", margin: "0 5% 40px" } });
            const featured = h("div");
            const nav = h("div", { style: { display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center", flexWrap: "wrap", gap: "10px", margin: "0 5% 20px" } });

            const draw = () => {
                const shown = list.filter((g) => filter === "all" || (filter === "active" ? !ended(g) : filter === "ended" ? ended(g) : String(g.user?.id) === String(me().id)))
                    .sort((a, b) => ended(a) - ended(b) || toMs(a.endsAt) - toMs(b.endsAt));
                nav.replaceChildren(
                    MiniNavbar({ items: [["active", "Active", "fas fa-hourglass-half"], ["ended", "Ended", "fas fa-flag-checkered"], ["mine", "Mine", "fas fa-user"], ["all", "All", "fas fa-layer-group"]]
                        .map(([key, text, ic]) => ({ text, icon: ic, active: filter === key, onClick: () => { filter = key; draw(); } })) }),
                    GenericButton({ icon: "fas fa-plus", onClick: () => createModal(load) }, "Create Giveaway"));
                const top = list.find((g) => g.featured && !ended(g));
                featured.replaceChildren(top ? h("div", {
                    class: S("components/Container/container").container,
                    style: { margin: "0 5% 20px", minWidth: "unset", flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "center", gap: "20px", cursor: "pointer", flexWrap: "wrap" },
                    onclick: () => viewGiveaway(top.id, load)
                },
                h("img", { src: giveawayImage(top), style: { width: "150px", height: "110px", objectFit: "cover", borderRadius: "var(--border-radius)" } }),
                h("div", { style: { flex: 1, minWidth: "240px", display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: "6px" } },
                    h("div", { style: { fontSize: "14px", fontWeight: 700, color: "gold" } }, h("i", { class: "fas fa-star", style: { marginRight: "6px" } }), "FEATURED"),
                    h("div", { style: { fontFamily: "var(--heading-font)", fontSize: "28px" } }, top.title),
                    h("div", { style: { fontSize: "16px", opacity: 0.75 } }, Countdown(top))),
                Rewards(top)) : "");
                grid.replaceChildren(...(shown.length ? shown.map((g) => GiveawayCard(g, () => viewGiveaway(g.id, load)))
                    : [h("div", { class: S("views/AuctionHouse/auctionHouse").noAuctions, style: { margin: "40px 0", fontSize: "28px" } }, "No giveaways here.")]));
            };

            function load() {
                grid.replaceChildren(h("div", { style: { fontSize: "20px", margin: "40px" } }, "Loading..."));
                getJson("/worker/giveaways").then((d) => {
                    if (!d || d.error) throw d?.reason || "Could not load giveaways.";
                    list = d.giveaways || [];
                    const latest = [...list].sort((a, b) => toMs(b.createdAt) - toMs(a.createdAt))[0];
                    if (latest) localStorage.setItem("lastGiveaway", latest.createdAt);
                    draw();
                }).catch((reason) => grid.replaceChildren(ErrorContainer(String(reason))));
            }

            root.append(featured, nav, grid);
            draw();
            load();
            const id = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get("id");
            if (id) viewGiveaway(id, load);
        }

        PAGES["/giveaways"] = { topRight: ["tokens"], pageHeader: "Giveaways", render };
    })();

    (() => {
        const store = (key, fallback) => {
            try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(key)) ?? fallback; } catch { return fallback; }
        };

        function promptModal({ title, body, icon: ic, placeholder, submitText, onSubmit }) {
            const input = Input({ icon: ic, placeholder, type: "number", min: "1", autocomplete: "off" });
            const field = input.querySelector("input");
            let error;
            const submit = () => {
                error?.remove();
                const value = parseInt(field.value, 10);
                if (!value || value < 1) return buttons.before(error = ErrorContainer("Please enter a number."));
                onSubmit(value).then(() => close()).catch((reason) => buttons.before(error = ErrorContainer(String(reason))));
            };
            const buttons = ModalButtons(GenericButton({ onClick: submit }, submitText), GenericButton({ onClick: () => close() }, "Cancel"));
