            const close = openModal(ModalHeader(title), ModalBody(body), h("form", { onsubmit: (e) => { e.preventDefault(); submit(); } }, input), buttons);
            field.focus();
        }

        const call = (url, body) => postJson(url, body).then((d) => {
            if (d.error) throw d.reason || "Something went wrong.";
            return d;
        });

        async function render(root, initialFilter) {
            const s = S("views/Inventory/inventory");
            const data = v2();
            let user = me();
            const name = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get("name");
            if (name && name.toLowerCase() !== user.username.toLowerCase()) {
                const other = await getUser(name);
                if (other?.blooks) user = other;
                else errorModal("That user could not be found.");
            }
            const viewingOther = user !== me();

            const lookupModal = () => {
                let error;
                const input = Input({ icon: "fas fa-user", placeholder: "Username", maxlength: "64", autocomplete: "off" });
                const submit = () => {
                    const who = input.querySelector("input").value.trim();
                    error?.remove();
                    if (!who) return buttons.before(error = ErrorContainer("Where's the username?"));
                    close();
                    go(`${location.pathname}?name=${encodeURIComponent(who)}`);
                };
                const buttons = ModalButtons(GenericButton({ onClick: submit }, "View"), GenericButton({ onClick: () => close() }, "Cancel"));
                const close = openModal(ModalHeader("View a Player's Blooks"), ModalBody("Whose inventory do you want to look at?"),
                    h("form", { onsubmit: (e) => { e.preventDefault(); submit(); } }, input), buttons);
                input.querySelector("input").focus();
            };

            let filter = store("inventory:filter", initialFilter);
            let showLocked = store("inventory:showLocked", false);
            let searchQuery = store("inventory:searchQuery", "");
            let selected = null;

            const searchHolder = h("div");
            const itemsHolder = h("div", { style: { display: "contents" } });
            const right = h("div", { style: { display: "contents" } });

            const save = () => {
                localStorage.setItem("inventory:filter", JSON.stringify(filter));
                localStorage.setItem("inventory:showLocked", JSON.stringify(showLocked));
                localStorage.setItem("inventory:searchQuery", JSON.stringify(searchQuery));
            };

            const drawSearch = () => searchHolder.replaceChildren(SearchBox({
                noPadding: true,
                placeholder: `Search ${filter === "all" ? "inventory" : filter}...`,
                value: searchQuery,
                oninput: (e) => { searchQuery = e.target.value; save(); drawItems(); },
                buttons: [
                    viewingOther
                        ? { icon: "fas fa-arrow-left", tooltip: "Back to Your Inventory", onClick: () => go(location.pathname) }
                        : { icon: "fas fa-user", tooltip: "View a Player's Blooks", onClick: lookupModal },
                    {
                        icon: filter === "all" ? "fas fa-layer-group" : filter === "blooks" ? "fas fa-user" : "fas fa-box",
                        tooltip: filter === "all" ? "Showing All" : filter === "blooks" ? "Showing Blooks" : "Showing Items",
                        onClick: () => { filter = filter === "all" ? "blooks" : filter === "blooks" ? "items" : "all"; save(); drawSearch(); drawItems(); }
                    },
                    plugin("sellDuplicates") && !viewingOther && { icon: "fas fa-broom", tooltip: "Sell Duplicates", onClick: sellDuplicates },
                plugin("bulkList") && !viewingOther && { icon: "fas fa-tags", tooltip: "Bulk List Duplicates", onClick: bulkList },
                    { icon: showLocked ? "fas fa-lock-open" : "fas fa-lock", tooltip: "Show Locked Items", onClick: () => { showLocked = !showLocked; save(); drawSearch(); drawItems(); } },
                    { icon: "fas fa-times", tooltip: "Reset Search", onClick: () => { searchQuery = ""; save(); drawSearch(); drawItems(); } }
                ]
            }));

            function bulkList() {
                const order = Object.keys(data.rarities || {});
                const pick = h("select", { style: { fontSize: "18px", padding: "6px 10px", borderRadius: "var(--border-radius)", background: "var(--background-color)", color: "var(--accent-color)", border: "none" } },
                    order.map((r) => h("option", { value: r }, r)));
                pick.value = order.includes("Rare") ? "Rare" : order[0];
                const percent = Input({ icon: "fas fa-percent", type: "number", min: "1", max: "1000", value: "100" });
                Object.assign(percent.style, { margin: "0", width: "160px" });
                const summary = h("div", { style: { fontSize: "17px", opacity: 0.8 } });
                const plan = () => {
                    const max = order.indexOf(pick.value);
                    const pct = Math.max(1, Number(percent.querySelector("input").value) || 100) / 100;
                    return Object.entries(user.blooks || {})
                        .filter(([n, c]) => c > 1 && VALUE_OF.get(n) > 0 && data.blooks[n] && order.indexOf(data.blooks[n].rarity) >= 0 && order.indexOf(data.blooks[n].rarity) <= max)
                        .map(([n, c]) => ({ name: n, copies: c - 1, price: Math.max(1, Math.round(VALUE_OF.get(n) * pct)) }));
                };
                const update = () => {
                    const list = plan();
                    const copies = list.reduce((a, b) => a + b.copies, 0);
                    summary.textContent = list.length
                        ? `Lists ${copies.toLocaleString()} blooks across ${list.length} kinds for ${list.reduce((a, b) => a + b.copies * b.price, 0).toLocaleString()} tokens in total. You keep one of each. Blooks without a value are skipped.`
                        : "Nothing to list at that rarity.";
                };
                pick.addEventListener("change", update);
                percent.querySelector("input").addEventListener("input", update);
                update();
                const run = async () => {
                    const list = plan();
                    if (!list.length) return;
                    close();
                    let listed = 0;
                    outer: for (const item of list) {
                        for (let i = 0; i < item.copies; i++) {
                            const d = await postJson("/worker/bazaar/list", { item: item.name, price: item.price });
                            if (d.error) { errorModal(`Stopped at ${item.name}: ${d.reason || "something went wrong"}`); break outer; }
                            user.blooks[item.name] -= 1;
                            listed++;
                            await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 400));
                        }
                    }
                    if (listed) success(`Listed ${listed.toLocaleString()} blooks on the Bazaar.`);
                    refresh();
                };
                const close = openModal(ModalHeader("Bulk List Duplicates"),
                    ModalBody(h("div", { style: { display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: "10px", flexWrap: "wrap", justifyContent: "center" } }, "Up to and including", pick, "at", percent, "of value")),
                    ModalBody(summary),
                    ModalButtons(GenericButton({ onClick: run }, "List"), GenericButton({ onClick: () => close() }, "Cancel")));
            }

            function sellDuplicates() {
                const order = Object.keys(data.rarities || {});
                const pick = h("select", { style: { fontSize: "18px", padding: "6px 10px", borderRadius: "var(--border-radius)", background: "var(--background-color)", color: "var(--accent-color)", border: "none" } },
                    order.map((r) => h("option", { value: r }, r)));
                pick.value = order.includes("Rare") ? "Rare" : order[0];
                const summary = h("div", { style: { fontSize: "17px", opacity: 0.8 } });
                const plan = () => {
                    const max = order.indexOf(pick.value);
                    return Object.entries(user.blooks || {})
                        .filter(([n, c]) => c > 1 && data.blooks[n] && order.indexOf(data.blooks[n].rarity) >= 0 && order.indexOf(data.blooks[n].rarity) <= max)
                        .map(([n, c]) => ({ name: n, quantity: c - 1, tokens: (c - 1) * (data.blooks[n].price ?? 0) }));
                };
                const update = () => {
                    const list = plan();
                    summary.textContent = list.length
                        ? `Sells ${list.reduce((a, b) => a + b.quantity, 0).toLocaleString()} blooks across ${list.length} kinds for ${list.reduce((a, b) => a + b.tokens, 0).toLocaleString()} tokens. You keep one of each.`
                        : "Nothing to sell at that rarity.";
                };
                pick.addEventListener("change", update);
                update();
                const run = async () => {
                    const list = plan();
                    if (!list.length) return;
                    close();
                    let sold = 0, tokens = 0;
                    for (const item of list) {
                        const d = await postJson("/worker/sell", { blook: item.name, quantity: item.quantity });
                        if (d.error) { errorModal(`Stopped at ${item.name}: ${d.reason || "something went wrong"}`); break; }
                        user.blooks[item.name] -= item.quantity;
                        user.tokens += item.tokens;
                        sold += item.quantity;
                        tokens += item.tokens;
                        await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 250));
                    }
                    if (sold) success(`Sold ${sold.toLocaleString()} duplicates for ${tokens.toLocaleString()} tokens.`);
                    refresh();
                };
                const close = openModal(ModalHeader("Sell Duplicates"),
                    ModalBody(h("div", { style: { display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: "10px" } }, "Up to and including", pick)),
                    ModalBody(summary),
                    ModalButtons(GenericButton({ onClick: run }, "Sell"), GenericButton({ onClick: () => close() }, "Cancel")));
            }

            const drawItems = () => itemsHolder.replaceChildren(ItemContainer({
                user,
                options: { showItems: filter !== "blooks", showBlooks: filter !== "items", showLocked, showPacks: true, search: searchQuery, allowLocked: plugin("wishlist") },
                onClick: (picked) => { selected = picked; drawRight(); }
            }));

            const Info = (name, ic, value) => h("div", { class: s.info }, h("div", { class: s.infoText }, h("i", { class: ic }), name), h("b", null, value));

            function drawRight() {
                if (!selected) return right.replaceChildren();
                const isBlook = selected.type === "blook";
                const thing = isBlook ? data.blooks[selected.name] : data.items[selected.name];
                if (!thing) return right.replaceChildren();

                const rarityName = isBlook ? thing.rarity : "Item";
                const rarity = isBlook ? data.rarities?.[thing.rarity] || { color: "#ffffff" } : { color: "#ffffff" };
                const background = isBlook && thing.art ? thing.art : media("/content/blooks/backgrounds/Default.png");
                const description = thing.description || `No description available for this ${isBlook ? "blook" : "item"}.`;
                const amount = isBlook ? user.blooks[selected.name] || 0 : ownedItems(user)[selected.name] || 0;

                const existCount = h("b", null, "Loading...");
                const average = h("b", null, "Loading...");
                getJson(`/worker/bazaar?item=${encodeURIComponent(selected.name)}`).then((d) => {
                    recordPrices(d?.bazaar);
                    const prices = (d?.bazaar || []).filter((l) => l.item === selected.name).map((l) => l.price);
                    average.textContent = prices.length ? Math.round(prices.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / prices.length).toLocaleString() : "N/A";
                }).catch(() => (average.textContent = "N/A"));
                existCount.textContent = "N/A";

                const sell = () => promptModal({
                    title: `Sell ${selected.name}`,
                    body: `How many would you like to sell for ${thing.price ?? 0} tokens each? You have ${amount}.`,
                    icon: "fas fa-hashtag",
                    placeholder: "Quantity",
                    submitText: "Sell",
                    onSubmit: (quantity) => call("/worker/sell", { blook: selected.name, quantity }).then(() => {
                        user.blooks[selected.name] -= quantity;
                        if (user.blooks[selected.name] < 1) delete user.blooks[selected.name];
                        user.tokens += quantity * (thing.price ?? 0);
                        success(`Sold ${quantity.toLocaleString()} ${selected.name} for ${(quantity * (thing.price ?? 0)).toLocaleString()} tokens.`);
                        refresh();
                    })
                });

                const auction = () => promptModal({
                    title: `List ${selected.name} on the Bazaar`,
                    body: "How many tokens would you like to list it for?",
                    icon: "fas fa-coins",
                    placeholder: "Price",
                    submitText: "List",
                    onSubmit: (price) => call("/worker/bazaar/list", { item: selected.name, price }).then(() => {
                        takeOne();
                        success(`Listed ${selected.name} on the Bazaar for ${price.toLocaleString()} tokens.`);
                        refresh();
                    })
                });

                const use = () => confirmModal("Question", `Are you sure you want to use ${selected.name}?`, () =>
                    call("/worker/use", { item: selected.name }).then(() => {
                        takeOne();
                        success(`Used ${selected.name}.`);
                        refresh();
                    }).catch(errorModal));

                const takeOne = () => {
                    if (isBlook) {
                        user.blooks[selected.name] -= 1;
                        if (user.blooks[selected.name] < 1) delete user.blooks[selected.name];
                    } else {
                        const i = user.inventory.indexOf(selected.name);
                        if (i >= 0) user.inventory.splice(i, 1);
                    }
                };

                right.replaceChildren(h("div", { class: s.rightSide },
                    h("div", { class: s.backgroundImageM }, h("img", { src: background, draggable: "false" })),
                    h("div", { class: s.top },
                        h("div", { class: s.topBackgroundImage }, h("img", { src: background, draggable: "false" })),
                        h("div", { class: s.itemContainerM },
                            h("div", { class: s.basicInfoM },
                                textfit(s.itemNameM, 40, selected.name),
                                h("div", { class: s.itemDescriptionM }, description)),
                            h("div", { class: s.itemImageContainerM }, Blook({ src: thing.image, className: s.itemImageM }))),
                        h("div", { class: s.itemContainer },
                            h("div", { class: s.itemImageContainer }, Blook({ src: thing.image, className: s.itemImage })),
                            h("div", { class: s.basicInfo },
                                textfit(s.itemName, 1000, selected.name),
                                h("div", { class: s.rarityLabelContainer }, h("div", { class: s.rarityLabel }, RarityLabel(rarityName, rarity.color)))))),
                    h("div", { class: s.bottom },
                        h("div", { class: s.description }, description),
                        h("div", { class: s.infoContainer },
                            Info("Amount", "fas fa-hashtag", amount.toLocaleString()),
                            !isBlook && Info("Usable", "fas fa-hand-pointer", "Yes"),
                            isBlook && Info("Chance", "fas fa-percentage", `${thing.chance ?? 0}%`),
                            isBlook && Info("Sell Price", "fas fa-dollar-sign", (thing.price ?? 0).toLocaleString()),
                            VALUE_OF.has(selected.name) && Info("Value", "fas fa-scale-balanced", VALUE_OF.get(selected.name).toLocaleString()),
                        plugin("priceHistory") && h("div", { class: s.info }, h("div", { class: s.infoText }, h("i", { class: "fas fa-chart-line" }), "Price History"),
                            h("b", { style: { cursor: "pointer", textDecoration: "underline" }, onclick: () => priceHistoryModal(selected.name) }, "View")),
                        plugin("wishlist") && isBlook && h("div", { class: s.info }, h("div", { class: s.infoText }, h("i", { class: "fas fa-star" }), "Wishlist"),
                            h("b", { style: { cursor: "pointer", textDecoration: "underline" }, onclick: () => { toggleWish(selected.name); drawItems(); drawRight(); } }, isWished(selected.name) ? "Remove" : "Add")),
                            h("div", { class: s.info }, h("div", { class: s.infoText }, h("i", { class: "fas fa-coins" }), "Recent Average Price"), average),
                            h("div", { class: s.info }, h("div", { class: s.infoText }, h("i", { class: "fas fa-database" }), "Exist Count"), existCount)),
                        h("div", { class: s.actionsContainer },
                            viewingOther ? h("div", { style: { textAlign: "center", opacity: 0.6 } }, `${user.username} owns ${amount.toLocaleString()}.`) : amount === 0 ? h("div", { style: { textAlign: "center", opacity: 0.6 } }, plugin("unlockAll") ? "Unlocked by the Unlock All plugin, only you can see this." : "You don't own this blook.") : h("div", { class: s.actions },
                                isBlook && GenericButton({ icon: "fas fa-coins", onClick: sell }, "Sell"),
                                !isBlook && GenericButton({ icon: "fas fa-bolt", onClick: use }, "Use"),
                                GenericButton({ icon: "fas fa-building-columns", onClick: auction }, "List"))))));
            }

            function refresh() {
                const still = selected && (selected.type === "blook" ? user.blooks[selected.name] > 0 : ownedItems(user)[selected.name] > 0);
                if (!still) selected = null;
                drawItems();
                drawRight();
                mountTopRight(currentPage());
            }

            drawSearch();
            drawItems();
            root.append(...[
                innerWidth > 768 && h("div", { class: S("components/PageHeader/pageHeader").pageHeader }, viewingOther ? `${user.username}'s Inventory` : "Inventory"),
                h("div", { class: s.leftSide }, searchHolder, itemsHolder),
                right].filter(Boolean));
        }

        PAGES["/blooks"] = { topRight: ["tokens"], render: (root) => render(root, "blooks") };
        PAGES["/inventory"] = { topRight: ["tokens"], render: (root) => render(root, "items") };
    })();

    (() => {
        const TYPES = [
            { key: "tokens", text: "Tokens", icon: "fas fa-coins", image: media("/content/token.png"), score: (u) => u.tokens },
            { key: "exp", text: "Experience", icon: "fas fa-star", image: media("/content/experience.png"), score: (u) => u.exp }
        ];

        function render(root) {
            const s = S("views/Leaderboard/leaderboard");
            let data = null;
            let type = TYPES[0];

            const wrap = h("div", { class: s.otherStandings });
            root.append(wrap);

            const avatar = (user, className) => {
                const src = avatarOf(user);
                const b = Blook({ className, src: src ? blookPath(src) : DEFAULT_AVATAR });
                if (!src) getUser(user.username).then((u) => u?.avatar && (b.querySelector("img").src = u.avatar));
                return b;
            };

            const scoreIcon = () => h("img", { src: type.image, draggable: "false" });

            function draw() {
                const standings = data ? Object.keys(data[type.key] || {}).sort((a, b) => a - b).map((k) => data[type.key][k]) : [];

                const podium = h("div", { class: s.podium, role: "group" }, standings.slice(0, 3).map((user, i) => {
                    const placement = i + 1;
                    return h("a", { class: s.podiumPlacement, href: `/stats?name=${encodeURIComponent(user.username)}`, dataset: { placement: String(placement) }, draggable: "false" },
                        h("div", { class: s.podiumTop },
                            avatar(user, s.podiumAvatar),
                            h("span", { class: s.podiumTrophy }, h("i", { class: "fas fa-trophy" }))),
                        h("div", { class: s.podiumDetails },
                            textfit(s.podiumUsername, 1000, Username({ user })),
                            h("div", { class: s.podiumRank }, `${placement}${ordinal(placement)}`),
                            textfit(s.podiumScore, 1000, h("span", { class: s.podiumScoreContent }, scoreIcon(), (type.score(user) ?? 0).toLocaleString())))
                    );
                }));

                const others = h("div", { class: s.otherTopThreeStandings }, standings.slice(3, 250).map((user, i) => {
                    const placement = i + 4;
                    return h("a", { class: s.otherStandingHolder, href: `/stats?name=${encodeURIComponent(user.username)}` },
                        h("div", { class: s.otherStandingContainer },
                            h("div", { class: s.otherStandingInside },
                                h("div", { class: s.otherStandingPlace }, String(placement)),
                                h("div", { class: s.otherStandingSuffix }, ordinal(placement)),
                                h("div", { class: s.otherStandingAvatar }, avatar(user)),
                                h("div", { class: s.otherStandingUsername, style: { fontSize: "30px", overflow: "hidden", whiteSpace: "nowrap", minWidth: 0 } }, Username({ user })),
                                h("div", { class: s.otherStandingScore }, (type.score(user) ?? 0).toLocaleString(), " ", scoreIcon()))));
                }));

                wrap.replaceChildren(
                    h("div", { class: s.podiumSection },
                        h("div", { style: { display: "flex", justifyContent: "center" } },
                            MiniNavbar({ items: TYPES.map((t) => ({ text: t.text, icon: t.icon, active: t === type, onClick: () => { type = t; draw(); } })) })),
                        h("div", { class: s.podiumViewport }, podium)),
                    others
                );
            }

            draw();
            getJson("/worker2/leaderboard").then((d) => { data = d; draw(); });
        }

        PAGES["/leaderboard"] = { topRight: [], render };
    })();

    (() => {
        const INSTANT_KEY = "bv3:openPacksInstantly";
        const instant = () => localStorage.getItem(INSTANT_KEY) === "true";

        function render(root) {
            const s = S("views/Market/market");
            const user = me();
            const data = v2();
            let search = { query: "", onlyPurchasable: false };
            try { search = { ...search, ...JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("market:search") || "{}") }; } catch { }

            const Category = (header, ...kids) => [h("div", { class: s.categoryHeader }, header), h("div", { class: s.categoryContent }, ...kids)];
            const tokenImg = () => h("img", { src: media("/content/token.png"), alt: "Token Icon" });

            const littleButtons = () => [
                LittleButton({ onClick: () => { localStorage.setItem(INSTANT_KEY, String(!instant())); redrawButtons(); } }, `Instant Open: ${instant() ? "On" : "Off"}`),
                plugin("pullStats") && LittleButton({ onClick: pullStatsModal }, "Pull Stats")
            ];
            const mobileButtons = h("div", { class: s.buttonHolderMobile });
            const desktopButtons = h("div", { class: s.buttonHolder });
            const redrawButtons = () => {
                mobileButtons.replaceChildren(...littleButtons());
                desktopButtons.replaceChildren(...littleButtons());
            };
            redrawButtons();

            const booster = data.booster;
            const boosterText = h("div");
            const boosterEl = h("div", { class: s.boosterContainer }, h("div", { class: s.boosterText }, boosterText, h("div", null, "No ongoing global shiny booster.")));
            const tickBooster = async () => {
                if (!booster?.active || booster.time * 1000 < Date.now()) return boosterText.replaceChildren("No ongoing global chance booster.");
                const by = await getUser(booster.user);
                boosterText.replaceChildren(h("div", { style: { display: "flex", flexDirection: "row", gap: "5px" } },
                    Username({ user: by || { username: "Someone" } }), ` is boosting your odds by ${booster.multiplier}x to find rares! This booster expires in ${formatTimeRemaining(new Date(booster.time * 1000))}.`));
            };
            tickBooster();
            const boosterTimer = setInterval(tickBooster, 1000);

            const packs = Object.entries(data.packs || {})
                .filter(([, p]) => p.enabled !== false && !p.hidden)
                .sort((a, b) => (a[1].priority ?? 0) - (b[1].priority ?? 0));

            const packsWrapper = h("div", { class: [s.packsWrapper, "bv3-m-packs"], style: { gridTemplateColumns: "repeat(3, 220px)" } });
            const packValue = (pack) => {
                const blooks = pack.blooks || [];
                const total = blooks.reduce((sum, b) => sum + (data.blooks?.[b]?.chance || 0), 0);
                return total ? blooks.reduce((sum, b) => sum + (data.blooks?.[b]?.chance || 0) * (VALUE_OF.get(b) || 0), 0) / total : 0;
            };
            const packEls = packs.map(([name, pack]) => {
                const el = h("div", { class: s.packContainer, onclick: () => buyPack(name, pack) },
                    h("div", { class: s.packBackground, style: { background: `radial-gradient(circle, ${pack.color1} 0%, ${pack.color2} 100%)` } }),
                    h("div", { class: s.packImageHolder },
                        h("img", { class: s.packImage, src: pack.image, draggable: "false" }),
                        h("img", { class: s.packShadow, src: pack.image, draggable: "false" })),
                    h("div", { class: s.bottomLeftText }, tokenImg(), (pack.price ?? 0).toLocaleString()),
                    plugin("packStats") && packValue(pack) > 0 && tooltip(h("div", { class: s.bottomRightText, style: { color: packValue(pack) >= pack.price ? "#7dff7d" : "#ffb37d" } }, `~${Math.round(packValue(pack)).toLocaleString()}`),
                        "Average value of one pull, from the Values list"),
                    plugin("autoOpen") && tooltip(h("div", {
                        style: { position: "absolute", top: "8px", right: "8px", width: "34px", height: "34px", borderRadius: "50%", display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center", background: "rgba(var(--black), 0.55)", fontSize: "16px", zIndex: 2 },
                        onclick: (e) => { e.stopPropagation(); autoOpen(name, pack); }
                    }, h("i", { class: "fas fa-repeat" })), "Auto Open"));
                return { name, pack, el };
            });
            const noPacks = h("span", null, "No packs found.");
            const filterPacks = () => {
                let any = false;
                for (const p of packEls) {
                    const show = p.name.toLowerCase().includes(search.query.toLowerCase()) && (!search.onlyPurchasable || user.tokens >= p.pack.price);
                    p.el.style.display = show ? "block" : "none";
                    any ||= show;
                }
                noPacks.style.display = any ? "none" : "";
                localStorage.setItem("market:search", JSON.stringify(search));
            };
            packsWrapper.append(...packEls.map((p) => p.el), noPacks);

            const searchHolder = h("div");
            const drawSearch = () => searchHolder.replaceChildren(SearchBox({
                placeholder: "Search for a pack or item...",
                value: search.query,
                oninput: (e) => { search.query = e.target.value; filterPacks(); },
                buttons: [
                    { icon: !search.onlyPurchasable ? "fas fa-eye" : "fas fa-eye-slash", tooltip: "Only Purchasable", onClick: () => { search.onlyPurchasable = !search.onlyPurchasable; filterPacks(); drawSearch(); } },
                    { icon: "fas fa-times", tooltip: "Reset Search", onClick: () => { search.query = ""; filterPacks(); drawSearch(); } }
                ]
            }));
            drawSearch();
            searchHolder.firstChild.style.margin = "20px 5% 10px";
            filterPacks();

            root.append(
                SidebarBody("Market",
                    mobileButtons,
                    h("div", { class: s.leftSide },
                        boosterEl,
                        searchHolder,
                        ...Category("Packs", packsWrapper))),
                h("div", { class: ["bv3-root", s.rightSide] },
                    h("div", { class: s.marketContainer },
                        h("img", { class: s.rightSideStore, src: media("/content/shopkeeper.png"), alt: "Shopkeeper" }),
                        desktopButtons))
            );

            function buyPack(name, pack) {
                if (instant()) return openPack(name, pack);
                if (user.tokens < pack.price) {
                    const close = openModal(ModalHeader("Error"), ModalBody("You do not have enough tokens to purchase this pack."),
                        ModalButtons(GenericButton({ onClick: () => close() }, "Okay")));
                    return;
                }

                const rates = (pack.blooks || []).map((b) => `${b}: ${data.blooks?.[b]?.chance ?? "?"}%`).join("\n");
                let error;
                const buttons = ModalButtons(
                    GenericButton({ onClick: () => openPack(name, pack).then(() => close()).catch((reason) => { error?.remove(); buttons.before(error = ErrorContainer(reason)); }) }, "Yes"),
                    plugin("autoOpen") && GenericButton({ icon: "fas fa-repeat", onClick: () => { close(); autoOpen(name, pack); } }, "Auto Open"),
                    GenericButton({ onClick: () => close() }, "No"));
                const close = openModal(
                    ModalHeader([tooltip(h("i", { class: [s.packRatesIcon, "far fa-question-circle"] }), rates), `${name} Pack`]),
                    ModalBody("Would you like to purchase this pack for ", h("img", { class: s.tokenPrice, src: media("/content/token.png") }), ` ${pack.price} tokens?`),
                    buttons);
            }

            function autoOpen(name, pack) {
                const most = Math.floor(user.tokens / pack.price);
                const input = Input({ icon: "fas fa-hashtag", placeholder: `How many? (up to ${most.toLocaleString()})`, type: "number", min: "1", value: String(Math.min(most, 25)) });
                let error;
                const start = () => {
                    const count = Math.min(parseInt(input.querySelector("input").value, 10) || 0, Math.floor(user.tokens / pack.price));
                    error?.remove();
                    if (count < 1) return buttons.before(error = ErrorContainer("You can't afford any of this pack."));
                    close();
                    run(count);
                };
                const buttons = ModalButtons(GenericButton({ onClick: start }, "Start"), GenericButton({ onClick: () => close() }, "Cancel"));
                const close = openModal(ModalHeader(`Auto Open ${name} Pack`), ModalBody(`Each pack costs ${pack.price.toLocaleString()} tokens. You have ${user.tokens.toLocaleString()}.`),
                    h("form", { onsubmit: (e) => { e.preventDefault(); start(); } }, input), buttons);
                input.querySelector("input").focus();

                function run(count) {
                    const pulls = {};
                    let opened = 0, stopped = false, spent = 0;
                    const progress = h("div", { style: { fontSize: "22px", fontWeight: 700 } });
                    const results = h("div", { style: { display: "flex", flexWrap: "wrap", gap: "8px", justifyContent: "center", maxWidth: "520px", maxHeight: "45vh", overflowY: "auto" } });
                    const stopButton = GenericButton({ icon: "fas fa-stop", onClick: () => { stopped = true; } }, "Stop");
                    const closeRun = openModal(ModalHeader(`Auto Opening ${name} Pack`), ModalBody(progress), ModalBody(results), ModalButtons(stopButton,
                        GenericButton({ onClick: () => { stopped = true; closeRun(); } }, "Close")));
                    const drawResults = (status) => {
                        progress.textContent = `${status} ${opened.toLocaleString()} / ${count.toLocaleString()} opened, ${spent.toLocaleString()} tokens spent`;
                        results.replaceChildren(...Object.entries(pulls)
                            .sort((x, y) => (data.blooks[x[0]]?.chance ?? 100) - (data.blooks[y[0]]?.chance ?? 100))
                            .map(([blook, n]) => tooltip(h("div", { style: { width: "60px", height: "70px" } }, InventoryItem({ blook, amount: n })), `${blook} (${data.blooks[blook]?.chance}%)`)));
                    };
                    (async () => {
                        while (!stopped && opened < count && user.tokens >= pack.price) {
                            const d = await postJson("/worker3/open", { pack: name });
                            if (d.error) { drawResults(`Stopped: ${d.reason || "something went wrong"}.`); break; }
                            opened++;
                            spent += pack.price;
                            user.tokens -= pack.price;
                            user.blooks[d.blook] = (user.blooks[d.blook] || 0) + 1;
                            pulls[d.blook] = (pulls[d.blook] || 0) + 1;
                            if ((data.blooks[d.blook]?.chance ?? 100) <= 1) toast({ header: "Rare pull!", body: `${d.blook} (${data.blooks[d.blook].chance}%)`, icon: data.blooks[d.blook].image });
                            recordPull(name, pack, d.blook);
                            drawResults("Opening...");
                            const stopAt = Number(pluginValue("autoOpenStop", 0));
                            if (stopAt > 0 && (data.blooks[d.blook]?.chance ?? 100) <= stopAt) { drawResults(`Stopped: pulled ${d.blook} (${data.blooks[d.blook].chance}%)!`); break; }
                            if (opened % 5 === 0) mountTopRight(currentPage());
                            await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, Math.max(300, Number(pluginValue("autoOpenDelay", 750)) || 750)));
                        }
                        if (!progress.textContent.startsWith("Stopped:")) drawResults(stopped ? "Stopped." : "Done!");
                        stopButton.remove();
                        mountTopRight(currentPage());
                    })();
                }
            }

            function openPack(name, pack) {
                return postJson("/worker3/open", { pack: name }).then((d) => {
                    if (d.error) throw d.reason || "Something went wrong.";
                    const isNew = !user.blooks[d.blook];
                    user.tokens -= pack.price;
                    user.blooks[d.blook] = (user.blooks[d.blook] || 0) + 1;
                    recordPull(name, pack, d.blook);
                    showOpening(pack, d.blook, isNew);
                });
            }

            function showOpening(pack, blookName, isNew) {
                const blook = data.blooks[blookName];
                const rarity = data.rarities?.[blook.rarity] || { color: "#ffffff" };
                const art = blook.art || media("/content/blooks/backgrounds/Default.png");
                let opened = false;

                const tear = h("video", { class: s.openPackTop, src: media("/content/pack-top.webm"), muted: true, playsinline: true, preload: "auto" });
                tear.muted = true;
                const bottom = h("img", { class: s.openPackBottom, src: pack.image, dataset: { opening: "false" } });
                const packContainer = h("div", { class: s.openPackContainer, dataset: { opening: "false" } }, tear, bottom);

                const sealFall = () => {
                    tear.remove();
                    const seal = h("img", { src: media("/content/pack-top-end.png"), class: s.openPackSeelFall, style: { left: "0px", top: "0px", position: "absolute" } });
                    packContainer.after(h("div", { class: s.openPackEndContainer }, seal));
                    let deg = 0, left = 0, top = 0, last = null, total = 0;
                    const step = (t) => {
                        if (last === null) last = t;
                        const dt = t - last;
                        last = t;
                        total += dt;
                        if (top >= innerHeight) return (seal.style.display = "none");
                        const k = Math.min(total / 500, 1);
                        deg += dt;
                        left -= (1 + (0.2 - 1) * k) * dt;
                        top += (0.2 + (2 - 0.2) * k * k) * dt;
                        seal.style.transform = `rotate(${deg}deg)`;
                        seal.style.left = `${left}px`;
                        seal.style.top = `${top}px`;
                        requestAnimationFrame(step);
                    };
                    requestAnimationFrame(step);
                };
                tear.addEventListener("ended", sealFall);

                const blookCard = () => h("div", { class: [s.openPackBlookContainer, s.openPackBlookContainerAnimation1] },
                    h("img", { src: art, class: s.openPackBlookBackground }),
                    h("div", { class: s.openPackBlookBlook }, Blook({ src: blook.image })),
                    h("div", { class: s.openPackBlookTopText },
                        textfit(s.openPackBlookBlookText, 40, blookName),
                        h("div", { class: s.openPackBlookRarityContainer }, h("div", { class: s.openPackBlookRarityLabel }, RarityLabel(blook.rarity, rarity.color)))),
                    h("div", { class: s.openPackBlookBottomText }, `${blook.chance}%${isNew ? " - NEW!" : ""}`),
                    h("div", { class: s.openPackBlookShadow }));

                const particles = ParticleCanvas({ className: s.canvas, color: rarity.color, animation: rarity.animation });

                const modal = h("div", { class: ["bv3-root", s.openModal] },
                    h("style", null, "body{overflow:hidden}"),
                    h("div", { class: s.openModalBackground, style: { background: `radial-gradient(circle, ${pack.color1} 0%, ${pack.color2} 100%)` } }),
                    particles.el,
                    packContainer,
                    h("div", {
                        class: s.openBigButton, onclick: () => {
                            if (opened) { particles.stop(); return modal.remove(); }
                            opened = true;
                            packContainer.dataset.opening = "true";
                            bottom.dataset.opening = "true";
                            tear.currentTime = 0;
                            tear.play().catch(sealFall);
                            setTimeout(() => {
                                modal.insertBefore(blookCard(), modal.lastChild);
                                particles.start();
                            }, 700);
                        }
                    }));
                document.body.append(modal);
                if (instant()) modal.lastChild.click();
            }

            return () => clearInterval(boosterTimer);
        }

        PAGES["/market"] = { topRight: ["tokens"], dontUseBody: true, render };
    })();

    (() => {
        const AUTHOR = { username: "Blacket", color: "#ffffff" };

        const content = (post) => h("div", { html: post.body || "" });
        const postDate = (post) => new Date((post.date ?? 0) * (post.date < 1e12 ? 1000 : 1));

        async function render(root) {
            const s = S("views/News/news");
            await whenData();
            const posts = v2().news || [];
            let open = null;

            const draw = () => {
                if (open) {
                    const date = postDate(open);
                    const back = () => h("a", { class: s.articleBack, href: "javascript:void(0)", onclick: (e) => { e.preventDefault(); open = null; draw(); } },
                        h("i", { class: "fas fa-arrow-left" }), "Back to news");
                    root.replaceChildren(h("article", { class: s.articlePage },
                        back(),
                        h("div", { class: s.articleLayout },
                            h("header", { class: s.articleHeader },
                                h("div", { class: s.articleMeta }, Username({ user: AUTHOR }), h("time", null, date.toLocaleDateString("en-US", { month: "long", day: "numeric", year: "numeric" }))),
                                h("h1", null, open.title)),
                            h("div", { class: s.articleContent },
                                open.image && h("img", { src: open.image, style: { maxWidth: "100%", borderRadius: "var(--border-radius)" } }),
                                content(open),
                                h("footer", { class: s.articleFooter }, back())))));
                    return;
                }

                root.replaceChildren(...[
                    h("div", { class: S("components/PageHeader/pageHeader").pageHeader }, "News"),
                    posts.length === 0 && h("p", { class: s.newsStatus }, "No news posts yet."),
                    h("div", { class: s.posts }, posts.map((post) =>
                        h("div", { class: s.postContainer },
                            h("div", { class: s.postTopContainer },
                                h("img", { class: s.postImage, draggable: "false", src: post.image || media("/content/icons/error.png") }),
                                h("div", { class: s.postDate }, h("i", { class: "fas fa-calendar-alt" }), postDate(post).toLocaleDateString()),
                                h("div", { class: s.postAuthor }, Username({ user: AUTHOR }), h("i", { class: "fas fa-user" }))),
                            h("a", { class: s.postTitle, href: "javascript:void(0)", onclick: (e) => { e.preventDefault(); open = post; draw(); } }, post.title),
                            h("div", { class: s.postDivider }),
                            h("div", { class: s.postBottomContainer },
                                h("div", { class: s.postContent }, content(post)),
                                h("div", { class: s.postReadMoreText, onclick: () => { open = post; draw(); }, style: { cursor: "pointer" } }, "Read more...")))))
                ].filter(Boolean));

                if (posts[0]) localStorage.setItem("lastPost", posts[0].date);
            };

            draw();
        }

        VIEWS.news = { topRight: [], render };
    })();

    (() => {
        function Toggle(checked, onChange) {
            const t = S("components/Toggle/toggle");
            const box = h("div", { class: t.toggleContainer, dataset: { checked: String(checked) }, role: "checkbox" }, h("i", { class: "fas fa-check" }));
            box.addEventListener("click", () => {
                checked = !checked;
                box.dataset.checked = String(checked);
                onChange(checked);
            });
            return h("div", { class: t.toggleWrapper, style: { margin: "0" } }, box);
        }

        function avatarModal() {
            let q = "";
            const holder = h("div", { style: { width: "min(600px, 85vw)", height: "55vh" } });
            const draw = () => holder.replaceChildren(ItemContainer({
                user: me(),
                options: { showItems: false, showPacks: false, allUnlocked: true, center: true, search: q },
                style: { height: "100%", width: "100%", boxSizing: "border-box", borderRadius: "var(--border-radius)" },
                onClick: ({ name }) => {
                    setPlugin("avatar", v2().blooks?.[name]?.image || blookPath(name));
                    close();
                    success(`Avatar set to ${name}. Only you see it.`);
                    rerender();
                }
            }));
            let typing = null;
            const search = SearchBox({ placeholder: "Search for a blook...", oninput: (e) => { q = e.target.value; clearTimeout(typing); typing = setTimeout(draw, 150); } });
            Object.assign(search.style, { margin: "0 0 10px", width: "100%", boxSizing: "border-box", boxShadow: "none" });
            const close = openModal(ModalHeader("Pick an Avatar"),
                ModalBody(h("div", { style: { display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", alignItems: "stretch", width: "min(600px, 85vw)" } }, search, holder)),
                ModalButtons(GenericButton({ onClick: () => close() }, "Close")));
            draw();
        }

        function NumberSetting(key, fallback, min, max, icon, label, step = 1) {
            const input = Input({ icon, type: "number", min: String(min), max: String(max), step: String(step), value: String(pluginValue(key, fallback)), placeholder: label });
            Object.assign(input.style, { margin: "0", width: "220px" });
            input.querySelector("input").addEventListener("change", (e) => {
                const n = Math.max(min, Math.min(max, step < 1 ? parseFloat(e.target.value) || 0 : parseInt(e.target.value, 10) || fallback));
                e.target.value = String(n);
                setPlugin(key, n);
            });
            return [h("span", { style: { fontSize: "15px", opacity: 0.6 } }, label), input];
        }

        function render(root) {
            const l = S("components/Container/LabeledContainer/labeledContainer");

            const Plugin = ({ key, icon: ic, name, description, extra, onToggle }) => h("div", { class: [S("components/Container/container").container, "bv3-m-card"], style: { width: "420px", minWidth: "unset", flexGrow: 0, margin: "0" } },
                h("div", { class: l.containerHeader, style: { justifyContent: "space-between" } },
                    h("div", { style: { display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: "10px", fontSize: "24px", fontWeight: 700 } }, h("i", { class: ic, style: { opacity: 0.5, fontSize: "22px" } }), name),
                    key && Toggle(plugin(key), (on) => { setPlugin(key, on); onToggle?.(on); })),
                h("div", { class: l.containerDivider }),
                h("div", { style: { fontSize: "17px", opacity: 0.8 } }, description),
                extra && h("div", { style: { marginTop: "12px", display: "flex", flexWrap: "wrap", gap: "10px", alignItems: "center" } }, extra));

            const Section = (title, ...plugins) => [
                h("div", { style: { width: "100%", fontFamily: "var(--heading-font)", fontSize: "32px", margin: "10px 0 0" } }, title),
                ...plugins
            ];

            const themeButtons = () => {
                const current = pluginValue("theme", "default");
                const chip = (key, name, swatch, onClick) => h("div", {
                    role: "button",
                    style: { display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: "8px", padding: "6px 12px", borderRadius: "var(--border-radius)", cursor: "pointer",
                        background: current === key ? "var(--accent-color)" : "rgba(var(--white), 0.08)", color: current === key ? "var(--background-color)" : null, fontWeight: 700, fontSize: "16px" },
                    onclick: onClick
                }, h("span", { style: { width: "16px", height: "16px", borderRadius: "50%", background: swatch, boxShadow: "0 0 0 2px rgba(var(--white), 0.3)" } }), name);
                const picker = h("input", { type: "color", value: pluginValue("themeColor", "#3b5bdb"), style: { width: "48px", height: "34px", border: "none", background: "none", cursor: "pointer", padding: 0 } });
                picker.addEventListener("input", () => { setPlugin("themeColor", picker.value); setPlugin("theme", "custom"); });
                picker.addEventListener("change", () => draw());
                return [
                    ...Object.entries(THEMES).map(([key, theme]) => chip(key, theme.name, theme.vars["--secondary-color"] || "rgb(63, 63, 63)", () => { setPlugin("theme", key); draw(); })),
                    h("div", { style: { width: "100%", height: "1px" } }),
                    chip("custom", "Custom", customThemeVars(pluginValue("themeColor", "#3b5bdb"))["--secondary-color"], () => { setPlugin("theme", "custom"); draw(); }),
                    picker,
                    h("span", { style: { fontSize: "15px", opacity: 0.6 } }, "custom colour")
                ];
            };

            const TextSetting = (key, placeholder, rows) => {
                const box = h("textarea", { placeholder, rows: String(rows), style: { width: "100%", boxSizing: "border-box", resize: "vertical", padding: "8px 10px", fontSize: "15px", fontFamily: "var(--paragraph-font)", color: "var(--accent-color)", background: "var(--background-color)", border: "none", borderRadius: "var(--border-radius)", outline: "none" } });
                box.value = pluginValue(key, "");
                box.addEventListener("change", () => setPlugin(key, box.value));
                return box;
            };

            const grid = h("div", { style: { display: "flex", flexWrap: "wrap", gap: "20px", justifyContent: "center", margin: "0 5% 40px" } });
            const Open = (label, onClick, ic = "fas fa-up-right-from-square") => GenericButton({ icon: ic, onClick }, label);
            const draw = () => grid.replaceChildren(
                ...Section("Chat",
                    Plugin({ key: "dockedChat", icon: "fas fa-comment-dots", name: "Chat Everywhere", description: "Chat button in the bottom right of every page. Opens global chat in a panel.", onToggle: () => mountDock() }),
                    Plugin({ key: "emojiAutofill", icon: "fas fa-face-smile", name: "Emoji Autofill", description: "Type : and part of an emoji name to get suggestions. Tab or Enter to pick." }),
                    Plugin({ key: "attachments", icon: "fas fa-paperclip", name: "Attachments", description: "Uploaded or pasted files sit above the message box and send with your message instead of right away." }),
                    Plugin({ key: "savedMessages", icon: "fas fa-bookmark", name: "Saved Messages", description: "Right click a message to save it. Bookmark button in chat lists them. Stored in this browser only." }),
                    Plugin({ key: "extendedChat", icon: "fas fa-scroll", name: "Extended Chat", description: "Loads more chat history than the default 250.", extra: NumberSetting("chatLimit", 500, 50, 5000, "fas fa-list-ol", "messages") }),
                    Plugin({ key: "mentionSound", icon: "fas fa-bell", name: "Mention Sound", description: "Plays a sound when someone pings you." }),
                    Plugin({ key: "mentionsInbox", icon: "fas fa-at", name: "Mentions Inbox", description: "Keeps every ping you get. The @ button in chat lists them, click one to go to that chat.", extra: Open("Open Inbox", mentionsModal) }),
                    Plugin({ key: "keywordAlerts", icon: "fas fa-bullhorn", name: "Keyword Alerts", description: "Sound and a notification when anyone in chat says one of these words.",
                        extra: TextSetting("alertWords", "comma separated, e.g. trading, rainbow panda", 2) }),
                    Plugin({ key: "chatSearch", icon: "fas fa-magnifying-glass", name: "Chat Search", description: "Search button in chat. Finds words in the loaded messages, or type from:username." }),
                    Plugin({ key: "muteUsers", icon: "fas fa-volume-xmark", name: "Mute User", description: "Right click someone in chat to hide their messages. Lighter than blocking, and only for you.", extra: Open("Muted List", mutedModal) }),
                    Plugin({ key: "userNotes", icon: "fas fa-note-sticky", name: "User Notes", description: "Right click someone or use their profile to write a private note. A note icon shows by their name." }),
                    Plugin({ key: "wordFilter", icon: "fas fa-filter", name: "Word Filter", description: "Hides messages containing any of these words. Click a hidden one to show it.",
                        extra: TextSetting("filterWords", "comma separated, e.g. scam, free tokens", 2) }),
                    Plugin({ key: "hideEmbeds", icon: "fas fa-image", name: "No Embeds", description: "Images, videos and files in chat show as links instead." }),
                    Plugin({ key: "compactChat", icon: "fas fa-compress", name: "Compact Chat", description: "Smaller avatars and less space between messages." })),
                ...Section("Trading",
                    Plugin({ key: "tradeValues", icon: "fas fa-calculator", name: "Trade Value Calculator", description: "Shows each side's value in a trade and how much you gain or lose." }),
                    Plugin({ key: "tradeHistory", icon: "fas fa-clock-rotate-left", name: "Trade History", description: "Saves every finished trade: who, what you gave, what you got and the value change.", extra: Open("View History", tradeHistoryModal) }),
                    Plugin({ key: "baitWarning", icon: "fas fa-triangle-exclamation", name: "Bait Warning", description: "Big warning if the other person changes their offer after someone accepted, showing what changed." }),
                    Plugin({ key: "autoDecline", icon: "fas fa-ban", name: "Auto-Decline", description: "Declines trade requests from people who aren't your friends, and from anyone on this list.",
                        extra: TextSetting("declineList", "usernames, comma separated", 2) }),
                    Plugin({ key: "quickOffers", icon: "fas fa-layer-group", name: "Quick Offers", description: "Save offers you make often and load them in one click with the Offers button in a trade." })),
                ...Section("Market",
                    Plugin({ key: "autoOpen", icon: "fas fa-repeat", name: "Auto Opener", description: "Adds a repeat button to each pack on the Market. Opens the number you pick, no animation, and lists what you got. Set a chance to stop when you pull something that rare or rarer (0 = never stop).",
                        extra: [...NumberSetting("autoOpenDelay", 750, 300, 10000, "fas fa-stopwatch", "ms between packs"), ...NumberSetting("autoOpenStop", 0, 0, 100, "fas fa-hand", "stop at % chance", 0.001)] }),
                    Plugin({ key: "packStats", icon: "fas fa-chart-pie", name: "Pack Value", description: "Shows the average value of one pull on each pack. Green if it's worth more than the price." }),
                    Plugin({ key: "pullStats", icon: "fas fa-dice", name: "Pull Stats", description: "Counts every pack you open: tokens spent, value pulled, your luck per pack and your rarest pulls.", extra: Open("View Stats", pullStatsModal) }),
                    Plugin({ key: "boosterAlert", icon: "fas fa-rocket", name: "Booster Alert", description: "Notification when someone starts a global booster." })),
                ...Section("Bazaar",

                    Plugin({ key: "undercutAlert", icon: "fas fa-arrow-trend-down", name: "Undercut Alert", description: "Notifies you when someone lists the same thing cheaper than one of your listings." }),
                    Plugin({ key: "priceHistory", icon: "fas fa-chart-line", name: "Price History", description: "Remembers the lowest Bazaar price seen each day. Shows a chart when you search one item, and in your inventory." }),
                    Plugin({ key: "bulkList", icon: "fas fa-tags", name: "Bulk List", description: "Adds a button to your inventory that lists all your duplicates at a share of their value. Keeps one of each." })),
                ...Section("Inventory",
                    Plugin({ key: "sellDuplicates", icon: "fas fa-broom", name: "Sell Duplicates", description: "Adds a button to your inventory that sells every extra copy of blooks up to a rarity you pick. Keeps one of each." }),
                    Plugin({ key: "collectionProgress", icon: "fas fa-list-check", name: "Collection Progress", description: "Shows how many blooks of each pack you have. Turn on locked blooks in your inventory to see what's missing." }),
                    Plugin({ key: "wishlist", icon: "fas fa-star", name: "Wishlist", description: "Star blooks you want. They get a star in inventories and on the Bazaar.", extra: Open("Edit Wishlist", wishlistModal) }),
                    Plugin({ key: "netWorth", icon: "fas fa-sack-dollar", name: "Net Worth Tracker", description: "Saves your blook value and tokens each day and graphs them. Also on your Dashboard.", extra: Open("View Graph", netWorthModal) })),
                ...Section("Profiles",

                    Plugin({ key: "moreStats", icon: "fas fa-chart-simple", name: "More Stats", description: "Extra profile stats: level, unique blooks, total blooks, items, rarest and most valuable blook, badges, join date, role." }),
                    Plugin({ key: "anyAvatar", icon: "fas fa-user-astronaut", name: "Any Avatar", description: "Use any blook as your avatar. Only you see it.", onToggle: () => rerender(),
                        extra: [GenericButton({ icon: "fas fa-images", onClick: avatarModal }, "Pick Avatar"), pluginValue("avatar") && h("img", { src: pluginValue("avatar"), style: { height: "45px" } })] }),
                    Plugin({ key: "unlockAll", icon: "fas fa-lock-open", name: "Unlock All", description: "Shows every blook as unlocked in your inventory. Only you see it. You can't sell or list blooks you don't own." })),
                ...Section("Look & Feel",
                    Plugin({ icon: "fas fa-palette", name: "Themes", description: "Pick a preset or any colour.", extra: themeButtons() }),
                    Plugin({ key: "customBackground", icon: "fas fa-panorama", name: "Custom Background", description: "Use your own picture instead of the pattern.", extra: Open("Pick Picture", backgroundModal) }),
                    Plugin({ key: "sidebarEditor", icon: "fas fa-bars-staggered", name: "Sidebar Editor", description: "Reorder or hide pages in the sidebar.", onToggle: () => refreshSidebar(), extra: Open("Edit Sidebar", sidebarEditorModal) }),
                    Plugin({ key: "quickSearch", icon: "fas fa-keyboard", name: "Quick Search", description: "Press Ctrl+K (Cmd+K on Mac) anywhere to jump to a page, find a blook on the Bazaar or look up a user.", extra: Open("Try It", quickSearch) }),
                    Plugin({ key: "sessionTracker", icon: "fas fa-stopwatch", name: "Session Tracker", description: "Shows in the top right how long you've been on and the tokens and exp you've gained since.", onToggle: () => mountTopRight(currentPage()) }),
                    Plugin({ key: "performance", icon: "fas fa-gauge-high", name: "Performance Mode", description: "Removes the background pattern, blur and shadows. Use it if the site lags." }),
                    Plugin({ key: "autoClaim", icon: "fas fa-gift", name: "Auto Claim Daily", description: "Claims your daily reward when you open the site." }))
