        VIEWS.plugins = { topRight: [], render };
    })();

    (() => {
        const ClearButton = ({ onClick, to }, ...children) => to
            ? h("a", { class: S("components/Buttons/ClearButton/clearButton").clearButton, href: to }, ...children)
            : h("div", { class: S("components/Buttons/ClearButton/clearButton").clearButton, role: "button", onclick: onClick }, ...children);

        function SettingsContainer(ic, label, ...children) {
            const l = S("components/Container/LabeledContainer/labeledContainer");
            return h("div", { class: S("components/Container/container").container },
                h("div", { class: l.containerHeader }, h("i", { class: ic }), h("div", null, label)),
                h("div", { class: l.containerDivider }),
                ...children);
        }

        const Divider = (margin) => h("div", { class: S("views/Settings/settings").divider, style: { margin: `${margin}px 0` } });

        const call = (url, body) => postJson(url, body).then((d) => {
            if (d.error) throw d.reason || "Something went wrong.";
            return d;
        });

        function formModal(title, body, fields, submitText, onSubmit) {
            let error;
            const inputs = fields.map((f) => Input({ icon: f.icon, placeholder: f.placeholder, type: f.type || "text", autocomplete: "off", maxlength: "64" }));
            const submit = () => {
                error?.remove();
                const values = inputs.map((i) => i.querySelector("input").value);
                onSubmit(values).then(() => close()).catch((reason) => buttons.before(error = ErrorContainer(String(reason))));
            };
            const buttons = ModalButtons(GenericButton({ onClick: submit }, submitText), GenericButton({ onClick: () => close() }, "Cancel"));
            const close = openModal(ModalHeader(title), ModalBody(body), h("form", { onsubmit: (e) => { e.preventDefault(); submit(); } }, inputs), buttons);
            inputs[0]?.querySelector("input").focus();
        }

        function render(root) {
            const s = S("views/Settings/settings");
            const user = me();
            const settings = user.settings || {};
            let section = localStorage.getItem("bv3:settingsSection") || "account";

            const cycle = (current, order) => order[(order.indexOf(current) + 1) % order.length];
            const label = (v) => v ? v[0].toUpperCase() + v.slice(1) : "Unknown";

            const SECTIONS = {
                account: () => [
                    SettingsContainer("fas fa-user", "Account",
                        h("div", null, h("b", null, "ID:"), ` ${user.id}`),
                        h("div", null, h("b", null, "Username:"), ` ${user.username}`),
                        h("div", { style: { display: "inline-flex" } }, h("b", null, "Font: "), h("div", { style: { fontFamily: "\"Quicksand Bold\"", marginLeft: "7px" } }, "Quicksand Bold")),
                        h("div", null, h("b", null, "Joined:"), ` ${new Date(user.created * 1000).toLocaleDateString()} ${new Date(user.created * 1000).toLocaleTimeString()}`),
                        Divider(10),
                        ClearButton({
                            onClick: () => formModal("Change Username", "What would you like your new username to be?",
                                [{ icon: "fas fa-user", placeholder: "New Username" }, { icon: "fas fa-lock", placeholder: "Password", type: "password" }],
                                "Change", ([username, password]) => call("/worker/settings/username", { username, password }).then(() => location.reload()))
                        }, "Change Username"),
                        ClearButton({
                            onClick: () => {
                                const value = cycle(settings.friends, ["on", "mutual", "off"]);
                                call("/worker/settings/friends", { value }).then(() => { settings.friends = value; draw(); }).catch(errorModal);
                            }
                        }, `Friend Requests: ${label(settings.friends)}`),
                        ClearButton({
                            onClick: () => {
                                const value = cycle(settings.requests, ["on", "friends", "off"]);
                                call("/worker/settings/requests", { value }).then(() => { settings.requests = value; draw(); }).catch(errorModal);
                            }
                        }, `Trade Requests: ${label(settings.requests)}`),
                        ClearButton({ onClick: () => confirmModal("Question", "Are you sure you want to logout?", () => go("/logout")) }, "Logout")),
                    SettingsContainer("fas fa-wallet", "Billing",
                        h("div", null, h("b", null, "Plan:"), ` ${user.plus ? "Blacket Plus" : "Basic"}`),
                        h("div", { style: { marginTop: "5px" } }, ClearButton({ to: "/store" }, "Visit the Store"))),
                    SettingsContainer("fas fa-cog", "General",
                        ClearButton({
                            onClick: () => formModal("Change Color", "What color would you like your name to be? (hex code)",
                                [{ icon: "fas fa-palette", placeholder: "#ffffff" }],
                                "Change", ([color]) => call("/worker/settings/color", { color }).then(() => location.reload()))
                        }, "Change Name Color"))
                ],
                social: () => {
                    const list = h("div", { class: S("views/Settings/components/Sections/Social/social").blocksContainer });
                    const blocks = user.blocks || [];
                    Promise.all(blocks.map((id) => getUser(id))).then((users) => list.replaceChildren(...users.filter(Boolean).map((u) =>
                        h("a", { href: `/stats?name=${encodeURIComponent(u.username)}`, class: S("views/Settings/components/Sections/Social/social").blockedUser },
                            Blook({ className: S("views/Settings/components/Sections/Social/social").blockedAvatar, src: u.avatar }),
                            Username({ user: u })))));
                    return [SettingsContainer("fas fa-ban", "Blocked", blocks.length === 0 && h("div", null, "You have not blocked any users."), list)];
                },
                security: () => [SettingsContainer("fas fa-lock", "Security",
                    ClearButton({
                        onClick: () => formModal("Change Password", "Enter your current password and your new password.",
                            [{ icon: "fas fa-lock", placeholder: "Current Password", type: "password" }, { icon: "fas fa-key", placeholder: "New Password", type: "password" }],
                            "Change", ([oldPassword, newPassword]) => call("/worker/settings/password", { oldPassword, newPassword }))
                    }, "Change Password"),
                    ClearButton({
                        onClick: () => {
                            if (user.otp?.enabled || user.otp === true) return formModal("Disable 2FA / OTP", "Enter the code from your authenticator app.",
                                [{ icon: "fas fa-shield-alt", placeholder: "Code" }], "Disable", ([code]) => call("/worker/otp/disable", { code }).then(() => location.reload()));
                            getJson("/worker/otp/generate").then((d) => {
                                if (d.error) return errorModal(d.reason);
                                formModal("Enable 2FA / OTP", h("div", null, h("img", { src: d.qr, style: { width: "200px", display: "block", margin: "0 auto 10px" } }), "Scan this with your authenticator app, then enter the code."),
                                    [{ icon: "fas fa-shield-alt", placeholder: "Code" }], "Enable", ([code]) => call("/worker/otp/enable", { code }).then(() => location.reload()));
                            });
                        }
                    }, `${user.otp?.enabled || user.otp === true ? "Disable" : "Enable"} 2FA / OTP`))],
                cosmetics: () => [SettingsContainer("fas fa-palette", "Cosmetics",
                    ClearButton({ onClick: () => { const off = localStorage.getItem("settings:modalAnimation") === "false"; localStorage.setItem("settings:modalAnimation", String(off)); draw(); } },
                        `Modal Animation: ${localStorage.getItem("settings:modalAnimation") === "false" ? "Off" : "On"}`))],
                legal: () => [SettingsContainer("fas fa-info-circle", "Legal",
                    h("a", { href: "/terms" }, "Terms of Service"),
                    h("a", { href: "/privacy" }, "Privacy Policy"),
                    h("a", { href: "/eula" }, "End User License Agreement"))]
            };

            const NAVBAR = [
                { icon: "fas fa-user", text: "Account", key: "account" },
                { icon: "fas fa-user-friends", text: "Social", key: "social" },
                { icon: "fas fa-wallet", text: "Billing", key: "account" },
                { icon: "fas fa-shield-alt", text: "Security", key: "security" },
                { icon: "fas fa-palette", text: "Cosmetics", key: "cosmetics" },
                { icon: "fas fa-info-circle", text: "Legal", key: "legal" }
            ];

            const navHolder = h("div", { style: { display: "contents" } });
            const container = h("div", { class: s.container });

            function draw() {
                localStorage.setItem("bv3:settingsSection", section);
                navHolder.replaceChildren(MiniNavbar({
                    className: s.navbar,
                    items: NAVBAR.map((item) => ({ ...item, active: item.key === section && item.text !== "Billing", onClick: () => { section = item.key; draw(); } }))
                }));
                container.replaceChildren(...(SECTIONS[section] || SECTIONS.account)());
            }

            draw();
            root.append(navHolder, container);
        }

        PAGES["/settings"] = { topRight: [], pageHeader: "Settings", render };
    })();

    (() => {
        const PLUS_PERKS = [
            "Access To Banners", "Exclusive Username Colors", "Exclusive Chat Colors", "Exclusive Plus Badge", "More Bazaar Listings",
            "Access To Creating Clans", "Upload Files in Chat", "Use Chat Embeds", "Use Blook Emojis", "Discord Plus Role", "+30,000 tokens"
        ];
        const BOOSTERS = [
            { item: "1hBooster", name: "1H Booster", subname: "Boosts everyone's odds 2x for 1 hour", tokens: "+20,000 tokens", image: "/content/items/1 Hour Booster.png", color1: "#ffb300", color2: "#ff6a00" },
            { item: "3hBooster", name: "3H Booster", subname: "Boosts everyone's odds 2x for 3 hours", tokens: "+30,000 tokens", image: "/content/items/3 Hour Booster.png", color1: "#c04bff", color2: "#5b2bff" }
        ];

        const priceOf = (item) => {
            const p = v2().config?.store?.[item];
            if (!p) return null;
            const sale = p.sale && p.sale.price !== "0.00" ? p.sale : null;
            return { price: p.price, sale: sale?.price, saleName: sale?.name };
        };

        function checkout(item, quantity = 1) {
            postJson("/worker/start-purchase", { item, quantity, origin: window.origin }).then((d) => {
                if (d.error) return errorModal(d.reason || "Something went wrong.");
                go(d.url);
            });
        }

        function render(root) {
            const st = S("views/Store/store");
            const cat = S("views/Store/components/Category/category");
            const prod = S("views/Store/components/Product/product");
            const sub = S("views/Store/components/Subscription/subscription");
            const pm = S("views/Store/components/ProductModal/productModal");
            const user = me();

            const hour = new Date().getHours();
            const greeting = hour < 5 ? `Why are you still awake ${user.username}? Welcome to the Store!`
                : hour < 12 ? `Good morning ${user.username}, Welcome to the Store!`
                    : hour < 18 ? `Good afternoon ${user.username}, Welcome to the Store!`
                        : hour < 22 ? `Good evening ${user.username}, Welcome to the Store!`
                            : `Enjoy your night ${user.username}, Welcome to the Store!`;

            const Category = (title, subTitle, children, spaceEvenly) => h("div", { class: cat.container },
                h("div", { class: cat.top }, h("div", { class: cat.topText }, h("div", { class: cat.title }, title), h("div", { class: cat.subTitle }, subTitle))),
                h("div", { class: cat.divider }),
                h("div", { class: cat.products, style: spaceEvenly ? { justifyContent: "space-evenly" } : null }, children));

            const PriceText = (p) => p.sale ? [h("span", { style: { textDecoration: "line-through", opacity: 0.6, marginRight: "6px" } }, `$${p.price}`), `$${p.sale}`] : `$${p.price}`;

            function productModal({ name, item, description, image, quantity }) {
                const p = priceOf(item);
                const qty = quantity && Input({ icon: "fas fa-hashtag", placeholder: "Quantity", type: "number", min: "1", value: "1" });
                const close = openModal(
                    ModalHeader(name),
                    ModalBody(h("div", { class: pm.productInformationContainer },
                        h("div", { class: pm.productLeft }, description),
                        h("div", { class: pm.productRight }, h("div", { class: pm.productImageContainer }, h("img", { class: pm.productImage, src: image, draggable: "false" }))))),
                    qty,
                    ModalBody(h("div", { style: { fontSize: "14px", opacity: 0.6 } }, "By purchasing, you agree to Blacket's Terms of Service, End User License Agreement, and Privacy Policy. This is a one-time charge.")),
                    ModalButtons(
                        GenericButton({ onClick: () => checkout(item, qty ? Math.max(1, parseInt(qty.querySelector("input").value, 10) || 1) : 1) },
                            h("div", { class: pm.productPrice }, p ? PriceText(p) : "Buy")),
                        GenericButton({ onClick: () => close() }, "Close")));
            }

            const plus = priceOf("plus");
            const plusImage = v2().badges?.Plus?.image || media("/content/badges/VIP.png");
            const Subscription = () => h("div", { class: sub.subscription },
                h("div", { class: sub.topContainer },
                    h("div", { class: sub.top, style: { background: "linear-gradient(#ffd000 0%, #ff9d00 100%)" } }),
                    h("img", { class: sub.image, src: plusImage, draggable: "false" })),
                textfit(sub.name, 50, "Plus"),
                h("div", { class: sub.description }, plus?.saleName && h("b", null, `${plus.saleName} Sale!`), PLUS_PERKS.map((perk) => h("div", null, h("i", { class: "fas fa-check", style: { marginRight: "8px" } }), perk))),
                h("div", { class: sub.bottom },
                    h("div", {
                        class: [S("components/Buttons/ClearButton/clearButton").clearButton, sub.subscribeButton],
                        role: "button",
                        onclick: () => productModal({ name: "Plus", item: "plus", image: plusImage, description: h("div", null, "Unlock all of Plus's perks, forever:", h("br"), PLUS_PERKS.join(", ") + ".") })
                    }, plus ? PriceText(plus) : "Plus", h("div", { class: sub.lifetimeText }, "one time"))),
                h("div", { class: sub.boxShadow, style: { boxShadow: "inset 0 0 0 4px #ff9d00" } }),
                h("div", { class: sub.background, style: { background: "linear-gradient(#ff9d00 0%, #ffd000 100%)" } },
                    h("div", { class: sub.backgroundBlooks, style: { backgroundImage: `url("${BACKGROUND_SVG}")` } })));

            const Product = (b) => {
                const p = priceOf(b.item);
                return h("div", {
                    class: prod.product,
                    style: { background: `linear-gradient(15deg, ${b.color1}, ${b.color2})` },
                    onclick: () => productModal({ name: b.name, item: b.item, image: media(b.image), quantity: true, description: `${b.subname}. ${b.tokens} each.` })
                },
                p?.sale && h("div", { class: prod.cornerRibbon }, h("div", { class: prod.cornerRibbonContent }, `${Math.round((1 - p.sale / p.price) * 100)}% OFF`)),
                h("div", { class: prod.productTop },
                    textfit(prod.productTitle, 25, b.name),
                    textfit(prod.productSubtitle, 15, b.tokens)),
                h("div", { class: prod.productImageContainer }, h("img", { class: prod.productImage, src: media(b.image), draggable: "false" })),
                h("div", { class: prod.productBottom }, h("div", { class: prod.productPrice }, p ? PriceText(p) : "")));
            };

            const spent = user.moneySpent ?? 0;

            root.append(
                SidebarBody(null,
                    h("div", { class: st.container },
                        h("div", { class: st.headerContainer },
                            textfit(st.headerBigText, 50, greeting),
                            h("div", { class: st.headerSmallText }, `Purchase plans, items, and more to stand out from the crowd to enhance your ${v2().config?.name || "Blacket"} experience!`)),
                        Category("Plans", "The best way to enhance your Blacket experience with exclusive perks and benefits!", Subscription(), true),
                        Category("Boosters", "Boost everyone's chances of finding rare blooks, and get tokens for yourself!", BOOSTERS.map(Product)),
                        h("div", { style: { textAlign: "center", opacity: 0.6, fontSize: "16px" } },
                            `You have spent $${spent} on Blacket. `, spent >= 50 ? "You've unlocked the Big Spender badge!" : `Spend $${50 - spent} more to unlock the Big Spender badge!`))),
                h("div", { class: ["bv3-root", st.rightSide] },
                    tooltip(h("img", { class: st.rightSideStore, src: media("/content/shopkeeper.png"), alt: "Shopkeeper" }), "What are you looking to purchase today?")));
        }

        PAGES["/store"] = { topRight: ["tokens"], dontUseBody: true, render };
    })();

    let tradeWaitingClose = null;
    let incomingTradeEl = null;

    function tradeWaiting(username) {
        tradeWaitingClose?.();
        const l = S("components/Loader/loader");
        tradeWaitingClose = openModal(
            ModalHeader("Trade Request"),
            ModalBody(`Waiting for ${username} to accept...`),
            ModalBody(h("div", { class: l.loaderSpinner, style: { width: "40px" } })),
            ModalButtons(GenericButton({ onClick: () => { postJson("/worker/trades/requests/cancel", {}); tradeWaitingClose?.(); tradeWaitingClose = null; } }, "Cancel Request")));
    }

    async function tradeWith(username) {
        const user = await getUser(username);
        if (!user) return errorModal("That user could not be found.");
        const d = await postJson("/worker/trades/requests/send", { user: String(user.id) });
        if (d.error) return errorModal(d.reason || "Could not send the trade request.");
        tradeWaiting(user.username);
    }

    async function incomingTrade(user) {
        if (!user) return;
        if (await shouldDecline(user)) {
            postJson("/worker/trades/requests/decline", {});
            return toast({ header: "Trade", body: `Auto-declined a trade request from ${user.username}.`, icon: "fas fa-ban" });
        }
        incomingTradeEl?.remove();
        const t = S("stores/ToastStore/toast");
        const answer = (path) => {
            incomingTradeEl?.remove();
            incomingTradeEl = null;
            postJson(`/worker/trades/requests/${path}`, {}).then((d) => {
                if (d.error) return errorModal(d.reason || "Something went wrong.");
                if (path === "accept") go("/trade");
            });
        };
        incomingTradeEl = h("div", { class: ["bv3-root", t.toastContainer], style: { top: "140px", zIndex: 30 }, dataset: { closing: "false" } },
            h("div", { class: t.toast, style: { cursor: "default", alignItems: "center", gap: "14px" } },
                h("div", { style: { width: "56px", height: "64px", flexShrink: 0 } }, Blook({ src: blookPath(user.avatar) })),
                h("div", { class: t.rightSide, style: { gap: "8px" } },
                    h("div", { class: t.toastHeader, style: { fontSize: "20px" } }, Username({ user }), " wants to trade"),
                    h("div", { style: { display: "flex", gap: "8px" } },
                        GenericButton({ backgroundColor: "#2a8a2a", icon: "fas fa-check", onClick: () => answer("accept") }, "Accept"),
                        GenericButton({ backgroundColor: "#a82a2a", icon: "fas fa-times", onClick: () => answer("decline") }, "Decline")))));
        document.body.append(incomingTradeEl);
        try { new Audio("/content/request.ogg").play().catch(() => { }); } catch { }
    }

    function checkTrades() {
        getJson("/worker/trades/ongoing").then((d) => {
            if (!d || d.error) return;
            if (d.trade && here() !== "/trade") return (location.href = "/trade");
            if (d.requests?.sending) tradeWaiting(d.requests.sending.username);
            if (d.requests?.receiving) incomingTrade(d.requests.receiving);
        });
    }

    onSocket(({ event, data, error }) => {
        if (error) return;
        if (event === "trading-requests-received") incomingTrade(data?.user);
        else if (event === "trading-requests-accepted") { tradeWaitingClose?.(); go("/trade"); }
        else if (event === "trading-requests-declined") {
            tradeWaitingClose?.();
            toast({ header: "Trade", body: "Your trade request was declined.", icon: "fas fa-times-circle" });
        }
        else if (event === "trading-requests-cancelled") { incomingTradeEl?.remove(); incomingTradeEl = null; }
    });

    (() => {
        const MAX_BLOOKS = 4;
        const dropV2Popups = () => setTimeout(() => document.querySelectorAll('body > [class*="arts__modal___VpEAD"]').forEach((e) => e.remove()), 50);

        async function render(root) {
            const self = await whenUser();
            const res = await getJson("/worker/trades/ongoing");
            const trade = res?.trade?.users ? res.trade : v2().trade;
            if (!trade?.users || Object.keys(trade.users).length < 2) {
                root.append(Container({ style: { margin: "0 5%", minWidth: "unset" } }, "You aren't in a trade right now."));
                return void setTimeout(() => go("/stats", true), 1500);
            }

            const myId = String(self.id);
            const otherId = Object.keys(trade.users).find((id) => String(id) !== myId);
            const mine = trade.users[myId] || trade.users[self.id];
            const theirs = trade.users[otherId];
            if (!mine || !theirs) {
                root.append(Container({ style: { margin: "0 5%", minWidth: "unset" } }, "Couldn't read this trade. Add ?nov3 to the url to use Blacket's own trade page."));
                return;
            }
            mine.blooks ||= {};
            theirs.blooks ||= {};
            mine.tokens = Number(mine.tokens) || 0;
            theirs.tokens = Number(theirs.tokens) || 0;
            let other = { id: otherId, username: "Them" };
            let iAccepted = false;

            const offerGrid = (blooks, editable) => {
                const names = Object.keys(blooks);
                const slot = { width: "64px", height: "74px", borderRadius: "var(--border-radius)", background: "rgba(var(--black), 0.2)", boxSizing: "border-box" };
                return h("div", { style: { display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "repeat(2, 64px)", gap: "8px" } },
                    ...names.map((name) => tooltip(h("div", { style: slot },
                        InventoryItem({ blook: name, amount: blooks[name], onClick: editable ? () => editOffer(name) : null })), editable ? `${name}, click to change` : name)),
                    ...Array.from({ length: MAX_BLOOKS - names.length }, () => h("div", { style: { ...slot, border: "2px dashed rgba(var(--white), 0.12)" } })));
            };
            const sideValue = (side) => worth(side.blooks) + side.tokens;

            const tokenInput = Input({ icon: "fas fa-coins", type: "number", min: "0", value: String(mine.tokens), placeholder: "Tokens" });
            Object.assign(tokenInput.style, { margin: "0", width: "200px" });
            let tokenTimer = null;
            tokenInput.querySelector("input").addEventListener("input", (e) => {
                clearTimeout(tokenTimer);
                tokenTimer = setTimeout(() => {
                    const n = Math.max(0, Math.min(parseInt(e.target.value, 10) || 0, self.tokens ?? 0));
                    e.target.value = String(n);
                    mine.tokens = n;
                    iAccepted = false;
                    emitSocket("trading-ongoing-tokens", String(n));
                    draw();
                }, 350);
            });

            const sendBlooks = () => {
                iAccepted = false;
                emitSocket("trading-ongoing-blooks", mine.blooks);
                draw();
            };

            function editOffer(name) {
                const have = self.blooks?.[name] || 0;
                const input = Input({ icon: "fas fa-hashtag", type: "number", min: "1", value: String(mine.blooks[name]), placeholder: `1 - ${have}` });
                const set = () => {
                    mine.blooks[name] = Math.max(1, Math.min(parseInt(input.querySelector("input").value, 10) || 1, have));
                    close();
                    sendBlooks();
                };
                const close = openModal(ModalHeader(name), ModalBody(`How many would you like to trade? You have ${have.toLocaleString()}.`),
                    h("form", { onsubmit: (e) => { e.preventDefault(); set(); } }, input),
                    ModalButtons(
                        GenericButton({ onClick: set }, "Set"),
                        GenericButton({ backgroundColor: "#a82a2a", onClick: () => { delete mine.blooks[name]; close(); sendBlooks(); } }, "Remove"),
                        GenericButton({ onClick: () => close() }, "Cancel")));
            }

            const addBlook = ({ name, real }) => {
                if (!real) return;
                if (mine.blooks[name]) return editOffer(name);
                if (Object.keys(mine.blooks).length >= MAX_BLOOKS) return toast({ header: "Trade", body: `You can offer up to ${MAX_BLOOKS} different blooks.`, icon: "fas fa-info-circle" });
                mine.blooks[name] = 1;
                sendBlooks();
            };

            const receiveText = () => {
                const names = Object.keys(theirs.blooks);
                return h("div", null, "You will receive ",
                    names.length ? names.map((n, i) => [i ? ", " : "", `x${theirs.blooks[n]} `, h("span", { class: rarityColor(n) === "rainbow" ? "rainbow" : null, style: { color: rarityColor(n) } }, n)]) : "no blooks",
                    ` and ${theirs.tokens.toLocaleString()} tokens.`);
            };

            const accept = () => {
                if (iAccepted) {
                    iAccepted = false;
                    emitSocket("trading-ongoing-cancel");
                    return draw();
                }
                confirmModal("Accept Trade", receiveText(), () => {
                    iAccepted = true;
                    emitSocket("trading-ongoing-accept");
                    draw();
                });
            };
            const decline = () => confirmModal("Decline Trade", "Are you sure you want to end this trade?", () => {
                emitSocket("trading-ongoing-decline");
                go("/stats");
            });

            const top = h("div", { class: "bv3-m-trade-top", style: { display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "1fr 1fr", gap: "14px" } });
            const bottom = h("div", { style: { display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: "10px" } });

            let search = "";
            const picker = h("div", { style: { flex: 1, minHeight: 0 } });
            const drawPicker = () => picker.replaceChildren(ItemContainer({
                user: self,
                options: { showItems: false, showPacks: false, showLocked: false, search },
                style: { height: "100%", width: "100%", boxSizing: "border-box", borderRadius: "var(--border-radius)" },
                onClick: addBlook
            }));
            const searchBox = SearchBox({ placeholder: "Search your blooks...", oninput: (e) => { search = e.target.value; drawPicker(); } });
            Object.assign(searchBox.style, { margin: "0 0 10px", width: "100%", boxSizing: "border-box", boxShadow: "none", padding: "0" });
            const panel = { margin: "0", minWidth: "unset", padding: "12px 14px 18px", boxSizing: "border-box" };
            Object.assign(searchBox.style, { margin: "0", flex: "1", minWidth: "0" });
            const searchRow = h("div", { style: { display: "flex", gap: "10px", alignItems: "center", marginBottom: "10px" } }, searchBox,
                plugin("quickOffers") && GenericButton({ icon: "fas fa-layer-group", onClick: openPresets, style: { minWidth: "unset" } }, "Offers"));
            const blooksPanel = Container({ style: { ...panel, minHeight: 0 } }, searchRow, picker);

            function openPresets() {
                presetsModal(() => mine, (preset) => {
                    const blooks = {};
                    let missing = false;
                    for (const [name, n] of Object.entries(preset.blooks)) {
                        const have = self.blooks?.[name] || 0;
                        if (have < n) missing = true;
                        if (have > 0 && Object.keys(blooks).length < MAX_BLOOKS) blooks[name] = Math.min(n, have);
                    }
                    mine.blooks = blooks;
                    mine.tokens = Math.min(preset.tokens || 0, self.tokens ?? 0);
                    tokenInput.querySelector("input").value = String(mine.tokens);
                    emitSocket("trading-ongoing-tokens", String(mine.tokens));
                    sendBlooks();
                    if (missing || mine.tokens < (preset.tokens || 0)) toast({ header: "Quick Offers", body: "You don't have all of that offer any more, so only what you own was added.", icon: "fas fa-info-circle" });
                });
            }

            function baitWarning(before) {
                chime();
                const drop = sideValue(before) - sideValue(theirs);
                const close = openModal(ModalHeader(h("span", { style: { color: "#ff6b6b" } }, h("i", { class: "fas fa-triangle-exclamation", style: { marginRight: "10px" } }), "Offer Changed")),
                    ModalBody(`${other.username} changed their offer after it was accepted. Your accept was cancelled, so check it before accepting again.`),
                    ModalBody(h("div", { style: { textAlign: "left", fontSize: "18px" } },
                        h("div", null, h("b", null, "Before: "), offerText(before)),
                        h("div", null, h("b", null, "Now: "), offerText(theirs)),
                        plugin("tradeValues") && drop > 0 && h("div", { style: { color: "#ff8a8a", fontWeight: 700, marginTop: "6px" } }, `That's ${drop.toLocaleString()} less in value.`))),
                    ModalButtons(GenericButton({ onClick: () => close() }, "Got It")));
            }

            const chatPanel = trade.room != null && h("div", { style: { position: "relative", minHeight: 0, borderRadius: "var(--border-radius)", background: "var(--primary-color)", boxShadow: "inset 0 -7px rgba(var(--black), 0.2)", overflow: "hidden", transform: "translateZ(0)" } });
            if (chatPanel) VIEWS.chat.renderRoom(chatPanel, { room: trade.room, name: "trade", embedded: true });

            const Side = (user, side, editable, accepted, mirrored) => Container({ style: { ...panel, flexDirection: mirrored ? "row-reverse" : "row", alignItems: "center", gap: "18px" } },
                h("div", { style: { display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", alignItems: "center", gap: "8px", minWidth: "110px" } },
                    h("div", { style: { position: "relative", width: "80px", height: "92px" } },
                        Blook({ src: blookPath(avatarOf(user)) }),
                        tooltip(h("div", { style: { position: "absolute", top: "-4px", [mirrored ? "left" : "right"]: "-8px", width: "18px", height: "18px", borderRadius: "50%", background: accepted ? "#3ddc3d" : "#e23b3b", boxShadow: "0 0 0 3px var(--primary-color)" } }),
                            accepted ? "Accepted" : "Not accepted")),
                    h("div", { style: { fontSize: "20px", maxWidth: "150px", overflow: "hidden", textOverflow: "ellipsis", whiteSpace: "nowrap" } }, Username({ user })),
                    h("div", { style: { fontSize: "14px", fontWeight: 700, color: accepted ? "#7dff7d" : "#ff8a8a" } }, accepted ? "Accepted" : "Not accepted")),
                offerGrid(side.blooks, editable),
                h("div", { style: { flex: 1, display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", alignItems: "center", gap: "8px", minWidth: 0 } },
                    h("div", { style: { fontSize: "14px", opacity: 0.6 } }, "Tokens"),
                    editable ? tokenInput : h("div", { style: { display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: "8px", fontSize: "24px", fontWeight: 700 } },
                        h("img", { src: media("/content/token.png"), style: { width: "26px" } }), side.tokens.toLocaleString()),
                    plugin("tradeValues") && h("div", { style: { fontSize: "14px", opacity: 0.6 } }, `Value ${sideValue(side).toLocaleString()}`)));

            function draw() {
                const diff = sideValue(theirs) - sideValue(mine);
                top.replaceChildren(Side(self, mine, true, iAccepted, false), Side(other, theirs, false, !!theirs.accepted, true));
                const button = (props, label) => GenericButton({ ...props, style: { flex: 1, minWidth: "unset" } }, h("span", { style: { fontSize: "22px" } }, label));
                bottom.replaceChildren(
                    plugin("tradeValues") && h("div", { style: { textAlign: "center", fontSize: "17px", fontWeight: 700, color: diff > 0 ? "#7dff7d" : diff < 0 ? "#ff8a8a" : null } },
                        diff === 0 ? "Even trade by value." : diff > 0 ? `You gain ${diff.toLocaleString()} in value.` : `You lose ${(-diff).toLocaleString()} in value.`),
                    h("div", { style: { display: "flex", gap: "14px" } },
                        button({ icon: iAccepted ? "fas fa-rotate-left" : "fas fa-check", backgroundColor: iAccepted ? null : "#2a8a2a", onClick: accept }, iAccepted ? "Cancel Accept" : "Accept"),
                        button({ icon: "fas fa-times", backgroundColor: "#a82a2a", onClick: decline }, "Decline")));
            }

            const off = onSocket(({ event, data, error }) => {
                if (error || !event?.startsWith("trading-ongoing")) return;
                if (event === "trading-ongoing-tokens" || event === "trading-ongoing-blooks") {
                    const before = { blooks: { ...theirs.blooks }, tokens: theirs.tokens };
                    const wasAccepted = iAccepted || theirs.accepted;
                    if (event === "trading-ongoing-tokens") theirs.tokens = Number(data?.tokens) || 0;
                    else theirs.blooks = data?.blooks || {};
                    theirs.accepted = false;
                    iAccepted = false;
                    if (wasAccepted && plugin("baitWarning")) baitWarning(before);
                }
                else if (event === "trading-ongoing-accept") theirs.accepted = true;
                else if (event === "trading-ongoing-cancel") theirs.accepted = false;
                else if (event === "trading-ongoing-decline") {
                    dropV2Popups();
                    const close = openModal(ModalHeader("Trade Declined"), ModalBody(`${other.username} ended the trade.`),
                        ModalButtons(GenericButton({ onClick: () => { close(); go("/stats"); } }, "Okay")));
                    return;
                }
                else if (event === "trading-ongoing-complete") {
                    recordTrade(other, mine, theirs);
                    dropV2Popups();
                    const close = openModal(ModalHeader("Trade Complete"), ModalBody(receiveText()),
                        ModalButtons(GenericButton({ onClick: () => { close(); go("/blooks"); } }, "Okay")));
                    return;
                }
                draw();
            });

            draw();
            root.append(h("div", { class: "bv3-m-trade", style: { display: "grid", gridTemplateRows: "auto minmax(0, 1fr) auto", gap: "14px", height: "100vh", padding: "65px 2% 18px", boxSizing: "border-box" } },
                top,
                h("div", { class: "bv3-m-trade-mid", style: { display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: chatPanel ? "minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(360px, 40%)" : "minmax(0, 1fr)", gap: "14px", minHeight: 0 } },
                    blooksPanel, chatPanel),
                bottom));
            drawPicker();
            getUser(otherId).then((u) => { if (u) { other = u; draw(); } });
            return off;
        }

        PAGES["/trade"] = { topRight: ["tokens"], noSidebar: true, render };
    })();

    (() => {
        const SORTS = [
            { icon: "fas fa-arrow-down-wide-short", tooltip: "Highest Value", fn: (a, b) => b.value - a.value },
            { icon: "fas fa-arrow-up-short-wide", tooltip: "Lowest Value", fn: (a, b) => a.value - b.value },
            { icon: "fas fa-arrow-down-a-z", tooltip: "Name", fn: (a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name) }
        ];

        async function render(root) {
            const s = S("views/AuctionHouse/auctionHouse");
            const a = S("components/Auction/auction");
            await whenData();

            let query = "";
            let sort = 0;
            let rarity = null;
            let player = null;
            const rarities = [...new Set(VALUES.map((v) => v.rarity))];
            const rarityOrder = Object.keys(v2().rarities || {});
            rarities.sort((x, y) => rarityOrder.indexOf(x) - rarityOrder.indexOf(y));

            const items = h("div", { class: s.auctionHouseItemsContainer });
            const header = h("div", { class: S("components/PageHeader/pageHeader").pageHeader });
            let observer = null;
            let typing = null;

            const Card = (v) => {
                const blook = v2().blooks?.[v.name];
                const color = v2().rarities?.[v.rarity]?.color || "#ffffff";
                const owned = (player || me()).blooks?.[v.name] || 0;
                return h("div", { class: a.auction, style: { cursor: "default" } },
                    h("div", { class: a.auctionImageContainer }, Blook({ src: blook?.image || media("/content/icons/error.png") })),
                    h("div", { class: a.auctionInfo },
                        h("div", { class: a.auctionName }, v.name),
                        h("div", { style: { height: "28px", display: "flex" } }, RarityLabel(v.rarity, color)),
                        h("div", { class: a.auctionPrice }, "Value: ", h("img", { src: media("/content/token.png"), draggable: "false" }), " ", h("span", null, v.value.toLocaleString())),
                        owned > 0 && h("div", null, player ? `${player.username} owns: ` : "You own: ", h("span", null, `${owned.toLocaleString()} (${(owned * v.value).toLocaleString()} tokens)`))),
                    h("div", { class: a.auctionBadge, style: { color: color === "rainbow" ? null : color } }, v.rarity.toUpperCase()));
            };

            const drawHeader = () => {
                const who = player || me();
                header.replaceChildren(player ? `${player.username}'s Values` : "Values",
                    h("div", { style: { fontFamily: "var(--paragraph-font)", fontSize: "20px", fontWeight: 700, marginTop: "4px", opacity: 0.6 } },
                        `${player ? "Their" : "Your"} blooks are worth ${worth(who.blooks).toLocaleString()} tokens`));
            };

            const draw = () => {
                const q = query.trim().toLowerCase();
                const list = VALUES
                    .filter((v) => (!q || v.name.toLowerCase().includes(q)) && (!rarity || v.rarity === rarity) && (!player || player.blooks?.[v.name] > 0))
                    .sort(SORTS[sort].fn);
                observer?.disconnect();
                if (!list.length) return items.replaceChildren(h("div", { class: s.noAuctions },
                    h("div", { class: s.noAuctionsImageContainer }, h("img", { class: s.noAuctionsImage, src: media("/content/404.png") }), h("div", { class: s.noAuctionsImageOverlay })),
                    player ? `${player.username} has no blooks with a value.` : "No blooks found."));
                const holder = h("div", { class: s.auctionHouseItems });
                const sentinel = h("div", { style: { width: "100%", height: "1px" } });
                let shown = 0;
                const more = () => {
                    holder.append(...list.slice(shown, shown + 24).map(Card));
                    shown += 24;
                    if (shown >= list.length) { observer?.disconnect(); sentinel.remove(); }
                };
                observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => entries.some((e) => e.isIntersecting) && more(), { root: items, rootMargin: "400px" });
                items.replaceChildren(holder, sentinel);
                items.scrollTop = 0;
                more();
                observer.observe(sentinel);
            };

            function lookupModal() {
                let error;
                const input = Input({ icon: "fas fa-user", placeholder: "Username", maxlength: "64", autocomplete: "off" });
                const field = input.querySelector("input");
                const submit = () => {
                    const name = field.value.trim();
                    error?.remove();
                    if (!name) return buttons.before(error = ErrorContainer("Where's the username?"));
                    getUser(name).then((u) => {
                        if (!u?.blooks) return buttons.before(error = ErrorContainer("That user could not be found."));
                        player = u;
                        query = "";
                        close();
                        drawHeader();
                        drawSearch();
                        draw();
                    });
                };
                const buttons = ModalButtons(GenericButton({ onClick: submit }, "Look Up"), GenericButton({ onClick: () => close() }, "Cancel"));
                const close = openModal(ModalHeader("Look Up a Player"), ModalBody("Whose blooks do you want to value?"),
                    h("form", { onsubmit: (e) => { e.preventDefault(); submit(); } }, input), buttons);
                field.focus();
            }

            const searchHolder = h("div");
            const drawSearch = () => {
                const box = SearchBox({
                    placeholder: player ? `Search ${player.username}'s blooks...` : "Search for a blook...",
                    value: query,
                    oninput: (e) => { query = e.target.value; clearTimeout(typing); typing = setTimeout(draw, 120); },
                    buttons: [
                        player
                            ? { icon: "fas fa-arrow-left", tooltip: "Back to All Values", onClick: () => { player = null; drawHeader(); drawSearch(); draw(); } }
                            : { icon: "fas fa-user", tooltip: "Look Up a Player", onClick: lookupModal },
                        { icon: SORTS[sort].icon, tooltip: `Sort: ${SORTS[sort].tooltip}`, onClick: () => { sort = (sort + 1) % SORTS.length; drawSearch(); draw(); } },
                        { icon: "fas fa-sliders", tooltip: rarity ? `Rarity: ${rarity}` : "All Rarities", onClick: rarityModal },
                        { icon: "fas fa-times", tooltip: "Reset Search", onClick: () => { query = ""; rarity = null; sort = 0; drawSearch(); draw(); } }
                    ]
                });
                searchHolder.replaceChildren(box);
            };

            function rarityModal() {
                const pick = (r) => { rarity = r; close(); drawSearch(); draw(); };
                const close = openModal(ModalHeader("Filter by Rarity"),
                    ModalButtons(
                        GenericButton({ onClick: () => pick(null), backgroundColor: !rarity ? "var(--accent-color)" : null }, h("span", { style: { color: !rarity ? "var(--background-color)" : null } }, "All")),
                        ...rarities.map((r) => GenericButton({ onClick: () => pick(r), backgroundColor: rarity === r ? "var(--accent-color)" : null },
                            h("span", { class: v2().rarities?.[r]?.color === "rainbow" ? "rainbow" : null, style: { color: rarity === r ? "var(--background-color)" : v2().rarities?.[r]?.color } }, r)))));
            }

            drawHeader();
            drawSearch();
            root.append(header, searchHolder, h("div", { class: s.auctionHouseContainer }, h("div", { class: s.auctionHouse }, items)));
            draw();
            return () => observer?.disconnect();
        }

        VIEWS.values = { topRight: ["tokens"], render };
    })();

    (() => {
        const seen = new Set();

        const watchList = () => String(pluginValue("watchList", "")).split("\n").map((line) => {
            const [name, price] = line.split(":").map((x) => x.trim());
            return name ? { name, max: parseInt(String(price || "").replace(/[^\d]/g, ""), 10) || VALUE_OF.get(name) || 0 } : null;
        }).filter((w) => w && w.max > 0);

        async function check() {
            if (!plugin("bazaarAlerts") || !me() || document.visibilityState !== "visible") return;
            for (const watch of watchList()) {
                const d = await getJson(`/worker/bazaar?item=${encodeURIComponent(watch.name)}`);
                recordPrices(d?.bazaar);
                for (const listing of d?.bazaar || []) {
                    if (listing.item.toLowerCase() !== watch.name.toLowerCase() || listing.price > watch.max || seen.has(listing.id)) continue;
                    seen.add(listing.id);
                    if (listing.seller === me().username) continue;
                    toast({
                        header: "Bazaar Alert", expires: 10000,
                        body: `${listing.item} listed for ${listing.price.toLocaleString()} by ${listing.seller}`,
                        icon: (v2().blooks?.[listing.item] || v2().items?.[listing.item])?.image || "fas fa-bell",
                        onClick: () => go(`/bazaar?item=${encodeURIComponent(listing.item)}`)
                    });
                }
                await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1500));
            }
        }

        const undercut = new Set();
        async function checkUndercut() {
            if (!plugin("undercutAlert") || !me() || document.visibilityState !== "visible") return;
            const self = me();
            const mine = ((await getJson(`/worker/bazaar?item=${encodeURIComponent(self.id)}`))?.bazaar || []).filter((l) => l.seller === self.username);
            const cheapest = {};
            for (const l of mine) cheapest[l.item] = Math.min(cheapest[l.item] ?? Infinity, l.price);
            for (const [item, price] of Object.entries(cheapest)) {
                const d = await getJson(`/worker/bazaar?item=${encodeURIComponent(item)}`);
                recordPrices(d?.bazaar);
                for (const l of d?.bazaar || []) {
                    if (l.item !== item || l.seller === self.username || l.price >= price || undercut.has(l.id)) continue;
                    undercut.add(l.id);
                    toast({
                        header: "Undercut!", expires: 10000, icon: (v2().blooks?.[item] || v2().items?.[item])?.image || "fas fa-arrow-trend-down",
                        body: `${l.seller} listed ${item} for ${l.price.toLocaleString()}, under your ${price.toLocaleString()}.`,
                        onClick: () => go(`/bazaar?item=${encodeURIComponent(item)}`)
                    });
                }
                await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1500));
            }
        }

        setTimeout(check, 5000);
        setInterval(check, 60 * 1000);
        setTimeout(checkUndercut, 8000);
        setInterval(checkUndercut, 90 * 1000);
    })();

    let mobileNavEl, sidebarEl, topRightEl, bodyEl, bodyCleanup, mountId = 0;

    function currentPage() {
        return activeView ? VIEWS[activeView] : PAGES[here()];
    }

    function mountTopRight(page) {
        topRightEl?.remove();
        topRightEl = null;
        if (page?.topRight === null) return;
        topRightEl = TopRight(page?.topRight || []);
        document.body.append(topRightEl);
    }

    function fitChrome(page) {
        const full = !!page?.noSidebar;
        if (full) document.documentElement.style.setProperty("--sidebar-width", "0px");
        else document.documentElement.style.removeProperty("--sidebar-width");
        if (sidebarEl) sidebarEl.style.display = full ? "none" : "";
    }

    function mountBody(page) {
        fitChrome(page);
        try { bodyCleanup?.(); } catch { }
        bodyCleanup = null;
        bodyEl?.remove();
        bodyEl = null;
        if (!page) return;

        document.documentElement.dataset.bv3Rebuilt = "true";
        const inner = h("div", { style: { display: "contents" } });
        bodyEl = page.dontUseBody
            ? h("div", { class: "bv3-root bv3-body" }, inner)
            : SidebarBody(page.pageHeader, inner);
        document.body.append(bodyEl);

        const muteLoader = () => {
            const b = v2();
            if (typeof b.stopLoading === "function") try { b.stopLoading(); } catch { }
            if (typeof b.startLoading === "function" && !b.startLoading.bv3) b.startLoading = Object.assign(() => { }, { bv3: true });
        };
        muteLoader();
        [250, 1000, 2500].forEach((ms) => setTimeout(muteLoader, ms));

        const id = ++mountId;
        whenData().then(() => {
            if (id !== mountId) return;
            try {
                const keep = (fn) => { if (typeof fn !== "function") return; if (id === mountId) bodyCleanup = fn; else fn(); };
                const cleanup = page.render(inner);
                if (cleanup?.then) cleanup.then(keep, (err) => console.error("[V3 skin]", err));
                else keep(cleanup);
            } catch (err) {
                console.error("[V3 skin]", err);
            }
        });
    }

    function rerender() {
        mountTopRight(currentPage());
        mountBody(currentPage());
    }

    function refreshSidebar() {
        const fresh = Sidebar();
        sidebarEl.replaceWith(fresh);
        sidebarEl = fresh;
        const nav = MobileNav();
        mobileNavEl?.replaceWith(nav);
        mobileNavEl = nav;
        fitChrome(currentPage());
    }

    function showView(name) {
        activeView = name;
        syncDock();
        refreshSidebar();
        mountTopRight(VIEWS[name]);
        mountBody(VIEWS[name]);
    }

    function showRoute() {
        if (!PAGES[here()]) return location.reload();
        activeView = null;
        syncDock();
        for (const modal of document.querySelectorAll(".bv3-modal")) modal.remove();
        refreshSidebar();
        scrollTo(0, 0);
        rerender();
    }

    function mountDock() {
        document.querySelector(".bv3-dock")?.remove();
        if (!plugin("dockedChat")) return;
        let open = false;
        const panel = h("div", { style: { position: "fixed", right: "20px", bottom: "86px", width: "min(440px, calc(100vw - 40px))", height: "min(620px, 72vh)", zIndex: 20, background: "var(--primary-color)", borderRadius: "var(--border-radius)", boxShadow: "inset 0 -7px rgba(var(--black), 0.2), 0 0 12px rgba(var(--black), 0.5)", overflow: "hidden", display: "none", transform: "translateZ(0)" } });
        const button = h("div", {
            style: { position: "fixed", right: "20px", bottom: "20px", width: "54px", height: "54px", borderRadius: "50%", background: "var(--secondary-color)", display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center", fontSize: "24px", cursor: "pointer", zIndex: 20, boxShadow: "inset 0 -4px rgba(var(--black), 0.25), 0 0 8px rgba(var(--black), 0.4)" },
            onclick: () => {
                open = !open;
                panel.style.display = open ? "block" : "none";
                if (open && !panel.firstChild) VIEWS.chat.renderRoom(panel, { room: 0, name: "global", embedded: true });
            }
        }, h("i", { class: "fas fa-comments" }));
        document.body.append(h("div", { class: "bv3-root bv3-dock" }, panel, button));
        syncDock();
    }
    function syncDock() {
        const dock = document.querySelector(".bv3-dock");
        if (dock) dock.style.display = activeView === "chat" ? "none" : "";
    }

    document.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
        if (e.defaultPrevented || e.button !== 0 || e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey || e.shiftKey || e.altKey) return;
        const a = e.target.closest?.("a[href]");
        if (!a || a.target || !a.closest(".bv3-root") || !navigateTo) return;
        const u = new URL(a.href, location.href);
        if (u.origin !== location.origin || !PAGES[u.pathname.replace(/\/+$/, "") || "/"]) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        go(u.pathname + u.search);
    });
    let pressTimer = null, pressedAt = 0;
    document.addEventListener("touchstart", (e) => {
        clearTimeout(pressTimer);
        pressedAt = 0;
        const touch = e.touches[0], target = e.target;
        if (e.touches.length !== 1 || !target.closest?.(".bv3-root")) return;
        pressTimer = setTimeout(() => {
            pressedAt = Date.now();
            target.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent("contextmenu", { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, clientX: touch.clientX, clientY: touch.clientY }));
        }, 550);
    }, { passive: true });
    for (const type of ["touchmove", "touchcancel"]) document.addEventListener(type, () => clearTimeout(pressTimer), { passive: true });
    document.addEventListener("touchend", (e) => {
        clearTimeout(pressTimer);
        if (pressedAt && e.cancelable) e.preventDefault();
    });
    document.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
        if (!pressedAt || Date.now() - pressedAt > 2000) return;
        pressedAt = 0;
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopImmediatePropagation();
    }, true);
    document.addEventListener("contextmenu", (e) => {
        if (!e.isTrusted) return;
        clearTimeout(pressTimer);
        if (e.pointerType === "touch" || matchMedia("(pointer: coarse)").matches) pressedAt = Date.now();
    }, true);

    window.addEventListener("popstate", () => navigateTo && showRoute());

    const REMAP = { "rgb(31, 31, 31)": "rgb(15, 15, 15)", "rgb(47, 47, 47)": "rgb(31, 31, 31)" };
    const doneSheets = new WeakSet();
    function remapSheets() {
        const walk = (rules) => {
            for (const rule of rules) {
                if (rule.cssRules && !(rule instanceof CSSStyleRule)) { walk(rule.cssRules); continue; }
                const value = rule.style?.getPropertyValue("background-color");
                if (REMAP[value]) rule.style.setProperty("background-color", REMAP[value], rule.style.getPropertyPriority("background-color"));
            }
        };
        for (const sheet of document.styleSheets) {
            if (doneSheets.has(sheet) || sheet.ownerNode?.id === "bv3-style") continue;
            let rules;
            try { rules = sheet.cssRules; } catch { continue; }
            doneSheets.add(sheet);
            walk(rules);
        }
    }

    function injectStyle() {
        if (document.getElementById("bv3-style") || !document.documentElement) return false;
        document.documentElement.classList.add("bv3");
        applyTheme();
        if (PAGES[here()]) document.documentElement.dataset.bv3Rebuilt = "true";
        const style = document.createElement("style");
        style.id = "bv3-style";
        style.textContent = V3_CSS;
        (document.head || document.documentElement).append(style);
        return true;
    }


    // BetterBlacket compatibility layer for the V3 renderer.
    // UI-level ports are used instead of BetterBlacket's document-start interceptor.
    const BBX_KEY = "bv3:betterBlacket";
    let bbxState = {};
    try { bbxState = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(BBX_KEY)) || {}; } catch { }
    const bbxSave = () => { try { localStorage.setItem(BBX_KEY, JSON.stringify(bbxState)); } catch { } };

    function mountBBAddons() {
        if (!document.body || document.getElementById("bv3-bbx-tools")) return;
        const style = document.createElement("style");
        style.id = "bv3-bbx-style";
        style.textContent = `
          #bv3-bbx-tools{position:fixed;left:14px;bottom:14px;z-index:99990;font-family:var(--paragraph-font,Arial,sans-serif)}
          #bv3-bbx-trigger{border:0;border-radius:12px;padding:10px 14px;background:var(--secondary-color,#333);color:var(--accent-color,#fff);font-weight:800;box-shadow:0 4px 14px #0006;cursor:pointer}
          #bv3-bbx-panel{display:none;position:fixed;left:14px;bottom:64px;width:min(360px,calc(100vw - 28px));max-height:70vh;overflow:auto;padding:14px;border-radius:14px;background:var(--primary-color,#222);color:var(--accent-color,#fff);box-shadow:0 8px 30px #0009;border:1px solid #ffffff22;box-sizing:border-box}
          #bv3-bbx-panel h3{margin:0 0 10px;font-size:18px}
          #bv3-bbx-panel label{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin:10px 0;font-size:14px}
          #bv3-bbx-panel textarea{width:100%;min-height:120px;box-sizing:border-box;background:var(--background-color,#111);color:var(--accent-color,#fff);border:1px solid #ffffff30;border-radius:8px;padding:9px;font:12px/1.45 monospace;resize:vertical}
          #bv3-bbx-panel button{border:0;border-radius:8px;padding:8px 10px;background:var(--secondary-color,#444);color:var(--accent-color,#fff);font-weight:700;cursor:pointer}
          #bv3-bbx-tokens{position:fixed;right:12px;top:12px;z-index:99980;display:none;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:7px 11px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--primary-color,#222);color:var(--accent-color,#fff);font:800 13px var(--paragraph-font,Arial,sans-serif);box-shadow:0 3px 12px #0007;border:1px solid #ffffff22;pointer-events:none}
          .bv3-bbx-rarity{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 7px var(--bbx-rarity,#fff)) drop-shadow(0 0 2px var(--bbx-rarity,#fff))}
        `;
        document.head.append(style);

        const tools = document.createElement("div");
        tools.id = "bv3-bbx-tools";
        const trigger = document.createElement("button");
        trigger.id = "bv3-bbx-trigger";
        trigger.type = "button";
        trigger.textContent = "BB+";
        const panel = document.createElement("section");
        panel.id = "bv3-bbx-panel";
        panel.innerHTML = `<h3>BetterBlacket tools</h3>
          <label><input id="bv3-bbx-token-toggle" type="checkbox"> Show tokens on every page</label>
          <label><input id="bv3-bbx-rarity-toggle" type="checkbox"> Highlight Bazaar rarity</label>
          <div style="font-weight:800;margin:12px 0 6px">Quick CSS</div>
          <textarea id="bv3-bbx-css" spellcheck="false" placeholder="/* Add custom CSS here */"></textarea>
          <div style="display:flex;gap:8px;margin-top:8px"><button id="bv3-bbx-save">Save CSS</button><button id="bv3-bbx-close">Close</button></div>
          <p style="opacity:.65;font-size:11px;margin:9px 0 0">Settings are saved in this browser. V3's built-in Auto Open and chat tools remain available.</p>`;
        tools.append(trigger, panel);
        document.body.append(tools);

        const tokens = document.createElement("div");
        tokens.id = "bv3-bbx-tokens";
        tokens.innerHTML = `<span>🪙</span><span id="bv3-bbx-token-value">0</span>`;
        document.body.append(tokens);

        const cssTag = document.createElement("style");
        cssTag.id = "bv3-bbx-custom-css";
        cssTag.textContent = typeof bbxState.quickCSS === "string" ? bbxState.quickCSS : "";
        document.head.append(cssTag);

        const tokenToggle = panel.querySelector("#bv3-bbx-token-toggle");
        const rarityToggle = panel.querySelector("#bv3-bbx-rarity-toggle");
        const cssInput = panel.querySelector("#bv3-bbx-css");
        tokenToggle.checked = bbxState.tokensEverywhere !== false;
        rarityToggle.checked = bbxState.highlightRarity !== false;
        cssInput.value = cssTag.textContent;

        const updateTokens = () => {
            const user = me();
            const visible = tokenToggle.checked && user && Number.isFinite(Number(user.tokens));
            tokens.style.display = visible ? "flex" : "none";
            if (visible) panel.querySelector("#bv3-bbx-token-value").textContent = Number(user.tokens).toLocaleString();
        };
        tokenToggle.addEventListener("change", () => {
            bbxState.tokensEverywhere = tokenToggle.checked;
            bbxSave();
            updateTokens();
        });
        rarityToggle.addEventListener("change", () => {
            bbxState.highlightRarity = rarityToggle.checked;
            bbxSave();
            applyBBXRarity();
        });
        panel.querySelector("#bv3-bbx-save").addEventListener("click", () => {
            bbxState.quickCSS = cssInput.value;
            bbxSave();
            cssTag.textContent = cssInput.value;
            toast({ header: "Quick CSS saved", body: "Your custom CSS has been applied.", icon: "fas fa-palette" });
        });
        panel.querySelector("#bv3-bbx-close").addEventListener("click", () => panel.style.display = "none");
        trigger.addEventListener("click", () => panel.style.display = panel.style.display === "block" ? "none" : "block");

        const updateTokensSafely = () => {
            try { updateTokens(); } catch { }
        };
        updateTokensSafely();
        setInterval(updateTokensSafely, 1200);

        function applyBBXRarity() {
            document.querySelectorAll(".bv3-bbx-rarity").forEach((el) => {
                el.classList.remove("bv3-bbx-rarity");
                el.style.removeProperty("--bbx-rarity");
            });
            if (!rarityToggle.checked || here() !== "/bazaar") return;
            const rarities = v2().rarities || {};
            document.querySelectorAll('[class*="auctionName"]').forEach((nameEl) => {
                const name = nameEl.textContent.trim();
                const blook = v2().blooks?.[name];
                const color = blook && rarities[blook.rarity]?.color;
                const image = nameEl.parentElement?.parentElement?.querySelector('[class*="auctionImageContainer"] img');
                if (image && color) {
                    image.classList.add("bv3-bbx-rarity");
                    image.style.setProperty("--bbx-rarity", color);
                }
            });
        }
        const rarityObserver = new MutationObserver(() => applyBBXRarity());
        rarityObserver.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
        applyBBXRarity();
    }


    const isV2Game = () => !!document.querySelector('[class*="styles__sidebar___1XqWi"]') || (!!PAGES[here()] && !!document.getElementById("app"));

    let mounted = false;
    async function mount() {
        if (mounted || !document.body || !isV2Game()) return;
        mounted = true;

        document.body.prepend(Background());
        if (!document.querySelector('meta[name="viewport"]')) (document.head || document.documentElement).append(h("meta", { name: "viewport", content: "width=device-width, initial-scale=1" }));
        sidebarEl = Sidebar();
        mobileNavEl = MobileNav();
        document.body.append(sidebarEl, mobileNavEl);
        const page = currentPage();
        fitChrome(page);
        if (page) {
            const l = S("components/Loader/loader");
            bodyEl = SidebarBody(null, h("div", { style: { display: "flex", justifyContent: "center", alignItems: "center", height: "100vh" } },
                h("div", { class: l.loaderSpinner, style: { width: "40px" } })));
            document.body.append(bodyEl);
        }

        const user = await whenUser();
        refreshSidebar();
        mountTopRight(currentPage());
        mountBody(currentPage());
        navigateTo = showRoute;

        mountDock();
        mountBBAddons();
        checkTrades();
        startExtras(user);
        if (plugin("autoClaim") && (!user.claimed || new Date(user.claimed * 1000).toDateString() !== new Date().toDateString())) {
            getJson("/worker/claim").then((d) => {
                if (d.error) return;
                user.claimed = Date.now() / 1000;
                success("Claimed your daily reward.");
            });
        }
    }

    if (!injectStyle()) {
        new MutationObserver((_, obs) => { if (injectStyle()) obs.disconnect(); }).observe(document, { childList: true });
    }

    let queued = false;
    const bootObserver = new MutationObserver(() => {
        if (queued) return;
        queued = true;
        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
            queued = false;
            remapSheets();
            mount();
            if (!mounted) return;
            bootObserver.disconnect();
            new MutationObserver(remapSheets).observe(document.head || document.documentElement, { childList: true });
        });
    });
    bootObserver.observe(document, { childList: true, subtree: true });

    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", mount);
    window.addEventListener("load", () => { remapSheets(); mount(); });

})();
